Ore dake Level Up na Ken
Вебтун. Поднятие уровня в одиночку. Solo Leveling
description:
In a world where awakened beings called “Hunters” must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Seong Jin-U, nicknamed “the weakest hunter of all mankind,” finds himself in a constant struggle for survival. One day, after a brutal encounter in an overpowered dungeon wipes out his party and threatens to end his life, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole player: Jin-U has been granted the rare opportunity to level up his abilities, possibly beyond any known limits. Follow Jin-U’s journey as he takes on ever-stronger enemies, both human and monster, to discover the secrets deep within the dungeons and the ultimate extent of his powers.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

alternative: The Weakest Hunter of All Mankind

characters.description:
__Class:__ Mage
__Relative(s):__ [Park Kyung-Hye](https://anilist.co/character/209396/KyungHye-Park) (Mother), [Sung Jin-Ah](https://anilist.co/character/138791/JinAh-Sung) (Sister), ~![Sung Il-Hwan](https://anilist.co/character/138790/IlHwan-Sung) (Father), [Cha Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/138789/HaeIn-Cha) (Wife), [Sung Su-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/306654/Suho-Sung) (Son), [Yoo Jin-Ho](https://anilist.co/character/136076/JinHo-Yoo) (Brother in Law)!~
~!__Guild:__ Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)
__Affiliation:__ Korean Hunters Association (helper), White Tiger Guild (helper), Hunters Guild (helper), Knights Guild (helper), Ahjin Guild (Guild Master)!~

Seong Jin-U is the protagonist of [Solo Leveling](https://anilist.co/manga/105398/Solo-Leveling/) and is known as an infamously weak E-Rank Hunter. He is a humble and benevolent individual who cares deeply for his family and has an ardent desire to become stronger. As a result, he shares a close relationship with his sister and his mother, and rarely wastes an opportunity to refine his skills and gain more power.

~!He becomes an S-Rank hunter after being given a chance to become stronger by the System.!~

__Guild:__ Hunters Guild
__Class:__ Sword Fighter
__Affiliations:__ Jeju Island Raid Party, [Song Chi-Yul](https://anilist.co/character/136073/ChiYul--Song)’s Dojo (Disciple)

Cha Hae-In is the Vice-Guild Master of the Hunters Guild. She is an S rank hunter and the 9th ranked hunter in South Korea. She possesses the unique ability of mana smell and hates the smell of hunters except for [Sung Jin-Woo](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung).

Igris is one of the first Shadows that Sung Jin-Woo acquired. He was initially protecting an empty throne in an Instant Dungeon where Jin-Woo was doing his Job Quest in the Job Change Quest Dungeon.

After two failed attempts of Shadow Extraction, Sung Jin-Woo convinced him to protect him instead of protecting an Empty throne, obtaining him as a Knight Grade Shadow.

Born from the Ant Queen on Jeju Island, The Ant King becomes the main threat during the Fourth Jeju Island Raid.

~!Single-handedly responsible for the deaths of over 8 of the 16 S-Rank Hunters during the raid.!~

~!After being killed by Sung Jinwoo, the Ant King was revived as one of his shadow soldiers, and was given him the new name of Beru.!~
Esil Radiru, or Elisa Radiru, is a daughter of the Radiru chief and an Aristocratic Demon found at the S-Rank Demon's Castle Instant Dungeon.
She is a healer with rank B.
Younger sister of [Jin-U](https://anilist.co/character/129928).
Go Gun-Hee (고건희) is a South Korean S-Rank Hunter and the Chairman of the Korean Hunters Association.

__Class:__ Tanker
__Guild:__ ~!Ahjin Guild (Vice-Guild Master)!~

Yoo Jin-Ho is a D rank hunter and is [Jin-U Seong](https://anilist.co/character/129928/JinWoo-Sung)'s faithful assistant and combat partner.
He is a S rank hunter and master of the White Tiger guild.
An A rank hunter that works for Hunter's association of Korea.
Choi Jong-In is one of the 10 S-Rank Hunters of South Korea. He is also the Guild Master of the Hunters Guild.
Il-Hwan is a muscular middle-aged man with black eyes, shaggy black hair, and slight facial hair. When using his powers or agitated, his eyes glows bright yellow.
Park Hee-Jin (박희진) is a member of White Tiger Guild that Sung Jin-Woo helped when they got stuck inside the Red Gate.

Han Song-I is an E-Rank hunter who quit school after gaining money through the Yoo Jin-Ho and Sung Jin-Woo motley group of party. She is friends with Sung Jin-Ah. She first appeared when Jin-Ah visited Jin-Woo in the hospital but she didn't know him then.
Thomas Andre (트마스 아드레) is one of only 5 National Level Hunters that exist and is considered to be the strongest Tank on Earth. He is also the Guild Master of the Scavenger Guild.

__Magic Type:__ Fire

Korean C-Rank Hunter and kumdo teacher. He is also one of Jinwoo's old friends, having known him since he was a E-Rank Hunter.
B-rank Hunter and An inspector working for South Korea's Hunter Association, Monitoring Division.

Min Byung-Gu was a retired hunter and one of the 10 S-Rank and only S-Rank Healer of South Korea. He was a close friend with the White Tiger's Guild Master Baek Yoon-Ho. He took part in the 4th Jeju Island Reclamation Raid and was a member of the Korean Raid Team tasked with killing the boss of the Jeju Island Gate.
Goto Ryuji is Japan's strongest S-Ranked Hunter and the Guild Master of Draw Sword Guild, one of the most powerful guilds in Asia.
Atsushi Kumamoto is one of Japan's strongest S-Rank Hunters. He is a member of Japan's most powerful guild, the Draw Sword Guild led by Goto Ryuji.
Son Ki-Hoon (손기훈) is the Team Leader of Attack Force B of the Hunters Guild.
Hwang Dong-su is an​ S-class hunter who works for Scavenger's Guild in America.
Famous Korean actor, known as Asia's biggest movie star. He is also an A-Rank Hunter.
Yu Myung-Han (유명한) is Jin-Ho's father and the CEO of Yoojin Construction.

description:
Back then, Dok-Ja had no idea. He had no idea his favorite web novel 'Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse' was going to come to life, and that he would become the only person to know how the world was going to end. He also had no idea he would end up becoming the protagonist of this novel-turned-reality. Now, Dok-Ja will go on a journey to change the course of the story and save humankind once and for all.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm

He is the sole reader of the webnovel Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World (AKA 'Ways of Survival'), an apocalyptic fantasy story written by tls123.

__Height:__ 158 cm

Han Su-Yeong is first shown to have a selfish personality, prioritizing her own interests over anything else. However, throughout the story she grows closer to the members of , gradually coming to  value each of them. Han Su-Yeong is a very confident, intelligent, and witty person, constantly insulting and joking around with her companions, but she gets angry very easily when others do stupid things. Similar to [Yu Jung-Hyeok](https://anilist.co/character/180892/), she will berate the people she cares about even as she tries her hardest to keep them safe. When [Kim Dok-Ja](https://anilist.co/character/180887/) is absent, Han Su-Yeong is the de facto leader of , using her astounding intelligence to guide them through any hardships that may come their way.

__Height:__ 184 cm

Yoo Joonghyuk is the main character of tls123's novel Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World.

~!Throughout Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint, he is seen in his 1863rd, 1864th (believed to be his 3rd), and 1865th regressions.!~

Demon-like Judge of Fire is a constellation of the  nebula who makes judgments through fire. Their real identity is the Archangel Uriel. Their contractor must only perform acts of "absolute good." In return, they gain enormous power.

She is one of the original 4 constellations who wishes to sponsor Kim Dokja. Despite being rejected, she is an avid supporter of .

~!It is later revealed that the Uriel of the 999th turn was one of Yoo Joonghyuk's companions and fought with his team to reach The End.!~

Jung Heewon is a member of Kim Dokja's party. She was part of the marginalized group from Geumho station. She becomes one of the most vital party members, sometimes referred to as the "sword" of the group.

__Height:__ 166 cm

Yoo Sang-Ah is one of Kim Dok-Ja's colleagues and current party members. She is described as being Mino Soft's beauty, with a gentle and lively look about her. While her expression is normally smiley, it becomes somewhat cold when she is thinking.
~!Instead of a single Constellation, Yoo Sangah is sponsored by the entirety of the "Olympus" nebula. She is therefore able to access multiple stigmas and powers, granted by the various Constellations within the nebula.!~

Bihyung is the dokkaebi in charge of Kim Dokja's scenario. Kim Dokja makes several deals with Bihyung.

He is the creator of the 'Random Item Box'. He was fired from the Star Stream Administration Bureau after the product was forced to be banned by the bureau and became a streamer.
Lee Ji-Hye is an ex-high school student and a current member of Kim Dokja's Company. She was originally a character in Ways of Survival, fighting under Yoo Joong-Hyuk's leadership.

Gil-Young is a young boy who is a member of [Kim Dok-Ja](https://anilist.co/character/180887/Kim-DokJa)'s party. He had the insects that allowed some of the party to survive Main Scenario 1. He is not a character from the original novel.

Shin Yoosung is one of Kim Dokja's and Yoo Joonghyuk's party members, and Kim Dokja's sponsored Incarnation. She is a character from the original Ways of Survival, and the child whose 41st round adult self appeared in Main Scenario 5 as the Disaster of Floods.

He's one of few constellation that showed interest in Kim Dokja since the start of the scenarios.

~! Later, it is revealed that he is actually [Yoo Joong-Hyuk](https://anilist.co/character/180892/JungHyeok-Yu), the protagonist of the original Ways of Survival, from after the end of the novel. After completing 1863 regressions, he travelled to another world line which contained Kim Dokja's world, watching over it since the beginning of the scenarios. !~

Persephone, better known by her constellation modifier "Queen of the Darkest Spring," is the wife of Hades and queen of the Underworld. She is equal in power to Hades and can change her incarnation appearance at will.

alternative: Great Sage the Equal of Heaven

characters.description: The Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, also known as the Great Sage the Equal of Heaven, is one of the "story bodies" i.e. versions of Sun Wukong. ~!He offered to sponsor Kim Dokja during the first Sponsor Selection, and has remained one of his staunch supporters since, eventually helping accept him as the fifth story body of Sun Wukong.!~

Lee Hyunsung is a former army lieutenant and a current member of [Kim Dokja](https://anilist.co/character/180887/Kim-DokJa)'s party. He was originally a character in Ways of Survival, fighting under Yoo Joonghyuk's leadership.

~!The Oldest Dream is the constellation sponsor of Yoo Joonghyuk, the protagonist of Ways of Survival. He provides Yoo Joonghyuk with the ability to regress in time, kickstarting the plot of the webnovel.!~ ~!The Oldest Dream's true identity is that of a significantly younger Kim Dokja, whose love for Ways of Survival created an entire set of world lines where it was a reality.!~
Lee Seol-Hwa is one of the 10 Evils, the Poisoner. She was Yoo Jong-Hyuk's companion in his second round.

alternative: Father of The Rich Night ‚ Ruler of The Underworld‚ King of the Underworld

characters.description:
The Father of the Rich Night is the constellation Hades, one of the head gods of Olympus and ruler of the underworld.

~!During the  scenario hades announces Kim Dokja as his successor!~
~!Hades later accepts Kim Dokja as his son!~
Yoo Mia is the younger sister of Yoo Joong-hyuk, the protagonist of Ways of Survival.

Kim Nam-Un is a side character in Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint. He was one of Yoo Joonghyuk's companions in Three Ways to Survive in a Ruined World.
~!He dies at the beginning of the story as he is eliminated in the last moment by Kim Dokja.!~

The Abyssal Black Flame Dragon is a constellation and the leader of the  group. He offered to sponsor Kim Dokja in the first Sponsor Selection, but was turned down. Despite being snubbed, he followed Kim Dokja through the scenarios and became a strong supporter of his nebula.

~!In all other rounds in WoS, he chose Kim Namwoon as his incarnation. In this 3rd round, Han Sooyoung chooses him as a sponsor. He comes to the aid of  several times through the story, and is a candidate for the Apocalypse Dragon.!~

Anna Croft is a prophet and savior. She's an American born in Las Vegas. Her sponsor is the Asgard Nebula and her goal is to protect Earth.

To achieve her goals she is willing to do anything necessary, such as putting her companion in a dangerous position during the Gourmet Banquet scenario in hopes that Thursday's Thunder, Thor would sponsor her companion. She has betrayed Yoo Joonghyuk multiple times over his regressions.
Gong Pildu is a member of  who acts as the main base defense. Formerly, he was the leader of the Landlord Alliance.
Nirvana Moebius is the leader of the Salvation Church and a reincarnator obsessed with regressor Yoo Joonghyuk.

characters.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Rank:__ Regular
__Position:__ Light Bearer

Khun Aguero Agnis is a E-Rank Regular from Khun Family, and is often referred to simply as "Khun". He is a best friend of [Twenty-Fifth Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam), one of the main protagonists of Tower of God.

Khun relies heavily on his master intellect, however, this is not his only strong field. He also has exceptional physical attributes and is a skilled Light Bearer. His powers in combat cannot be denied.

__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 168 cm (Part 1), 180 cm (Part II)
__Rank:__ Irregular
__Position:__ Wave Controller
__Born:__  ~!Floor of Death!~__Occupation:__  ~!FUG Slayer Candidate!~

Twenty-Fifth Baam is an Irregular and one of the main protagonists of Tower of God. Bam entered in search of his best friend [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/135466/Rachel), and after passing Headon's test he was deemed worthy to climb the Tower.

In Part I, he is a highly empathetic and caring young man, understanding little of life, having had virtually no contact with people before meeting Rachel and later entering the Tower. He hates loneliness and other people's loneliness. He is considered very naive and knows little about the Tower. During Part I, his only reason for climbing the Tower is to be with Rachel.

In Part II:
~!
He was forced to join FUG, and received then the name of Jue Viole Grace (쥬 비올레 그레이스), the Slayer Candidate, to keep his real identity hidden. As Viole, he is far more violent. He now has friends to protect and will not hesitate to fight if it means protecting them. He now completely understands that in order to climb the Tower, he must be pre-emptive and prepared to engage in combat and eradicate all opposition. He's become more introverted, rarely ever speaking or displaying any signs of emotion. He's also quite cold and calculating, interacting with others only out of necessity and will take advantage of a situation to defeat his opponents.

Later in the Part as FUG's hold on him weakens, he begins to be more expressive and talkative. Later, when he officially meets with Khun and Rak for the first time in seven years, he smiles happily and embraces them, showing that his original personality that he had hidden away to protect himself from FUG's influence was resurfacing.
!~

In Part III:
~!
He is completely back to his normal self, with the addition of some improvements in areas such as confidence. He additionally dropped the 'Viole' look and sticks with an updated 'Baam' look. He is still often called both Baam and Viole now. He now goes through new questions such as what to do when he can't save everyone, and old questions, such as why everyone can't just get along, but he is more accepting of things than before, all the while continually fighting stronger enemies and becoming stronger.
!~

alternative: ラーク・レクレイシャー

characters.description:
__Species:__ Wraithraiser, ~!Native One!~
__Height:__ 3m (Decompressed)
__Rank:__ Regular C-Rank
__Position:__ Spear Bearer

Rak Wraithraiser is a Regular. He unwillingly teamed up with [Baam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and [Khun](https://anilist.co/character/84781/Khun-Aguero-Agnis) during the first test on the Second Floor and passed other tests with them. He was selected for the Spear Bearer position. He is a large and powerful warrior and a very confident individual.
Rak is originally a 3 meter tall creature, but after he mocked the Ranker [Yu Han Sung](https://anilist.co/character/141286/Sung-Yu-Han), the Second Floor Test Director, his body was shrunken by them. He eventually found out how to get back to his original size. As a being who can control their body size, he is a Compression Licenser.He is a direct descendant of the Native One, a type of being that is able to rule over the elements in the Tower.

Rak doesn't come off as particularly smart; he thinks he's superior to almost everyone else and so refers to other people as "turtles". He occasionally calls himself "Rakleader" when he is feeling particularly full of himself, although Khun may be to blame for indulging him. He tries to make himself appear tough, although he's actually a bit of a baby sometimes. However, he does seem to have a little of a caring side in him.

__Species:__ Human
__Rank:__ Extra

Rachel, also known as Michelle Light was Baam's best and only friend as she was the only one to visit him in his "cave". She longs to see the stars which is one of the fabled rewards waiting at the top of the Tower, because she "fears the Night".
~!Like Baam she is an Irregular.!~

alternative: エンドロシ・ザハード

characters.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Endorsi Jahad is a Regular and one of Jahad's Princesses, currently climbing the Tower. Among Regulars, Endorsi is unmatched in terms of physical ability. Among the Jahad's Princesses, she is fairly warm and more human.

Her parents weren't around when she was born. She was then adopted by a couple from the Middle Area before she became a princess. Later, her adoptive parents were killed by Snake Charmer.

Her character concept is that of a 'Normal modern girl' taking great care of her looks, stressed about her weight, wanting to hear she is pretty while acting confident. A girl who is yet to mature fully.

Endorsi doesn't believe in being friends with a guy at first and says that guys and girls cannot be friends and can only be boyfriend and girlfriend and later states that she is not allowed to date anyone because she is a Princess of Jahad, but later on she catches feelings for [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and calls Bam her boyfriend.

Ha Yuri Jahad, more commonly known as Yu​ri Jahad (lacking her family name), is a High Ranker and Princess from the Ha Family. Notably, she is one of the most famous Princesses and therefore highly favored, with much political influence throughout The Tower.

~!She is the owner of Black March and Green April, two of the 13 Month Series. She is the first Princess to own two 13 Months at the same time since Garam Jahad. Notably, she is one of the most famed Princesses, and perhaps one of the most favored.!~

__Species:__ Red Witch
__Height:__ 168 cm
__Rank:__ Regular
__Position:__ Wave Controller, Scout, Guide

Hwaryun is a quiet person who says little and she has a gloomy and ominous aura. She is also quite manipulative.

In Part II, she's depicted as mischievous and teasing, as she clearly mocked the Viole impostor and repeatedly called him "Pig". She almost always smiles in mischief and probably a little bit of arrogance. She also tends to be extremely blunt, caring very little about other peoples' feelings; though this could be considered her way of spurring a person on. This leads her to seem very harsh.

Hwaryun is Viole's Guide but is also the Guide for FUG's Rankers notably Ha Jinsung. ~!It was revealed that she went into the Floor of Death first, instructing another Red-haired lady to lead the way for Yuri and Khun's team.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Born:__ Outside
__Height:__ 195 cm
__Rank:__ Irregular, High Ranker #4 (Currently)
__Position:__ Fisherman
__Occupation:__ Wolhaiksong (Vice Captain)

Urek Mazino is an Irregular, currently 4th in Rank. He was the strongest active Ranker before [Jahad](https://anilist.co/character/126030/Jahad) became active once again. He is also the most recent person to be part of the Top 5 High Rankers inside the Tower.

He is considered to be on the same level as Phantaminum by weaker Rankers, however, his true rank is almost impossible to determine in terms of the Top 4 ranks because the top 2 Rankers are inactive and thus, cannot be compared with Urek. He mentioned to [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam) on the 43rd Floor that they would meet again later on the 77th Floor, then left the floor. His current location is unknown.

Urek is said to have a ruthless personality, leading him to be respected by all those who dare call themselves men and at the same time seems to be disliked by seemingly every woman he meets. He is also shown to be extremely confident to the point of arrogance, often ridiculing the efforts of those who were no match for him. Despite his ruthlessness and boastful nature, he still wants to help others and friends in need. He will also help strangers if he thinks they are "worthy" to be helped. He respects one's courage, determination, and nobility.

Lero-Ro is a former Examiner of the Second Floor. He is an exceptionally strong Ranker, to the point that even Quant, also a former Test Administrator (and a haughty one), would constantly boast about his strength. He was supposedly the strongest Second Floor Test Administrator and is particularly skilled in the use of Shinsoo. He was also the Light Bearer position instructor. He is fairly old, older than Yuri Zahard, as he stated that Anak Zahard didn't live up to a Princess's chaotic expectations like Yuri Zahard did, whom he met when they were both Regulars. He and Quant are awkwardly described as a "Set Menu", explained by the fact that Lero-Ro and Quant climbed the Tower together like a team. He is apparently quite famous, and he took over 300 years to climb the Tower.

Anaak is introduced in the second floor, where she forms a team with Shibisu and Hatz.

~!She introduces herself as one of Jahad's Princesses, but it's later revealed that she's actually the daughter of the real Anaak Jahad, who was impregnated by her lover and ran into hiding. Though she is only a demi-princess because of the diluted Jahad's blood in her, she used to possess two of the 13 Month Series at one point; something only a few Princesses have accomplished. She is climbing the Tower for revenge.!~

Ja Wangnan aspires to be the king of the whole Tower. He values his determination in life more than anyone else's desires. He plans to scale up the Tower's Floors and reach the true top of the Tower, unlike those who have given up.

The tenth Slayer of FUG, one of the 2nd generation of Slayers and until the latter events of the Hell Train, only his name and soul remained while his body had been lost. It was revealed during the Dallar Show that Hoaqin and his other siblings, in their combined form, was actually White.

Jin-Seong Ha is a High Ranker of the Ha Family and a member of FUG. Jinsung has a carefree and fun-loving attitude, although this also serves as a mask to hide his true intentions. Since meeting Baam, his character has mellowed slightly to the point where he feels regret at the FUG's treatment of Baam.
As a member of the Ha Family and one of the top 100 High Rankers, Jinsung is an incredibly powerful High Ranker, extremely skilled with martial arts and incredibly physically powerful, his status heightening the standards one would expect of him.

Additionally, even the Elders and Slayers of FUG are wary of angering him, speaking volumes about his strength, with Khel Hellam commenting it was a waste to lose someone as powerful as Jinsung and Kallavan noted that Jinsung is far stronger than Karaka, one of the Slayers. In fact, he is such a monster that Hwa Ryun stated that even a Slayer would have trouble against him in a serious fight.

Ran Khun is a Regular currently climbing the Tower. He was formerly Khun's teammate and was also formerly a member of the FUG team created for Jue Viole Grace. He often describes situations or people that are troublesome as 'annoying'. After the events of the Workshop Battle, he formed into a new team with Khun's direction. He is also from the same branch of the Khun family as Mascheny Jahad.

Ehwa Yeon, known by some as the "Yeon Family's Flare", is a member of the Yeon Family one of the 10 Great Families. She is a Regular climbing with the rest of her team, having recently participated in the Workshop Battle.

Lo Po Bia Elaine (로 포 비아 엘레인, Lo Po Bia Ellein) formerly known as Kaiser the Name Hunter (이름 사냥꾼 카이저, ileum sanyangkkun kaijeo; "Name Hunter Kaiser") is a Regular who acted as the ruler of the third station of the Hell Train located on the 39th Floor, Name Hunt, for over a thousand years on behalf of her family. She is one of the 3 top D-rank Regulars.

Headon is the Guardian of the First Floor and is the caretaker of the Tower. He has an appearance reminiscent of a white rabbit because of his long ears.

Headon talks in a friendly tone, but has been shown to have a cruel and manipulative streak. He presents his ideas and opinions in a logical and pragmatic manner, but his goals and desires themselves are not understood. He is perfectly willing to manipulate dozens of lives and create the nucleus of civil unrest to attain his mysterious goal.

Although most Administrators normally stay on their Floors, Headon seems to be the only Administrator with the ability to visit other Floors of the Tower. It is said that Headon is the most experienced Administrator of the Tower. Although that only means he was the first Administrator Zahard met and therefore the first one to carry out the roles of a Administrator, that doesn't mean he's the oldest.

__Species:__ Human
__Born:__ Outside
__Age:__ Older than his Empire
__Height:__ 240 cm
__Hair color:__ Yellow
__Eye color:__ Orange
__Position:__ Fisherman
__Rank:__ Ranker, High Ranker #3 (Currently)
__Occupation:__ Ruler and King of The Tower

__Jahad__ (자하드, "Jahadeu") is the famed "King of the Tower" and the most famous and greatest being residing inside; he is like a god to the inhabitants of the Tower. He is a High Ranker, currently retaining the 3rd spot in the ranking, and the overarching ruler of Jahad's Floors and founder of the Jahad Empire while still conquering the Tower.

Infamous for his prevailing immortality, he has become the prime target of FUG.

After the events of the Hidden Floor, Jahad came out of hibernation and is active once again, making him the highest ranked __Active__ Ranker in the Tower, right above [Urek Mazino](https://anilist.co/character/124137/Urek-Mazino). Due to his actions, Jahad can be considered the primary antagonist of the series.
Karaka is a Slayer in FUG. His secret hideout is located on the 97th Floor.

Eduahn is a High Ranker, currently in the 6th ranking. He is the head of the Khun Family, one of the 10 Great Families, and also the father of numerous children from the Khun Family, such as Aguero Agnis.

alternative: The Princess of the Deep Colored Sea

characters.description: She's one of the princesses of Jahad. She is known as the Hermit in the North City of the 43rd Floor and the Princess of the Deep Colored Sea, she is also the owner of Blue August and Indigo July.

alternative: エヴァン・エドロック

characters.description: Evan Edrok is a High Ranker as well the Chief Guide of Zahard Royalty, which is a unique position in the Tower. He always seems to follow his partner, Ha Yuri Zahard.

__Sobriquet__: Aloof Wave
__Rank__: 14

Po Bidau Gustang is the head of the Po Bidau Family, one of the 10 Great Warriors and the first living being to systematically record Shinsoo. Po Bidau Gustang is the Tower’s most famous Wave Controller and writer. Excluding the eccentrics within The Workshop, he probably knows the most about The Tower. He is shown to be an arrogant individual, with such great reputation and influence in his family, that even his family members think he has omniscient intellect.

Sachi Faker, also known as the "Ticket Hunter", is a D-rank Regular and part of the 3 top predators within the Hell Express. He is apparently the one that Regulars should be most afraid of at the first station.
Boro (보로, Boro) is a D-rank Fisherman and an experienced level Shinsoo Martial Artist. Boro had already boarded the Hell Express twice in the past.

description:
High school life is hard enough, but it’s even harder for Seon Jin. A sickly disabled boy, Jin might as well be invisible. No one ever pays attention to him, except for the bullies who prey on him for being weak. Jin, however, keeps a very dark secret—there’s a serial killer in his house…and it’s his father!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description: Jin is the main protagonist and the son of the murderous CEO Dongsoo Seon. Jin is a scrawny teenager with pale skin, brown hair, and a blue right eye. Because of the "accident" during his childhood, Jin's left eye was substituted with a reddish-brown glass eye, which he hides with his irregular bangs. Due to his brutal nature, while dealing with bullies and other opponents, Jin will occasionally appear bruised and cut from his fights. Even though Jin wants to be righteous and well-meaning, he has a sociopathic side that emerges in times of intense stress or anger. When this trait shows itself, he shows no fear, uses rather a foul language, and his face turns dark and menacing. When provoked into an extreme rage, Jin shows no remorse or hesitation for any violent actions he may commit in this state. He is also prone to outbursts, breakdowns, or temporary lapses of fear when he is questioned about his father, hears mention of his father, or he notices his father in action.
Kyun is known to be a sociable butterfly and friendly, she has a lot of morality as well as common sense. However there are times where she can be quite cold when the time calls for it.
Dongsoo Seon is the father of Jin Seon and the executive CEO of G Corporation.

Manny Kim is the 'alpha' of his school, being quite popular with everyone. ~!That changed when an accident took his legs.!~ He comes from a rich family, gets good grades, and is quite good at fighting. He and Jin Seon have a very complicated relationship.

description:
In the mysterious, RPG dungeon-like Tower, Confucius Kim lives a mundane existence, envying all the star hunters. One day, his wish for more is granted with a legendary skill to copy others’ abilities… at the cost of his life. Before he can make sense of it, he’s killed by the #1 hunter, the Flame Emperor! But this activates his skill and now he’s copied a new one, the ability to travel back in time upon death. How will Confucius use these skills to outplay the competition and rise to the top?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description:
Gong-Ja Kim is an aspiring hunter who is jealous of the #1 ranker: the [Flame Emperor](https://anilist.co/character/211825/Yu-SoHa).

Before entering the tower, Gong-Ja lived his life as an orphan. Even after entering, he was a below-average hunter who adored and worshipped higher rankers. This admiration later turned into envy though, and [Soo-Ha Yoo](https://anilist.co/character/211825/Yu-SoHa) became the main subject of Gong-Ja's jealousy. This below-average hunter's life changed when he received an S-Rank Skill Card for the toxic envy he developed. His gifted S-Rank Skill Card allowed him to receive the power of those who killed him.
She is the villainess of the story named "The Tale of Sormwyn Academy".
Anastasia is the Guild Leader of Black Dragon.
The leader of the Demonic Faction from the story chosen for Floor 22.
Bambollina is the Guild Leader of Pantheon.
Nisha is the Guild Leader of the United Merchants.
Liaofan is the Guild Leader of the Heavenly Order.

description:
When civil engineering student Su-Ho Kim falls asleep reading a fantasy novel, he wakes up as a character in the book! Su-Ho is now in the body of Lloyd Frontera, a lazy noble who loves to drink, and whose family is in a mountain of debt. Using his engineering knowledge, Su-Ho designs inventions to avert the terrible future that lies in wait for him. With the help of a giant hamster, a knight, and the world’s magic, can Su-Ho dig his new family out of debt and build a better future?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

characters.description:
__Height:__ 181 cm

A drunkard whose family is in a mountain of debt. Su-Ho Kim, a civil engineer, is transmigrated into his body.

The protagonist of the fantasy novel Iron Blooded Knight, who rises to the level of a sword grandmaster after several years of adventure. Javier Asrahan is a loyal knight of the Frontera family. He currently acts as the personal guard of Lloyd Frontera and accompanies him on nearly every occasion.

Bangul is a fantastical snake capable of growing to gigantic proportions and processing dirt into either steel or volcanic ash.
Bibeong, also known as King Storma, is a legendary beast responsible for the creation of Lake Kapua.

Hamang is a fantastical hippopotamus capable of growing to gigantic proportions after drinking a large quantity of water.

Michael is farmboy that lives at the Barony of Frontera.

description:
A world where everything has been lost. A boy and a girl alone together. A spark of hope kindled between them. All they can do is move forward. But against broken adults and devastating despair, how long will they be able to keep going...?

(Source: Yen Press)

characters.description: The boy who lost their parents live with one hope: that he can walk with the [girl](https://anilist.co/character/197692/Geu-Sonyeo) forever...until they come across adults who are trying to take that hope away.

The girl who lost her father due to an infectious disease, contracted from someone on the bus who they ventured with.
Meets the boy unexpectedly on the bus, and together they walk on the path for as long as they can.

He used to be a doctor. He has excellent marksmanship skills and knowledge of weaponry, picking off one by one the soldiers who kidnap the children, and setting explosive traps within the city. He provides the children with shelter and food and treats their wounds, asking for help with finding and exterminating trespassers in exchange. He believes that every person carrying a gun does so with the intent to kill, and must be eliminated.
~!The meat he and the children eat comes from the bodies of those he has killed.!~

After the war, him and his daughter are the only surviving members of their family. They manage to get on a bus with several other people, traveling from place to place in search of safety. He is a kind man who tries to take his daughter's mind off the gloom of their new lives. ~!He also succumbs to the infectious disease contracted from one of the passengers.!~

He drives the bus used by a group of people who managed to escape the war. A former soldier who saw his friends die in battle, he is a pragmatic but compassionate man of few words. He looks after the girl after her father leaves the bus.

A woman who lives along the seaside with her partner.
~!The Boy meets the couple as an old man and is reminded of the two children he met in the forest long ago. Though initially reluctant, he eventually becomes friends with this couple and their child.!~

The child of the seaside couple.
~!She considers The Boy (now an old man) to be her grandfather.!~

He is among the few who managed to escape the war, using a bus to travel from place to place in search of safety. He correctly diagnoses an old man as suffering from an incurable infectious disease, and succumbs to it himself shortly after the old man. In a wedding photo, his parents are shown to be of Indian descent.

A man who lives along the seaside with his partner.
~!The Boy meets the couple as an old man and is reminded of the two children he met in the forest long ago. Though initially reluctant, he eventually becomes friends with this couple and their child.!~

A man whom the boy and the girl meet on their journey. The girl takes pity and lets him follow them, while the boy feels uneasy about his presence and suggests they try to shake him off. He behaves in a manner resembling a chimpanzee (only makes high-pitched noises, snatches the children's supplies, eats raw meat, and doesn't seem to understand or respond in human language). ~!His only spoken words are cries of pain as he lay dying after accidentally stepping on a hidden landmine while chasing after the children.!~
She travels with a boy who seems to be around her age; both speak the same language, which the Boy and Girl don't understand.

He travels with a girl who seems to be around his age; speak the same language, which the Boy and Girl don't understand. ~!When the two pairs meet for the first time, the boys hold each other at gunpoint, unsure of the others' intentions, but the girls defuse the situation.!~
~!However, when a missile explodes in the vicinity, the boys are startled into firing their weapons. He is killed and his partner immediately commits suicide after witnessing his death.!~

She is among the few who managed to escape the war, using a bus to travel from place to place in search of safety. She usually sits by herself in silence. ~!When the novelist discovers that he is infected with the same disease that had taken another passenger's life, and voluntarily leaves the bus, she falls into a deep depression and refuses to eat. She ends up committing suicide shortly after.!~

He is among the few who managed to escape the war, using a bus to travel from place to place in search of safety. ~!He suffers from an unnamed infectious disease which proves to be terminal and highly contagious, first manifesting through a persistent cough and eventually through necrotic tissue. He is the first to leave the bus once the second stage manifests, though by that point it's already too late for the others.!~

description:
At the age of eight, I-Jin Yu lost his parents in a plane crash and became stranded in a foreign land, forced to become a child mercenary in order to stay alive. He returns home ten years later to be reunited with his family in Korea, where food and shelter are plenty and everything seems peaceful. But I-Jin will soon learn that life as a teenager is a whole other feat of survival. With only one year of high school left, I-Jin must master new tactics to maneuver his way around the schoolhouse battleground. Can he survive a year of high school? Or rather, will the school be able to survive him?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: As the only survivor of a plane crash, Ijin became a mercenary in order to survive. 10 years later, he returned to his home country where his family was. As a former mercenary, he attends school and is currently a senior.

Shin Yeon-A is Da-Yeon's friend. She transfers back to Da-Yeon & I-Jin's class after studying abroad for 2 years.

~!When she left the school 2 years before the story begins to study in America, Da-Yeon started being bullied.!~

Shin Yeon-A is the granddaughter of the owner of SW, the biggest corporation in South Korea. She is almost always accompanied by her secretary and bodyguard Go Seok-Ju whom she grew up with.
I-Jin Yu's sister. She often gets bullied in school but is protected by her brother.
Seok-Ju Go is Yu-Na Shin's secretary and bodyguard.
Cha Seoha is Yu Ijin's friend. She is also a celebrity.

description:
After an unexpected family tragedy, a reclusive high school student is forced to leave his home -- only to face something much scarier: a reality where monsters are trying to wipe out humanity. Now he must fight alongside a handful of reluctant heroes to try and save the world before it’s too late.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description:
The main character of the story. An isolated, lonely teenager who is forced to move when his family dies in a traffic accident. He is eighteen years old and stopped going to high school due to unknown reasons. He spends his time trolling and tricking on internet, as well as playing various RPGs. He sold his old house and moved into Green Home apartments (room 1410) because the money left by his deceased family was insufficient for him to survive as an isolated person. He then proceeds to chose October 25th as a date to commit suicide.

~!Hyun is a human infected with the monsterization, but fights back against both his impending mutation and the monsters that have overtaken the world.!~ His weapon of choice is a handmade electric spear, powered by a large battery that he carries in his backpack.

It was revealed in chapters 81 and 82 that ~!Hyun had a rather happy childhood. Up until his high school years, he was the pride of his family. However, in high school he was targeted by a rich bully who made sure that Hyun was socially excluded. Eventually, even his own sister started excluding him by claiming that he wasn't her brother. His parents took little action, due to the fact that the bully's father was owner of the company Hyun's dad worked at. They did however talk to the school, and the bully stopped picking on him after that incident. However, Hyun was traumatized from the experience, and came out a different person. Eventually, he fell into suicidal thoughts and developed a history of self harm.!~

Eighteen year old Hyuk Lee is the leader of the Green Roof Apartments Survivors and Eun Lee's older brother. He is also one of the deuteragonists of the series with the others being some of the Green Roof Apartment survivors.

Hyuk is an intelligent and level-headed young man with an affinity for leadership. He often plans the many missions the survivors need to undertake. He is unafraid to take risks and is pragmatic, such as accepting an infected human into their ranks, if it helps boost their success rates. He also was prepared to take underhanded measures to tip the odds in his favor. However, as other survivors have learned, Hyuk is extremely blunt in speech and often says things rudely or in a way that would draw their ire. Hyuk is aware of this trait and either uses it to energize people or to provoke people for his own enjoyment. Due to his video game playing habits, he occasionally offers explanations using video game terminology. Because of this and his bluntness, it often embarrasses his sister Eun. Despite this, Hyuk deeply cares about Eun. He notices her actions and is able to deduce that Eun has a crush on Hyun. Hyuk also possesses empathetic traits but masks it greatly for both survival and so that no biases are made when it came to decision making as a leader. However, if there is no harm to the survivors, Hyuk would let emotions and morality guide his decisions.
A girl who recently moved into Green Home apartments (room 1510) the same day as Hyun.

Thirty two year old Wook Pyeon, also called Mr. Mobster by some of the other residents, is a former police detective and a resident of Green Roof Apartments. He is fierce-looking and he appears to have a gangster manner. However, he calls himself a "good fella". He got fired for putting the son of an important person in hospital.

Due to his background, he is more aggressive than others. He still uses physical force to keep others in line, such as Hyun Cha. Despite this, he means well and will selflessly put his life on the line to save others. He appears confident in his ability to live and does not see his acts as a sacrifice, believing he will be able to come back alive. This confidence is borderline reckless: initially, he preferred to fight monsters barehanded, despite their superior strength and unpredictable abilities. He has a strong sense of justice and keeps count of the monsters he killed.

An intimidating man who looks to be in his 30s or 40s. He is slightly overweight but still muscular​ and sits in a wheelchair due to his missing left leg.
Du-Sik is quite skilled with engineering and mechanics, building many weapons/contraptions.

Jay-Hun is a survivor of the Green Roof Apartments. Jayhun is usually seen with Ji-Su. Jay-Hun was a devout Christian, which other apartment residents found odd. However, despite what he believed in, Jay-Hun was very tolerant of other beliefs. Through Jay-Hun's faith, he was able to work up the courage to do things that would otherwise terrify him. He was also very kindhearted towards others, even towards Hyun Cha who is infected. Jay-Hun used a sword as his weapon.

Yu-Ri Park is a survivor in the Green Roof Apartments. Twenty eight year old Yu-Ri is a pragmatist at heart. She is willing to do normally amoral things, such as loot bodies, to stay alive. She is also fine with casually mentioning her mortality in normal conversation. She tends to be sassy when questioned about her actions. She is very level headed in otherwise extremely stressful situations. Despite her willingness to loot bodies, she does have a moral code, noting that Gap-Su was more like a monster even when he was human.

Yu-Ri has some training as a medical care professional and was working as a senior caretaker before the apocalypse. Yu-Ri has asthma and needs to use an inhaler.

A young girl, who is Hyuk's little sister. She is quite childlike and even a liar. She is part of the Helping Squad. She has a crush on Hyun.

Shortly after being born, Eun and Hyuk's mother died. Only a few years later, their father's company goes bankrupt and the two are left at an orphanage, and their stay becomes permanent when their father dies in an accident. At the time, Eun was still very young; however, she did not appear to take the events well as she started an underage smoking habit. She and Hyuk eventually move to Green Home.

I-Hyun Jo is in the band of criminals who attempt to take over the apartment building. He is one of few half-monsters.

~!He is able to control his monsterization very precisely, as he has dissociative identity disorder and only his alter is actually affected by the monsterization. I-Hyun Jo is shown to be very kind, offering one of his asthma inhalers to Yu-Ri Park, and explaining his wrongdoings. He is very empathetic to others, even monsters. He seems to respect Joon Shin and will do as he asks. His alter ego, however, has given in to the monster. The alter ego displays sociopathic tendencies. It wants to be seen as an "anti-hero," and is frequently maniacal and violent in its attacks. However, both sides of Ihyun appear loyal to Joon Shin.!~

Joon Shin, a very manipulative, amoral, and cruel man, is the leader of a gang of prison escapees and the final antagonist in Sweet Home.

He is a former drug dealer who was arrested by Wook Pyeon and sentenced to jail. During the Monster Apocalypse, he led a group of prisoners through a jail-break and stole a prison bus.

He is clever enough to leverage the fake promise of essential resources to coerce the survivors into cooperation. He uses draconian methods to exert dominance over his gang and the survivors, such as threats of killing people who oppose him. He is, however, careful not to kill someone who may prove useful, such as those able to control their own monster. He is usually cold and calculating, but loses his temper when people disobey his commands. He also appears to hold a grudge against Pyeon as he was visibly enraged when challenged by Wook. Ultimately, Joon is selfish and isn't above abandoning his own gang if things go awry and is willing to turn into a monster in order to live.

Hyun-Shik Lim is part of Joon Shin's criminal gang. He was arrested as a con artist.

Hyun-Shik is a good actor and has working knowledge of psychology. He uses this to tell believable stories to manipulate other people into cooperating with the criminals, and presumably it is how he succeeded as a con artist before getting arrested. He is very proud of this ability and maniacally laughs about it when successful. He also appears to be the only one who genuinely cares for the other members of his gang,

Ho-Yeon Baek is one of Joon Shin's gang members. Ho-Yeon Baek is a prideful individual. He frequently carries a gun and uses it to intimidate other people. Additionally, he can't help but take on challenges to his pride, even if it means risking failure of an assignment. Despite being involved in criminal activity, he does seem to have some moral code, as he is regretful that his boss had to use a woman as a hostage.
The security guard of the apartment complex Hyun Cha lives in.

Gap-Su Seo is a member of Joon Shin's criminal gang. Out of all the members of Joon Shin's gang, Gap-Su is the most immoral and impulsive to the point of disobeying Joon's orders. He is willing to do many immoral things to others to satisfy his needs. He is also petty and vengeful. His impulsiveness and unreliability keeps him relatively low in the gang's pecking order, as he was the only gang member not given any important task to fulfill.

description:
Mori Jin is a high school student and Taekwondo specialist who enters "The God of High School," a fighting tournament that promises the winner anything they want. What began as a competition to seek out the best high school fighter soon reveals itself to be part of a much greater plot that goes beyond Mori's wildest imagination. What will he give to become a true god?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
__Occupation:__ G.O.H. Participant and Student
__Relatives:__ [Jin Tae-Jin](https://anilist.co/character/181867/TaeJin-Jin) (adoptive grandfather)
__Style:__ Renewal Taekwondo, Jin Mori Original

Jin Mori is introduced as a carefree and energetic student with an obsession for fighting. He loves eating and having fun. Mori can be seen as both confident and arrogant due to his identity later revealed. However, he still cares deeply about his friends and family, and will get serious when either of them are hurt or in danger.

Jin Mori was shown to be a dominant competitor in early stages of the G.O.H tournament. His fighting style in the anime is shown to resemble his adoptive grandfather's renewal taekwondo. He also has his own special technique which he names 'Jin Mori Original.' The first is called Blue Dragon Kick. His second is called Twin Dragon Blue Kick. His third and final technique is called Blue Dragon Tempest.

__Height:__ 180 cm

Dae-Wi is one of the main protagonists in The God Of Highschool. He was once part of the legendary duo named 'Mad Cows' and he is a very skilled fighter. Over time, he will become a close friend of Mo-Ri and Mi-Ra. He is a practitioner of the Kyokushin Karate (Full Contact Karate),

 ~!After training from Executive Q Dae-Wi is able to summon the charyeok Haetae!~

Yu Mira is the 25th Master of the Moon Light Sword Style. She was invited to participate in the God Of High School Tournament. ~!During the World Tournament and RagnarÖk, she received Original Greed and through it Ultio R bequeath her Okhwang's physical power (which he had previously stolen). Due to that, Sang Man-Duk recognized her as the Jade Emperor's successor.!~

Park Ilpyo is the Meridional Jeolla Province Champion of the G.O.H Tournament. He is considered as one of the top 3 fighters in the country and is famously known as Sakyamuni Park Ilpyo. He is one of the main supporting characters of the series.

__After RagnarÖk__ ~!17 years after RagnarÖk, he becomes one of The Six and devoted himself to teaching Ssam-Su Taekkyeon.!~
__CHARYEOK__ ~!Nine-Tails Guardian: This is the Charyeok of Park Il-Pyo. It is currently the only Charyeok that changes the appearance of its user, besides Yu Mi-Ra's Yeo-Po Bong-Seon. It is one of the most powerful Charyeok seen to date it has been seen taking down multiple Charyeok in Greed's arsenal. The Nine-Tails Guardian is seen to give the wielder health generation, physical enhancements including enhanced strength and speed, and pyrokenesis.!~

alternative: The Youngest Member of The Six

characters.description:
__Race__: ~!Supreme God!~
__Style__: Borrowed Power User
__Charyeok__: Longinus

Mu-Jin Park is a member of the National Assembly of Korea, a member of The Six and the organizer of the G.O.H Tournament. ~!He changed his name from Mu-Bong Park to Mu-Jin Park 17 years before the story begins.!~

~!Hui Mo-Ri was the main protagonist of G.O.H season 4 and the first-half of season 5, and was also the clone created by Jin Mo-Ri to go to the Human Realm with his gourd. As time went on he would become less of Jin Mo-Ri's clone and discover his true self.!~

Saturn is a G.O.H. Priest of the Nox organization with a foul mouth. As soon as her mouth is opened, she starts cursing non-stop, though the reason is unknown. She is also short tempered as her cool and quiet image was shattered in the battle with Judge O.

description:
The worst calamity humankind has ever faced...

Shadow Realms have ravaged the earth and decimated almost everyone in their way. The survival of humanity hinges upon the success of just six mages, including analytic fighter Desir Herrman. The remaining heroes make one final stand to end the bloodshed...but to no avail. Desir closes his eyes on what should be the end of his life—only to open them and see the beginning of his school days?! Desir has returned thirteen years back to the past, where he’s been given another chance. A chance to see the loved ones he lost, a chance to meet his fellow warriors again, and a chance to save the world…!

(Source: Yen Press)

characters.description:
__Magic Circle Rank:__ Tier 3 (Analysis Magic)

Desir Herrman is the central protagonist of A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special. After his return to the past upon the failure of clearing the Shadow World, he resolves to strengthen his allies so that the future doesn’t get repeated. In Hebrion Academy, commoners are frowned upon and put into the Beta class whilst the nobles are designated the alpha class, Desir is one of the commoners who hates the class system and wants things to change. As a result he and his friends set out to close the gap by showing the teachers and aristocrats that commoners can have as much potential as the nobles if given the right circumstances.

alternative: アゼスト・キングスクラウン

characters.description:
__Circle Level Tier:__ 4 (Swordmage)

Azest Jedgar F. Roguepalace was the firstborn of Gilltian Jedgar F. Roguepalace, the current emperor of the Hebrion Empire and thus the heir to the Hebrion throne. Initially Azest was a cold person and she tends to be uninterested about other people unless they consist of her close friends in the Desir group.
~! Azest was one of the six survivors of the Shadow Labyrinth who defeated Brohmier Napolitan along with Desir Arman. She was the core figure of their attack force and their swordmage. She dealt the final blow to kill the boss of the shadow world. !~

__Circle Tier Level:__ 3 (Wind Mage)

When Desir Arman first meets Romantica after returning from the Shadow Labyrinth she exhibits a superiority complex due to her position as a noble which slowly decreases as the story progresses and she gets to know Desir Arman.

~! Later on in the it is discovered that Romantica is the illegitimate child of a baron and the only reason that she has the title of a noble is that her mother traded her life so that Romantica wouldn't have to live the impoverished "commoner's" life. As the story progresses Desir offers her a chance to join the beta class and because of her distaste of how the nobles treat the commoners and so accepted his offer along with Ajest and Pram !~

alternative: プラム・シュナイザー

characters.description:
__Circle Tier Level:__ 3 (Swordmage)

Pram is a member of Desir Arman's alpha party made of commoners.

~! Pram’s weapon of choice was a rapier made of Blankšum, left by his noble father (The super light rapier). The sword was originally in a rusted hilt and was sold to a pawn shop for little money. Later on, Desir Arman and Pram go back to take the sword back, and after a disagreement, Desir is forced to fight the merchant's bodyguard and take the sword back to its rightful owner !~

__Circle Tier Level:__ 7 (Sage)

Sage of Wisdom Zod Exarion is the Master of the Tower of Magic and the one and only Seventh-Circle magician in existence. He was known as the greatest mage in the world, the man who had singled-handily revived interest in magic. He also was one of the 100 people who fought against Bhromier Napolitan and one of the six who survived the battle.
Swan Katarina is one of the four Royal Guard of the Hebrion Empire. She is also the best archer in the empire.

description:
Kang Jin-Hyeok, a gaming streamer, and content creator is the only person who has cleared the game, [Tower of Trials]. However, as the game’s popularity declines, it becomes increasingly difficult for him to continue making a living as a content creator. Jinhyeok prepares to end his 11-year-long relationship with the game and say goodbye to his humble group of subscribers. But on that very day, the Tower of Trials appears in reality with a message saying that humanity will perish unless all players clear each floor within 90 days. Jin-Hyeok, who knows the game better than anyone, decides to use his knowledge to his advantage and dominate the tower. It’s time to show everyone what a hardcore gamer can do!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

description:
Nanotechnology meets martial arts at the Mashin Academy. Yeo-Un’s mother may not be one of the High Priest’s six official wives, but his father’s blood still qualifies him for a chance at the position of Minor Priest. Will a mysterious nanomachine injection from a future descendent help Yeo-un in this fierce competition against his powerful half-siblings?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
He was a member of the Cheon Family and was the son of a female servant who worked at the Lord’s chamber and was not from the Six Clans. Although considered as an illegitimate son of the Lord due to a servant mother, he was still part of the Cheon family and he had the right to the throne but had an extremely low chance without support.

He doesn't learn any martial arts in his early 15 years due to his oath with the Lord's wives from Six Clans. After entering the Demonic Academy, only then did he learn Martial Arts and have an unimaginable growth rate due to Nano Machine'a support.

Gyu Mun is the female protagonist of Nano Machine. She is the granddaughter of Yun Mun, one of the elders of the Demonic Cult. She is a part of Yeo-Woon Cheon's team during their stay in the Demonic Academy. ~!She is Yeo-Woon's future first wife.!~
She was one of the twelve expert martial artists from the Demonic Cult that were tasked to protect the Kirin blood.
The Right Guardian of the Demonic Cult. His nickname is Crazy Blade, due to his drunkard-like and unpredictable blade skills. He is the first Teacher Yeo-Woon Cheon had in his martial arts journey.

Mu-Hwa Yeon is the 2nd Council Elder of the Demonic Cult (Formerly 10th) as well as the only female elder aside from Soyu Hang. ~!Later, she was acknowledged as the true successor of the Sword Demon lineage.!~
She is the first female warrior who joined Yeo-Woon Cheon in the Demonic Academy and one of his Six Swords. She joined him because of his strength and his character as a leader.
Coming from the Gentle Kick Clan, he is one of the most trusted followers of Cheon Yeo-Woon.
She is the daughter of Wang Jeon, one of the Five Greatest Martial Artists.
He is Cheon Yeo-Un's first subordinate.

The Great Guardian of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult and Protector of the Heavenly Demon Order. He is famous across the Murim for his unparalleled speed and swift sword techniques that hundreds of masters have died to which earned him the title, the Dark King.
Ga-Gyeong Jang was the parental figure of Yeo-Woon Cheon's early life and served Lady Hwa until she died. He went to crown Yeo-Woon as the Lord of the Demonic Cult during his Coronation Ceremony.

He is from the upper sect of the Magic Sword Sect and is a master of martial arts. He is the first of the six swords.

~!In a relationship with Ho Sang-Hwa!~

Lady Hwa (Yeon Hwa) was Yeo-Woon Cheon's Mother and the Seventh wife of Cheon-Yu Jong. She was poisoned and died when Yeo-Woon was little. ~!Later on, it was revealed by Jong-Seom Cheon that the one who poisoned her was Lady Mu.!~

~!Blade God is the main antagonist. He is from a future timeline and is the originator of the Extreme Art of the Blade God in the current timeline. He is the founder of the Blade God Six Martial Clan.!~

Yu-Jong Cheon is the Lord of the Demonic Cult and the Father of Yeo-Woon Cheon. He was one of the Top Five Strongest Masters in the entire Murim and succeeded in the title 'Southern Demon Lord' after Inji Cheon.
Mu-Geum Cheon is the Spring Clan candidate for the throne.
He is the head of the Demonic Academy.
Mu-Yeon Cheon is the son of Lord Yu-Jong Cheon from the Dark Clan and had been deemed the most likely to succeed the throne during the start of Demonic Academy.
Gyeong-Un Cheon is the heir candidate from the Sword Clan and one of the Top 3 candidates that were most likely to succeed the throne.

Won-Ryeo Cheon was the Sound Clan candidate for the throne.
~!She was the first heir candidate to be eliminated.!~
Jong-Seom Cheon was the Poison Clan candidate for the throne.
~!Lady Baek is the one who asked the Poison Clan to poison Lady Hwa, Yeo-Woon's mother.!~
She is the head of the Sound Clan and the 5th Council Elder but was later demoted to the 11th Elder of the Demonic Cult.

title.english: The Legend of the Northern Blade

description:
For decades, the brave warriors of the Northern Heavenly Sect fought to keep the world safe from the evil Silent Night. But when the fourth generation leader is accused of colluding with the enemy, he is forced to disband the sect and commit suicide to protect his son, Moo-Won. With no family and allies left, Moo-Won leads a dreary life under close surveillance... until a surprise attack from the Silent Night gives him a chance to escape to the mountains. There, the young warrior trains to master the fighting techniques of his predecessors, before the mysterious disappearance of a loved one brings him back to the mainland. Follow Moo-Won as he embarks on a journey to avenge his father’s death and take down the villains who threaten to plunge the world into darkness!

(Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: The last descendant of the 4th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect, Kwan-Ho Jin. With his supposed death 10 years ago, he reappears as the 5th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect and given the title "The Northern Blade".

Eun Ha-Seol is a mysterious girl who came across Jin Mu-Won after being attacked by a unknown assailant. After recuperating from her injuries, she gradually began to open to Mu-Won while rebuilding her strength and took it upon herself to defend him when the Northern Heavenly Sect was under attack before being rescued by her master, the Witch of the White Night Seo Geum-Hyang.

Seo Mu-Sang is introduced as a member of the Third Mercenary Group dispatched by the Central Heavenly Alliance to keep guard over Jin Mu-Won and served as its Vice Captain and Second in command. He was also the chief strategist of the group.

alternative: Lone Star of the Cerulean Sky

characters.description: Dam Soo-Cheon, commonly known by his epithet Lone Star of the Cerulean Sky, is a martial master and the current family head of the Valley of No Return and a member of the Seven Lesser Heavens. He is the third son of Dam Jeok-Shim, a member of the Nine Skies. He, along with Seo-Moon Hye Ryung and Shim Won-Lee, created the Cerulean Dragon Society in order to allow young martial artists a great voice within the affairs of Murim.

Known as the 4th generation leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect, Jin Kwan-Ho was unrivaled under the heavens and known by the title "North Wall". After decades of successfully defending the mainlands from the Silent Night, he was ultimately betrayed by his most trusted comrades and The Nine Skies. After giving up his own life with the request to spare his son, Jin Kwan-Ho unknowingly paved a horrible and treacherous path for his son.

Hwang-Cheol is a former warrior of the Northern Heavenly Sect. Self defense is the extent of his martial arts, and as such, he was the weakest warrior in the sect. However, he is unmatched in his devotion and loyalty towards the sect. Even after the dissolution of the sect, he remained loyal to the sect, and by extension, loyal to Jin Mu-Won. After the dissolution of the Northern Heavenly Sect, he worked as a wandering merchant and would do his best to bring supplies for Jin during Jin's adolescent years in the ruined Northern Heavenly Sect, and also helped Jin with supplies during Jin's time, training in the Jeokam mountains..

~!Post timeskip, he is seen working as a merchant and bodyguard with the White Dragon Merchant Troupe.!~

Geum Dan-Yeop is a member of The Silent Night who was orphaned after the destruction of his home, alongside his sister Eun Ha-Seol. His aim is to resurrect the sleeping Silent Night and awaken it to rise up against the Central Heavenly Alliance by kidnapping merchants in the province of Unnam and force Jo Cheon-Woo and his Broken Fist Sect to attack in retaliation.
Leader of the Iron Brigade.

Former member of the legendary Great Four Of The Northern Heavens and known as Demon Fist. After he colluded with the Nine Skies and betrayed the Northern Heavenly Sect he established the Broken Fist Sect in the Province of Unnam.

Buk Jin-Hu was the 1st Generation Leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect as well the creator of it's legendary martial arts, the Gathering of Ten Thousand Shadows. He was a prominent martial master of his time. He was elected by the Central Heavenly Alliance as the leader of the Northern Heavenly Sect.
Bul-Yeong is a member of the Shaolin Temple and is a member of the Nine Skies, a group of powerful and untouchable martial masters who ruled over the world of murim.
Spear Dragon Lord Bi Sa-won is a member of the Nine Skies.
Dam Jin-Hong is a member of the wandering mercenary group, the Iron Brigade.
Chae Yak-Ran is the Vice-leader of the wandering mercenary group, the Iron Brigade.

Dam Jeok-Shim also known by his epithet, Awakened Nirvana is a martial master and member of the Nine Skies. He has three sons with three wives. Dam Jeok-Shim is a hedonist and doesn't really care for his sons. His son and successor despises him.
She is known for her intelligence.

Olly Wang used to go to the same cram school as Sally Park and Heather. He was a smart kid whose immigrant parents pushed him to extreme lengths to be a good student. His parents were so overbearing that he felt like he was driven to insanity.

Olly became obsessed with Eli Jang after witnessing him destroy Backdoor. He did anything to get Eli's attention, stealing from minors and even robbing his own house. description:
Ji-U is a kind-hearted young man who harnesses the lightning quick reflexes of a cat to secretly make the world a better place – one saved little child or foster pet at a time. Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a…um…decidedly fat old fluffy cat. Together, armed with Ji-U’s super powers and Kayden’s uber-smarts, they’re out to fight those forces who would let evil rule this world. That is, if they can stand each other long enough to get the job done.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: Kayden is a secret agent on the run, who finds himself stuck in the body of a fat old fluffy cat. The strongest unaffiliated person in the world, capable to crush even those trained by the groups, which had accumulated vast amounts of data in their systems over the years. He is teaching Jiwoo about the awakened world as his teacher and coach.

He is a very bright and kind person who will go out of his way to help the people around him. His main ability is super speed.

In the past, Ji-U had no friends because he was afraid that people would discover his powers and those they discovered would treat him like a freak. The first friend he made was a stray cat, which led to his adoration for cats today.

His mentor is Kayden Break, who started to live with him. He is friends with Ji-Seok Yu, U-In, and Su-Bin Lee.

Being the leader of Shinhwa, Ji-Yeong Yu's responsibility is to teach new awakened ability users the basics and provide the most basic levels of support as well as keep the awakened world hidden from the normal world.

She is a famous highly ranked awakened wind ability user, the most powerful awakened in South Korea and has a good reputation. She's the older sister of Ji-Seok Yu.

U-In was a student under Dr. Delein, and has no known last name that is currently revealed. He is an independent awakener with no affiliation. His ability is telekinesis. U-In becomes friends with Ji-U, Ji-Seok and Su-Bin.
She is the granddaughter of the Awakened Union leader. She is on par with Ji-Seok in terms of power, making her quite strong. She is friends with Ji-Seok, Ji-U, and U-In. Her ability is cryokinesis.

He is the younger brother of Ji-Yeong Yu, the CEO of Shinhwa Association.

He is one of the most powerful, if not the most powerful, awakened person in his age group in South Korea.  There are only a few teenage awakeners in Korea that are able to rival him. Like his sister, his awakened power is aerokinesis.

He is friends with U-In, Ji-U Seo and eventually Su-Bin Lee.

She is the student representative of Mir, an organization made up of awakeners that specialize in controlling animals. Her ability is also animal control.

I-Seul has a white pet dog that is very big and loves hugs. His name is Duri.
He is known to be in the top 20 in the ranks of awakened people in Korea, however, his rank is unknown. He is often seen with Ji-Yeong as they assist matters of Shinhwa together.

Seong-Ha Park’s past has not yet been revealed, however he is a strong awakener as he is considered to be in the top 20 ranks of powerful awakeners in Korea. He is part of the Awakened Union and has close ties to the leadership of the group as shown by how highly Su-Bin Lee regards him.

She is a friend of Jae-Hyeok Lee and one of the awakeners that the Shinhwa Association sent to the Awakened Academy. She does show a very cheerful persona, although it seems like she is cunning and sly. Not much is known about her abilities and fighting prowess, but it can be assumed that she is roughly at the same level as Jae-Hyeok as she was chosen by the Shinhwa Association to participate in the Awakened Academy. It can also be assumed that her ability is Aerokinesis like the rest of the members of Shinhwa.

description:
Yeonwoo’s brother disappeared years ago, and he’s devastated to learn of his death. As he copes with his loss, he’s given a pocket watch and learns there’s more to his brother’s death: he was betrayed while competing in the Tower of the Sun God. Now it’s Yeonwoo’s turn to use the knowledge his brother left behind. Can Yeonwoo (call sign: Cain) navigate that world and gain enough power and experience to reach the top of the tower, defeating his brother’s enemies and all those who stand in his way?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description:
__Height:__ 182 cm

Yeon-woo is the main protagonist of the Korean web Novel, Second Life Ranker. Prior to entering the tower, he served in the army and later on went to take on the revenge for his younger twin brother. Yeon-woo later reawakened as a 'Dragon Human' becoming a 'player' after receiving the powers from the pocket watch of [Jeon-woo](https://anilist.co/character/165469/JeongWoo-Cha). He continues to climb the tower taking revenge on those who betrayed his brother and killed him.

He is a hard-working and determined person who greatly cherishes his family. Yeon-Woo was different from his younger brother who did everything effortlessly. He often had to try over and over again to solve a problem, but he tried not to show the efforts he made, pretending he was doing fine. Unlike his younger brother who could be categorized as a natural genius, all his achievements all came from being a hard worker through which he was able to achieve results that are reflective of his effort.

However, despite his rather advanced intellect and tactical genius, Yeon-Woo does indeed possess a childish side, where he was noted to possess a very bad sense of imagination when naming things and has a tendency of naming things with names usually though up by toddlers.

This is seen where he named the newborn Phoenix, "Chirpy" and when he obtained his Magical Dragon, he attempted to name it "Growl" and "Roar". Although initially thought to be him being insulting and condescending, it was later revealed that Yeoon genuinely did like those names despite their obvious childishness. This trait itself is seemingly shared with his niece, Sesha.

Later after finding out about his niece, Sesha and his face being revealed to Brahm, Galliard, Phante and Edora, Yeon was noted to have begun becoming considerably warmer and less cynical due to finally opening up to others. Unlike before where he regarded them with a level of paranoia due to his brother's story, he has now begun to truly trust them.

(Source: Second Life Ranking wiki)

Edora is a member of the One Horn Tribe royal family. She is the daughter of the Martial King and the younger sister of [Phante](https://anilist.co/character/192568/Phante).

Unlike her brother, Edora is calm and collected. She speaks politely and does not like to waste her time with anything unnecessary. In essence, she is cold towards most people. However, after meeting [Cain](https://anilist.co/character/140547/YeonWoo-Cha), she developed romantic feelings for him; she began to blush and feel embarrassed when someone refers to both of them having a relationship.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

Jeong-woo Cha is Yeon-woo Cha's younger twin brother. He was one of the strongest and the most famous high-ranker in the Tower before he was betrayed by his teammates leading to the events of the main story.

Jeong-woo was described by Yeon-woo as being a weak and introverted person who liked books, movies, and had a talent of not needing much work to succeed in most things. Furthermore, he also greatly valued his family, even leaving home in order to find a cure for his mother.

(Source: Second Life Ranking wiki)

Nayu is the king of the One-Horned Tribe. He is commonly referred to as the Martial King and is one of the strongest people in the Tower. He is the only one among the Nine Kings that is capable of rivaling Summer Queen in individual might.

He is shown to possess a very care-free, mischievous and whimsical personality. Having become well known for being highly unpredictable in his actions by both his own Tribe's men and the other Rankers of the Tower. However despite his usually jovial disposition, Nayu has also shown the same immense blood-thirst, murderous intent and battle crazed craving as the rest of the One-Horned Tribe, a side of himself that he usually reveals in front of his enemies and his tribe's men in order to terrify or keep them in line.

Nayu as the Martial King was also shown to be highly intelligent and cunning when dealing with matters regarding the tribe's future, having been shown to be pragmatic and heartless enough to do the most dirties deeds in order to insure the tribe's prosperity and peace.

However despite these traits, Nayu was shown to also have a very fatherly side to himself, as seen where he greatly enjoyed dotting and teasing his daughter Edora on her having successfully located a suitable marriage partner and was noted to be highly protective of her. Nayu was also shown to have a positive, but hard relationship with his son, Phante, having been known to constantly train him to increase his strength and was known to mercilessly beat him during training to increase his battle prowess. He however did show to have a kind side with him, as seen where he also enjoyed teasing his son similarly to his daughter. However despite him caring for his children, Nayu was also shown to have no hesitance in intimidating them and scaring them when they begin getting out of line, as seen with how he handled his son, Jang.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

Phante is a prince of the One-Horned Tribe and the one most likely to become the next King. He hails from the Cheonglam family with his mother being the tribe's current Psychic Medium.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

~!Sesha is the biological daughter of Cha Jeong-woo and Viera Dune, who had her in secret from her father to experiment and take advantage of her qualities as a quarter breed dragonborn. However, she was saved by Ananta and adopted by her and left in the care of Ananta's father, Brahm to protect her from her mother and her clan.!~

Yul is a player that formerly climbed the Tower.

He is a determined boy. Although he is prone to cowering when bullied (like any boy his age), he is able to stand up for himself when he gets pushed too far.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

Doyle is one of the super rookies of the Tower. He was ranked 11th on the Tutorial's rankings before Yeon-woo Cha began his tutorial.

He is an extremely lazy young man such that he doesn't care about much outside of sleeping. He is also a clever guy but, due to his young age, he is still immature regarding certain matters.
Yvlke is the Floor Guardian of the Floor 0, in other words the floor guardian of the tutorial. However, he also holds a special position as one of the leaders of all the Floor Guardians.

Leonte was a high-ranker of Cheonghwado. He was dubbed the Fist God and was one of the clan's five leaders.

Previously, he was a high-ranker and executive of Arthia, however, he defected to Cheonghwado when he realized that Arthia was bound to be destroyed, eventually. He was one of the five people that directly killed Cha Jeong-woo.

(Source: Second Life Ranker wiki)

Kim Rok-Su has one life motto: “Let’s not get beat up.” But after dozing off somewhere midway through the novel “Birth of a Hero,” he wakes up as Cale Henituse - one of the minor villains in the novel who gets the beating of a lifetime from soon-to-be hero Choi Han. Only time will tell how much longer he has before that dreadful encounter. Can Kim Rok-Su change the course of this story so he can enjoy a long and lavish life free of the soon-to-be hero?

__Occupation:__
