__Affiliations:__ Henituse Family, Roan Kingdom

 Cale‘s original personality was that of a spoiled brat. His mother died when he was very young and his father remarried and created a family he didn't like. He used to be a 'good boy', but he began acting 'trash'-y at the tender age of 8 and started drinking when he was 15. Though he liked to cause trouble, he still afforded respect to his family and the few people whom he saw worthy enough to be treated like human beings (such as his butler Ron). Cale never forced himself upon women and defended women as well, although he originally loved to drink every night until dawn. He also never beat up innocent people, only throwing (and always missing) his alcohol bottles at gangsters while drunk.

The current Cale is just as lazy as the old Cale and wishes to live his life as the “trash” of the count's family in comfort. He has others do many things for him so that he does not have to get involved with the storyline, but somehow, he always gets involved in one way or another. He is still a very kind and gentle person to those he is close to and can be worldly-wise and generous. Sometimes he can give advice, motivate, or comfort people with his words without realizing it. He claims to dislike getting personally involved in fights, as he prefers to surround himself with strong individuals. He thinks even paper cuts hurt, let alone actual sword-fighting. In conflicts, he always seeks to keep casualties to a minimum.

Cale is the type of person who would take responsibility in order to not have to take responsibility. He also often is unable to directly speak his true feelings of care and concern for the people he cares about but when asked about it, he would be unable to deny it. Cale doesn't realize that his actions in pursuit of his dream of a slacker life are equivalent to making the world a better place. He will also never admit to feeling sorrow or pain and would blame all his feelings on the failure to become a slacker.

A 6 year old black dragon (he was 4 years old at the beginning of the story) who started following Cale after he was saved by him from Venion Sten. He was imprisioned and tortured by Venion for the span of four years.

Cale gave the Dragon the name Raon Miru, pure Korean for "Joyful Dragon" after the black dragon asked him to do so.

He possesses destructive impulses but looks out for his newfound family.

Raon would give tear-soaked apple pie slices to Cale whenever Cale overused his powers or got hurt.

__Occupation:__ Swordmaster, ~!Dragon Slayer!~
__Abilities:__ ~!Black Yong, Ancient Powers, Sword of Disasters, Dominating Aura, Abandoning Life!~
Alver Crossman is the Crown Prince of the Rowoon Kingdom and the eldest son of Zed Crossman.
Member of the Cat Tribe and On's brother. He was taken out of the streets by Cale Henituse.
Member of the Cat Tribe and Hong's sister. She was taken out of the streets by Cale Henituse.
A former assassin and the father of Vicross, Ron is currently the butler of Cale Henituse.
Former Crown Princess of the Breck Kingdom and an ally to Cale. She gave up her claim to the throne to pursue her aspirations of becoming a mage. Her goal is to become the master of the Magic Tower.
The youngest child of the Whale King Shickler, Paseton is not a pure blooded Whale and struggles living in the ocean. He's the only mixed blood in the Whale Tribe.

The eldest son of the Sten family.

He was originally the heir of the House of Sten, but was forced out after his legs became paralyzed due to having both his knees destroyed.
The priestess of the God of Death and Taylor Sten’s close friend. Much to her displeasure, she is favored by the God of Death. A master of mental torture and curses.
Member of the Blue Wolf Tribe.

Hans is the deputy butler of the Henituse family and is assigned to Cale.
He likes cute things and animals - like On, Hong, and Raon.
He's noted to be very, very good at doing his job, but he can be quite dramatic, especially when praising Cale.

Leader of the rebellion against the Whipper Kingdom's mages.

He later became the Commander-in-Chief of the Whipper Kingdom.

Tunka is very loud and arrogant; he never backs down from a fight. However, he can be quite serious and sincere, which is in contrast to his usually arrogant, idiotic personality.

At first, he is depicted as a maniac that loves fighting strong people and has no respect for the weak. Over time, due to Cale's actions, Tunka changes his mindset and begins to use his head more, gaining respect for weaker people.
The son and heir of Count Whilsman. Eric and the original Cale Henituse were close.
The youngest child of Deruth Henituse, and Cale's half-sister. While they didn't initially have much of a relationship, Cale and Lilly grow closer.
Amir Ubar is the daughter of Viscountess Ubar and her successor, who eventually takes over as the matriarch of the Ubar family.

The bastard son of the Flynn Merchant Guild's guild leader.

He is very talented as a merchant, and so the official children of the family hate him. He moved to the Henituse territory as it was remote, and wasn't allowed to use the Flynn family name.

The step-mother of Cale, mother of Lily and Basen, and second wife of Count Deruth.
She is also the director for the Henituse territory's cultural business operations.
Violan doesn't appear to care about Cale at all as they spend most of their time ignoring each other, prior to Cale's transmigration. But after Cale talks to Violan more, she demonstrates that she does think Cale as a son and cares for him as a mother.
A mage in the employ of Darkness, obsessed with blood and the color red. He took part in the attack on the Wolf Tribe and was in charge of the terrorist attack on the Roan Kingdom.
[Bilose](https://anilist.co/character/275926/)'s uncle. While he seems like a normal merchant, he is actually in control of the Northwestern and Central regions' underworld.
Venion Sten is the second son of Marquis Sten and the one responsible for the torture of Raon Miru during his captivity.
The father of Cale, Bassen and Lilly and leader of the Henituse territory. He cares very much about his territory and the safety of his family, and believes in the Henituse family motto.

alternative: The Sun of the Roan Kingdom

characters.description: King of the Rowoon Kingdom

A lackey of Venion Sten and the successor to Viscount Tolls.
The village near the cave where Raon had been tortured was part of his family's territory.

description:
You’ve got the raw talent. Or you’re the underdog. But do you have the heart? Do you have what it takes? Let’s see what you’re made of. The real fight starts now!

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
Yu is the main character of The Boxer. He becomes a professional boxer under the tutelage of the legendary [K](https://anilist.co/character/208937/K).

Yu has a very dark and melancholic appearance, with unstyled jet-black hair that drapes down loosely on his head, distinctively coal-black eyes with even darker pupils and a wholly disinterested facial expression painted on his face with an equally 'dead' look in his eyes. He has a very skinny body which belies his deceptively athletic abilities.

Yu has a startlingly emotionless and disinterested persona, taking little to no interest in anything other than his pet cat. He is shown to be alarmingly apathetic, simply taking hits because he couldn't be bothered to dodge them and giving zero response when threatened by an obviously vicious person.
K is one the supporting characters in The Boxer. He is a legendary boxing trainer, having raised 5 boxing world champions. He is currently training Yu.

Yuto is known as a positive person, always looking at the bright side. He's very motivated and doesn't give up despite all the obstacles he had faced. He's motivating not only himself but also those around him, helping them at the same time.
Jean-Pierre Manuel (쟝 삐에르 마뉘엘, Jyang Ppieleu Manwiel) is a professional boxer and the former boxing lightweight world champion.
She was hired as Yu's bodyguard before his fight with Santorino, she is also K's assistant.
Aaron Tide is the Heavy Weight World Champion. He was trained under Coach K but currently fights under a different gym.
Santorino Fabrizo bears the title of Middle Weight Champion. He is famous for using tricky moves and cheats.
Viktor Grigoryevich is the current Cruiser Weight World Champion.
Marco Santorino is [Fabrizio Santorino](https://anilist.co/character/209083/)'s older brother as well as coach. He is known for his dirty fighting tactics.
Misaki (미사키, Misaki) is the boxing coach of current light welterweight world champion Takeda Yuto.

John puts on a decidedly confident and somewhat cocky air in public, with a great enjoyment in taking down talented young boxers with promising careers. To this end, he believes that bending the rules is more than okay if it leads to winning in the end.[1] He looks up to the middleweight champion boxer, Santorino Fabrizo, calling the man a true warrior on another level and saying he deserves more respect from people.
Previous Cruiserweight World Champion before Viktor Grigorievich.

Kasim is a swaggering, spoilt, and arrogant man with an extravagant showboating personality in and out of the ring, bringing about controversy and polarization in the Boxing world by merely participating. At any recourse, Kasim's first course of action is to try to throw money at the problem, paying people to spar with him and proposing to simply buy out the Boxing organization he competed in to change the rules to allow for illegal moves he performed out of ignorance.

Josh (조시, Josi) was once a member of the Lions Boxing Club with dreams of becoming a professional boxer. However, after being annihilated by Yu, Josh gave up on his dream and currently works as a bartender.

Siha Lee is a character in The Boxer universe. He was a boxing prodigy who was able to become one of the best boxers in Korea across all weight classes, being undefeated for 9 matches straight, with many top-ranking boxers unable to do anything against him, all of them suffering a crushing defeat by his hands. He was praised for his ability to memorize attack patterns, rhythms, timing, and everything about his opponents in a single round, using it all against them in the second round.

synonyms: หลังวันสิ้นโลก
description:
Faced with imminent defeat and certain death, would you choose to run – or continue to fight for a doomed world? When mysterious towers appear across the world, summoning monsters that prey on mankind, this is the choice presented to the Tower Walkers – adventurers with special powers to fight the monsters. On the brink of death, they can choose to use a “regression stone” to return to the past for a second chance, though this decision places them in a separate timeline forever. Stubborn Tower Walker Jae-Hwan rejects this choice, choosing to fight for the original timeline, and learning shocking secrets about the Tower along the way.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: Jaehwan is a young, South Korean male who was summoned to the Tower of Nightmares, a large construct consisting of 100 floors brimming with perilous monsters. Jaehwan's sole mission is climbing the Tower and saving humanity, which suffers from "Tower Impacts".

__Ocupation__: Assassin
__Place of Birth__: Arkal, known as World 7651
~!__Place of death__: Tower of Nightmares (former), New World!~

Han Mino is a young woman who cleared a Tower of Nightmares
She is a 3rd Stage Adapter and works as an assassin for the Dark Forest Clan.

~!Died in Great Lands and entered Chaos.!~

He is the doctor of the Gorgon Fortress. He is an awakened like Jaehwan. He is able to perform the "Undead Slash" which cures the spirit of those who are becoming Undead. He was part of the first Abyss expedition lead by Mulack Armelt

__Place of Birth:__ Roots of the Tree of Imagery, Six Region

Siren is a pink-haired Nightmare (Dream Demon) known as the most popular streamer in Chaos. She works as a tower maker and was the apprentice of Mulack Armelt

synonyms: Revenge of the Iron-Blooded Sword Hound
Revenge of the Sword Clan's Hound
Die Rückkehr des Jagdhundes aus Eisen und Blut
description:
Raised to kill like a pack of loyal hounds, the Baskerville children took countless lives as a band of fearsome assassins. Despite being the shunned illegitimate son of the brood, Vikir served his family faithfully, only to meet his untimely demise at his father’s hands. But when he is inexplicably reborn with a second chance at life, Vikir, armed with the memories and knowledge of his past, swears to rise above the pack and take his revenge. This time, he's ready to bite the hand that feeds.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The Hound of the Baskerville Clan who regressed after being cut down by the blade of the guillotine.
She first met [Vikir](https://anilist.co/character/309777) when he saved her from being sold as a slave in the auction.
She was known as a Morgue Clan's Steel-Blooded Empress before [Bikir](https://anilist.co/character/309777)'s regression.
Chieftain of Ballack and mother of [Aiyen](https://anilist.co/character/309778). She is the person who gave Hugo a big scar on the bridge of his nose.
She's a saintess who is a living embodiment of goodness.
He is the Patriarch of the Baskerville family and the father of [Bikir van Baskerville](https://anilist.co/character/309777).
He is the office manager in Underdog City in the territory of Baskerville.

synonyms: Return of The Mount Hua Sect
Return of the Flowery Mountain Sect
หวนคืนสู่ฮวาซาน
description:
When Cheong-Myeong of the Mount Hua Sect awakens a hundred years in the future, his last memories are of a bloody battle against the Leader of the Demonic Cult, the evil Cheon-Ma. The battle almost saw the end of the Ten Great Sects of ancient China, when Cheong-Myeong ended the hard-fought struggle by striking down Cheon-Ma. Soon after, he succumbed to his wounds, filled with regret at their pyrrhic victory. All is not lost, however, as he awakens to his second chance at life. Shocked to find his beloved Mount Hua Sect reduced to a mere shadow of itself in the present day, Cheong-Myeong embarks on a journey to restore Mount Hua to its former glory.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: Cheong-Myeong usually has a carefree nature and enjoys fooling around. However, when he has a goal, he sets his mind to it. Cheong-Myeong is intelligent, but often uses that to his advantage (but sometimes end up offending others). He enjoys drinking and indulges himself with food. Cheong-Myeong is sadistic and likes playing around with his seniors. He has confidence and doesn't waver in every situation and knows when he should retreat or run away.

__Height:__ 5'9

Jo Gul is a 3rd class disciple of the Mount Hua Sect. He's the second son of a merchant family.
Hyun Young is the youngest of the three sages, and an elder of the Mount Hua Sect. He is the general manager of the Finance Office, and is involved in all matters of finance and economy.
Hyun Jong is the current sect leader of the Mount Hua Sect.

__Height:__ 6'2

Lee Songbaek is a 2nd-class disciple of the Zhongnan Sect. He was the first disciple from an opposing sect to recognize the true strength of Cheongmyeong.
Jin Geumryong is a second class disciple of the Zhongnan Sect and Baek Cheon's brother. He is the strongest and most prospective talent within the Zhongnan Sect.
Chun Ma, also known as the Heavenly Demon, is the leader of the Demonic Cult.
Cheongmun, the Daxian Sword, is the 21st sect leader of the Mount Hua Sect.
Yu Iseol's father was formerly a member of the Mount Hua Sect and a disciple who tried to recreate the lost 24-Movement Plum Blossom Sword Technique.
Jong Seohan is a 2nd-class disciple of the Zhongnan Sect. He is deemed the second strongest out of the 2nd-class disciples of the sect.
Hyun Sang is the second sage and an elder of the Mount Hua Sect. He is in charge of managing the sect's martial arts curriculum.
Jin Hyeon, also known as the Indestructible Sword of the Wudang Sect, or the Sword Dragon. He is a likely candidate to become the First Sword of Wudang.
Jongsan Yu is the owner of the Huayin Linen Shop, a business that originally was owned by the Mount Hua Sect.
Unam is a 1st ranked disciple of the Mount Hua Sect.
Jin Mu, also known as the Sword Dragon of Wudang, is a disciple of the Wudang Sect.
Un Gum is a 1st ranked disciple of the Mount Hua Sect. He is the monitor of the White Plum Blossom Hall and trainer of the third class disciples.
Taiji Sword Emperor was a member of Wudang Sect 100 years ago and lost against Cheongmyeong.
Hwang Jongui is the vice president of Eunha Trading Company.
Hong Dae-Kwang is the head of the Beggars' Union branch in Luoyang.
Sama Seung is an elder of the Zhongnan Sect.
Munyeon Gong is the proprietor of the Taehwa Pavilion, the largest tavern in Huayin, and is a powerful merchant who runs many businesses from the tavern.
Heo Do Jinin is the current sect leader of the Wudang Sect.
Hwi Go is a second class disciple of the Zhongnan Sect. Alongside Lee Songbaek, he was tasked with gaining the cooperation of the Eunha Merchant Guild.
Mu Jin, also known as the Clear Flowing Sword, is one of the three swords of Wudang, a disciple of the 22nd generation of the Wudang Sect.
Ki Mokseung is an elder of the Zhongnan Sect.

synonyms: ปั่นสู้ฝัน Wind Breaker
description:
Jay's the perfect student. He's got straight As and he's the student body president. But after being coerced into joining the school's biking team, the Hummingbird Crew, he discovers a whole new world outside of studying. What new adventures will he face outside the comfort of his textbooks?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Notes:

- Includes two extra chapters.

- The work was cancelled after it was discovered that the artist had been tracing other people's art.

characters.description:
__Place of Birth:__ Incheon, South Korea
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew
__Height:__ 178cm

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/ja_hyuni/)

Ja-Hyeon is a member and ace of the Hummingbird Crew and a junior at Sunny High School.

He usually assumes a serious and emotionless expression. He appears cold hearted, but very much so cares about the friends he has and his little brother. His minimal expression of emotion doesn't allow him to articulate his feelings very well, but sometimes his few words mean a lot.

Ja-Hyeon is a well rounded cyclist. Throughout the competition, he is acknowledged as the ace of the crew. He is able to play as a defensive rider, supporting his crew during their races, as well as a offensive rider. Vinny noted that he enjoyed the "hunt" of attacking from the back.

His debut in the League of Street preliminaries helped him gain popularity in the biking scene in Korea and at his school.

~!Vinny Hong is a student at Gunn High and the current leader of the Sabbath Crew.He was previously a member of the Zephyrus Crew along with Minu and June, the Hummingbird Crew, and the Ghost Crew..!~

He cares deeply about his mom and does not tolerate anyone who disrespects his mother, not even her self-deprecation.
His childhood sweetness does make an appearance once in a while. He displays a great deal of empathy, even while displaying it through hardened words.

Yu-Bin has a condition called Waardenburg syndrome which caused the color of his left eye and hair.

One of the few things Vinny is proficient at in cooking is Ramen. He often cooks a pot for his friends voluntarily and involuntarily.

__Height:__ 163 cm
__Place of birth:__ Manchester, England
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/shelly_______x/)

Shelly has a crush on [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/Jo-JaHyeon). She is the only female member of the Humming Bird Crew.

Because she stayed at England before coming to Korea her personality is perceived as very headstrong. She does not like it when people talk badly about her friends, especially Jay. Described as someone who can confidently express her thoughts and feelings. Although her words are harsh, it is because she never sugar coated her words with her friends. And with Jay, Shelly is very clingy and flirtatious.

__Height:__ 188 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/hannam_x_jordan/)

Dom is a Junior at Sunny High School. He is the son of a gang leader. He is interested in making music in the future and works part-time as a DJ at his father's club, WD Club. He is quite the sneakerhead and spends his money on his collection.
Dom is caring towards his friends and others and does his best to get involved.

Dom is very good at sprinting and riding on straight distances. He is also good at hand-to-hand combat and wrestling

__Height:__ 180 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

Minu is quite a simple and good guy. He is loyal to his words and his friends and seems to be a rather pure guy. When people provoke him he most likely falls for it since he is very emotional and impulsive. Furthermore he is really tough and can endure some pain. He is quick to anger when someone he cherishes is threatened.

~!He gets run over by a car from a member of Team Scorpion while trying to protect [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/Jo-JaHyeon). He remains crippled in a wheelchair from this accident.!~
Leader of Team Tarantula.

__Height:__ 168cm
__Affiliation:__ Light Cavalry Crew

Noah is seen as arrogant, and dislikes losing as seen when she lost a race against Jay Jo which led her to stalk him to his home and school, wanting to have a rematch with him using her personal bike and equipment.

__Affiliation:__ Kazuma Crew

Kaneshiro Takeda is 3-time international Grand Prix champion and leader of the Kazuma Crew.

She has a strong character, she does not show expressions other than a deep coldness in her eyes, she can look upset even with a face of disgust at things she does not like, but it is rare to see her smile or show compassion, she lets herself be guided by her instincts, both with known and unknown people, his personality does not change much, her way of treating people is very discreet.

__Height:__ 201 cm
__Affiliation__: Sabbath Crew

He's the undefeated champion in the underground cage fights scene. He seems to be doing it for the money to take care of his family. It is unknown how many siblings he has or if their parents are around but we know he has at least one younger brother, who went behind Joker's back to work at a construction site. He is protective over them, not wanting them to work, assumably in order for them to focus on getting their education.

He's mostly shown working closely with Wooin and are often seen together. It is assumed that they are good friends.

__Height:__ 193 cm
__Place of birth:__ Manchester, England
__Affiliation:__ Light Cavalry Crew

Owen Knight is the creator and member of Light Cavalry cyclist team. He joined Sunny High to stay closer with his childhood friend [Shelly](https://anilist.co/character/140299/Shelly) and fend off her feelings for [Jay](https://anilist.co/character/137282/JaHyeon-Jo).

Owen Knight is said to be close to the crews who spread street riding culture In New York. He was said to have followed them around and became friends with their members and cycled together. Then, in his freshman year of high school, he went back to England and formed a world-famous crew with his athlete friends called Light Cavalry.

__Height:__ 180 cm
__Affiliation:__ Humming Bird Crew

June is one of the more level-headed members of the Humming Bird Crew. He is generally polite and kind, and does not fight as much as the others. However, he will always support his friends.
He sometimes feels as if he is useless, especially when he couldn't lead the team. He feels like a deadweight to the crew, not able to contribute to the success of the team, but he works just as hard as everyone else during training to be more useful to the team.

Works at Sunny High as a gym teacher.

~!Later on it is revealed that he is Ricardo Rossi, former pro cyclist.!~

__Place of Birth__: Dong-gu, South Korea
__Affiliation__: Sabbath Crew

U-In is a member of the Sabbath Crew and is currently under the employment of Sang-Ho. He, along with the rest of his crew, aim to sabotage Team Hummingbird's chances of progressing through the League of Street Competition.

__Height:__ 205 cm
__Place of birth:__ Jung-gu-, Seoul
__Affiliation:__ Monster Crew

Monster, is one of the favourites in the "League of Street" competition. He is the leader of Monster Crew. His team is expected to win the competition due to their raw power and speed.

He is an honest and fair cyclist who is dedicated to the sport. It is seen and mentioned that he works out all the time apart from sleeping and eating, he is addicted to working out and becoming a better version of himself. And he's seen sleeping in classes and only bringing workout tools in his backpack, he uses every opportunity to work out even when his teacher calls him out to the back he would use the chance to do squats while the classes continue.

__Height:__ 183 cm
__Affiliation:__ Sabbath Crew

He is a quiet individual who seems to be quite inquisitive but also very mysterious. He has a part time job outside of his crew and although he seems to have a good friendship with Joker and Wooin, he doesn't like to spend too much time with them . He always leaves immediately after each race, this is known after Wooin mentions it.

In races, he is pretty brutal and ruthless. He is known as the Grim Reaper and is known to take down anyone who rides too close to him.

Currently a junior at Sunny High.

~!She is in love with Jay and has even thought of marrying him.!~

__Place of Birth:__ Dasan-dong, Seoul, South Korea
__Height:__ 162 cm

 She is a student at Sunny High and is s the headstrong twin sister of [Minu](https://anilist.co/character/140298/MinU-Yoon).
Between the siblings, Yuna gets along more with their father and step-mother. An incident from the past has yet to be revealed has caused great strain on their family. Yuna cares a lot for her brother though she is clearly tired from the constant arguments

Yuna is bored with her current life, having expected more romance and drama instead of the humdrum life of a high school student and she complains about it in the beginning. To her friends, she is a very dependable person.

__Height:__ 187 cm

He is one of the organizers of League of Street, previously a cyclist and Mahon's teammate.

Sangho is cunning and only thinks of money and work, he also seems to hold a good grudge with Mahon. He wants Jay Jo to feel the humilation of being runner up like he did to Mahon.

synonyms: PICK ME UP～低レア★英雄の成り上がり～
description:
1-Star heroes are just fodder for learning a boss' attack patterns. That was Seojin Han's philosophy when playing the notoriously difficult game Pick Me Up. But after being transported into the game as one of those 1-star heroes, he's got no choice but to rise in rank and defeat the player controlling him and his party. Can a gacha game character hope to defeat a player akin to being his god?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: He was a master of the game 'Pick Me Up' who went by the nickname of Loki and was ranked 5th in it. One day, he gets brought into the world of Taoneer as Han Yslat, a 1-star playable character.
1-star hero, who was summoned at the same time as [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546). She learned archery from her father, who was a hunter.
She is a fire magician from a noble family.
The King's Eye. She is from Niflheimr where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.
A 3-star hero, she was a member of the Maned Wolf Party.
She has many names, but the one she gave to [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was Tel.
Administrator of Taoneer. She is a fan of Loki.
A 1-star hero, he was summoned up in the 3rd cycle of the draft.
The King's Sword. He is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.
The King's Flame and Niflheim's only 4-star hero. She is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.
The King's Bow. She is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.
A 2-star hero who is gifted, belligerent, fearless, and highly talented.
The King's Spear. He is from the Niflheim, where [Han](https://anilist.co/character/298546) was the Master.
A 4-star hero, she was a knight before the draft.
A 2-star hero who is cool-headed and composed. She is especially skilled in special actions like stealth, infiltration, and intel collection.
A 2-star hero, he worked as a mercenary before conscription.

synonyms: The Youngest Son of a Master Swordsman
Youngest Son of the Renowned Swordsmanship Clan
description:
Jin Runcandel was destined to become the head of his swordmaster clan. But despite his best efforts, he's banished for his shoddy swordsmanship. Though Jin eventually makes a contract with the god Solderet and is freed from the curse that hindered his abilities, he meets a rather unfortunate end. In the next moment, however, he awakens as a baby, long before his tragedy began. Armed with a second chance and some new powers, Jin swears to fulfill his destiny and become the ultimate swordmaster.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The youngest son of Runcandel family.

She's the 1st flagbearer of Runcandel also known as the White Whale. Despite being the strongest of all the Runcandel siblings, she has no interest in becoming the patriarch and has stepped away from the "Succession War".
Jin's father and the current head of Runcandel. He is the only true knight of the present age, the strongest knight, and the undisputed strongest human
The sixth daughter of Chiron Runcandel. She currently resides with the Nameless Assassin group.
Murakan's older sister.
She is the lady of the Runcandel family..
The youngest son of Kelliak Zipple and a powerful next-generation head of the family.
The eldest son of Chiron Runcandel and  the 2nd flagbearer of the Runcandel. He was the most likely candidate for the next family head after Luna's announcement of relinquishing her position.
Originally witch Heluram's pet cat. Later made a pact with Jin, becoming Jin's cat.
Jin's magic mentor in his previous life. She is the sole survivor of the Heaster family, which was annihilated by Zipple.
The Silver Dragon of Time.The guardian dragon of the Olta Contractor. She and Murakan were lovers for approximately 500 years, 1000 years ago.

Jin Runcandel's nanny. In the past, she was a 7-star knight-level, boasting exceptional potential and skill enough to be called the next First Sword of the McLauran family. She cared for Jin more than anyone else, both in her past life and in her current one.

Heir to the Hairan family. Along with Veradin Zipple, he is the only friend of Jin Runcandel. Dante rivals Jin in terms of swordsmanship. He possesses exceptional swordsmanship thanks to his family's abilities and innate talent.
She's the adopted daughter of the Holy King of Bankela.
Az Mil's contractor. Casimir's daughter.
Supreme Commander of the Holy Knights.
Water dragon. One of the guardian dragons of Veradin Zipple.
Earth Dragon. One of the guardian dragons of Veradin Zipple.
Chiron Runcandel's fourth son and the 6th flagbearer of Runcandel.
Chiron Runcandel's third daughter and the 7th flagbearer of Runcandel.
The only daughter of Talaris Endorma.
Former Vice-Captain of the 2nd Division of the Viment Special Forces and wife of the demon sword Casimir. Currently, she serves as the captain of the defense of the free city of Tikan.

The leader of the Free City of Tikan and the intelligence organization Seven-Colored Bird. He was a prince of the Viment Empire, but was expelled from the imperial court. Since then, he has been known to the world as a warrior of immense skill, nicknamed the Demon Sword.

description:
This game’s got me obsessed! It’s like it’s taken over my life... wait—HARD MODE ACTIVATED. No-no-no-no-no! It has literally taken me and thrown me into the part of Penelope Eckhart. Love is easy as the heroine, but as the hated villainess, I’m trying very hard not to die… at the hands of my brothers… the prince… a fork… every possible ending is death! This world is stacked against me, but can my wits and insider game knowledge score the affection of these male characters? Or the reset button???

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description:
Penelope is the adoptive daughter of the Eckhart family.

The protagonist, Siyeon Cha, transmigrates into Penelope's body after struggling with the Hard Mode of the game Daughter of the Duke - Love Project! and falling asleep. After years of abuse, the protagonist has become a cold-hearted and independent person. She can also be very sarcastic.

__Height:__ 188cm

The crown prince of the Empire of Eorka, Callisto Regulus is a cruel tyrant who treats humans like dirt. It is hinted that there may be an ill-fated reason for his disposition.
__Height:__ 185cm

Ivonne Eckhart is the true, biological daughter of Duke Eckhart, and younger sister of Derrick Eckhart and Reynold Eckhart. She is the heroine of the otome game Daughter of the Duke - Love Project! in Normal Mode.
~!After being possessed by the goddess, she is the main antagonist of the series.!~

synonyms: Reincarnation of the Suicidal Battle God
Doom Breaker: Venganza contra los Dioses
เกิดใหม่นักรบพันธุ์ระห่ำ
description:
Zephyr is the last human fighting evil in a world abandoned by the gods. When he is killed in battle by Tartarus, the god of destruction, all hope for humanity seems lost. But Zephyr’s fate is not sealed — the gods who find his battles entertaining have gifted him a second chance at life, as he is sent ten years into the past, back to when he was a slave instead of the most powerful human alive. Can Zephyr get his revenge against Tartarus and save the woman he loves, or is he doomed to repeat the past?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
Protagonist of the story "Doom Breaker".
Zephyr is the last human fighting evil in a world abandoned by the gods. When he is killed in battle by Tartarus, the god of destruction, all hope for humanity seems lost. But Zephyr’s fate is not sealed - the gods who find his battles entertaining have gifted him a second chance at life, as he is sent ten years into the past, back to when he was a slave instead of the most powerful human alive.

The princess of the Kingdom of Cayenne on the continent of Aslan where the story takes place. Altair was Zephyr's lover in their previous lives, and Zephyr is strongly determined to save her this time around.

One of the official disciples of Jinryang of the East, the 9th-highest ranking Tartarus Worshipper. He worked under Mathias Grimmer, the 36th-highest ranking Tartarus Worshipper. Both infiltrated the Temple of Light, working as Inquisitors to hide their agenda.

She is a sister of the shrine of light.

~!The name of her other persona is the broker 'White Rose', who has connection with the underworld and exchanges monsters corpses, equipment and information regarding people.!~
The representative that shares the words of the gods. High level angel.

Polaris is the eldest prince of the Kingdom of Cayenne and Altair's eldest brother in addition to being the youngest cardinal in the Temple of Light.
~!He is the Head of the Tartarus Worshipers.!~

description:
The story of The Breaker follows Shi-Woon Yi, a timid high school student who becomes the disciple of Chun-Woo Han, a martial artist who is an enemy to the secret martial arts society known as the Murim. However, Shi-Woon is nave and unaware of his master's shady past and the unseen underbelly of the society. How will Chun-Woo manage to teach Shi-Woon and help him survive in the world of the Murim?

(Source: ABLAZE)

characters.description: Teacher who has mastered 9 styles of martial arts. With a mysterious past who seems to hold a grudge for the martial artists federation relating to the death of his master.  At the beginning of the story he seems to be a perverted middle aged man who came to the school going undercover as a teacher. After Shioon discovering his martial art skills, shioon bribes him with a video clip. Continuing Chun woo discovers Shioon's hidden potential and teaches foot and arm techiniques.As the story progresses, he shows more of his past and growing relationship with his new disciple.

A weak cowardly boy who is constantly being bullied until he encounters his new teacher using martial arts to defend himself. Shi-Woon begs him to teach him. After several instances where the cowardly boy shows he has heart and will fight with all his might, he becomes Chun-Woo's pupil.   ~!He was given the Illwallsidan (One Moon Divine Dan) by Shi-Ho that forcefully increases Ki, and, had it not been for Goo-Moon-Ryong's help, would have died due to large of amount of Ki his body could not contain. Due to ingesting the pill, Shi-Woon now possess quick healing abilities, greater stamina and physical ability. Though the main effect of the pill is the extremely large amount of Ki he now holds in his body, seemingly giving him endless stamina and great strength in martial arts techniques. However initially, Shi-Woon's body is not yet able to take the strain of the great amount of Ki he suddenly possesses and when summoning too much strength would harm him.  Over the course of the first series, he shows that he has an affinity for learning martial arts, as he was able to perform a high level technique, Lightning Steps, after being shown only once. He was also able to align his Ki with external movements, allowing him to use Spirit Breaking Strike within a week. These abilities usually takes months, if not years, for high level Murim to learn and perfect, proving that Shi-Woon may have hidden talents yet to be fully realized. Due to his master's intent of removing him from the Murim world and not suffering the same pain he felt on his master's sacrifice, Chun-Woo destroyed his Ki-center, effectively taking away his ability to do martial arts. Shi-Woon later wakes up in a hospital and learns that after he became unconscious, Chun-Woo disappeared with the other Black Forest members and So-Sul, having only left behind a cell phone with video tutorials on his techniques for Shi-Woon. A few weeks later, Shi-Woon is at school and adjusting back to life before he met Chun-Woo and the others. News has spread of his beating of Chang-Ho and he was being challenged by others for the top spot. On his way through the school exit, he is greeted by a large number of men in black suits led by Gyu-Bum who tells him that he has become the new Head of the Sun-Woo Clan, as he is now in possession of the Phoenix Medallion( given to him by So-Sul in chapter 37 of Breaker) and that a new Murim world awaits him. !~  ~!The Breaker: New Waves  No longer a member of the martial arts world of Murim, Shi-Woon Yi is supposed to return to his normal life. However, he was given a medallion from So-Sul that names him as the new leader of the Sun-Woo clan. The Sun-Woo clan elders send Jin-Ie Kwon as protection for Shi-Woon, and to make him accept the position of head of the clan so they can make him their puppet. Shi-Woon is confronted by several individuals with grudges against his master. Despite having a shattered ki center, Shi-Woon chooses to fight in order to protect the reputation of his master.The Elder of the Sun-Woo Clan Jae-Kyu Kwon , realizing that Shi-Woon will not be a willing puppet for them, orders Jin-Ie to kill him, but she spares his life. Not wanting to cause trouble for Jin-Ie, Shi-Woon goes into hiding, hoping the Sun-Woo clan will believe he is dead. Shi-Woon encounters difficulties, however, when he starts getting attacked  by the S.U.C. (Soldiers Under Command), an organization of individuals claiming to be "disciples" of the Nine Arts Dragon. They claim that in order to fullfil Goomoonryong's will, they must eliminate his "first student", Shi-Woon since he is the only "official" disciple to Goomoonryong. Believing that they are going against his master's beliefs and teachings, Shi-Woon tries to fight them but struggles. He encounters a mysterious homeless man named Bae Seung-Jae who gives him a special medicine that, when consumed, allows Shi-Woon's body to produce Ki for a limited period of time despite his shattered Ki center. With it, Shi-Woon is able to utilize his old techniques and defeat several of his attackers from S.U.C. Told repeatedly that there is no way to fix his shattered Ki center, Shi-Woon resolves to find a way to get stronger.It is recently revealed in New Waves that Shi-Woon does have skills for martial arts, the reason being that he is able to possess a great amount of Ki due to Goo-Moon-Ryong expanding his Meridians (channels of Ki that is stored in the Ki Center) to an abnormally large extent, allowing him to possess the amount of Ki equal to Master class martial artists.!~ (Source: Wikipedia, The Breaker: New Waves chapter 32,35-36, and 43)

A very attractive woman who uses her sex appeal to make people do as she wishes. She can be very manipulative when she wants, making the likes of Alex carry out jobs which she would prefer not to do. Chun-Woo once claimed that there has never been a person that she has targeted that hadn't been taken in by her. She was a member of the Chun-Nyu-Moon (Heavenly Maiden Skill) and is very skilled at administering drugs, and has a in-depth knowledge of the human body and Ki system. With this knowledge, she has the ability to transfer Ki from one person to another. She drives a Mini Cooper S as her personal vehicle.   ~!Her own fighting skills are also high level, as she was able to escape capture after meeting Won-Jae Hyun and held her own when fighting alongside Chun-Woo against the Alliance.  She died in the hands on Chun-Woo on the top of the Alliance HQ after jumping in front of a gun aimed at Chun-Woo. She was used as a bargaining chip to make Chun-Woo hand over the Black Heaven and Earth Technique when gravely injured, but during the commotion was shot once again unnoticed by a sniper. She was in love with Chun-Woo and saw Yoon-Ji as a rival, always interfering with his attempts to date her.!~

He was the master of Chun-Woo Han and Ryuji. After achieving the Black Origin Threshold the Martial Arts Alliance banished him to a life of meditation and solitude in a cave while he tried to figure out a way to solve the problem of this technique. He was always calm and composed, and did not hold a grudge against the elders that exiled him. Despite almost never showing emotions, he is very caring as he expelled Ryuji as a disciple and killed himself to protect both Ryuji and Chun-Woo Han respectively. He is also very moral, as he told off Chun-Woo Han when his student made the wrong choices in using martial arts to hurt others.

(Source: The Breaker wiki)

Kang-Sung, also known as Sammoonryong (lit. Three Arts Dragon), is the curent chief of the Martial Arts Alliance. It is unknown how powerful Kang-Sung really is even with the title of Sammoonryong. Others say he did not pursue the title of Goomoonryong because of obligations to lead his clan.  He is a calm and righteous man who has his own beliefs that differ from Gi-Joo Song, Hyun-Tae, and the previous Alliance Chief. Though Goomoonryong killed his master and Gi-Joo, he doesn't believe in revenge. He initially admires Goomoonryong and tries his best to understand him, despite the fact that the Chief and his own master deemed him as their enemy. He is loyal to the Alliance and greatly values the traditions of the Murim, so when Goomoonryong mocks the relationship between master and student, he considers it as the last straw and is ready to fight him.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

So-Chun Hyuk is the Assistant-Leader of the "Heavenly Way School" and a martial arts prodigy in the Murim world. He is one of the many characters in the series who start out as an antagonist to Shi-Woon, but later become an ally to him. He is the adopted brother of Jang Joon-Ho.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

Jang So-Sul / Sun-Woo So-Sul is the former head of the Sun-Woo Clan, like her father. So-Sul is small and has a weak frame due to her unique body condition which makes her seem younger than she really is (a fact that greatly annoys her as Shi-Woon treats her like a little child). In the beginning, she cannot talk due to her unique condition; whenever she does, she is come over with a coughing seizure. But due to Shi-Woon Yi administrating his blood to her as a remedy and then massaging her body, she can now talk more due the vast amount of ki in Shi-Woon's blood.  Despite her appearance, and even her age (15 Years Old), she is incredibly mature, a trait that is shown in her almost aristocratic style of speech and her self-denial of a teenage lifestyle. She appears to be calm even when there is danger although it was revealed that she was afraid since she saw the same things in nightmares and was scared. She seems to be shy and the type that does not show her true desires and always acts as though she is forced to things that she actually wants to do, like when she played with Shi-Woon in the sand making castles.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)
Childhood friend of Shi-Woon.

A member of the Black Forest Defense Group and a world-class porter. Although his martial arts skills are limited, he is described as a "God" when driving, which was proven when he was able to get a very far distance when being pursued by the Torrent Clan during the Sosul incident while driving a broken down, slow car. He is infatuated with Shi-Ho, and she often uses this to manipulate him into doing her bidding. He drives a Lamborghini Murcielago as his personal vehicle.  ~!He is also able to pilot a helicopter.!~  (Source: Wikipedia)

He is a member of the Martial Arts Alliance and head of the One Moon School. His school has a large pharmaceutical company as a front for its existence. He is also Shi-Ho Lee's ex-boyfriend. Throughout the series he constantly tried to help and win the affection of Shi-Ho who he still loves.    ~!After Shi-Ho's death at the conclusion of The Breaker, he took her body and placed it in a special chamber as he works to bring her back from her comatose state.!~ (Source: The Breaker Wiki)

She had a stained relationship with her son and neglected him for work. After Shioon is rushed to the hospital, she blames herself for not protected him and starts paying more attention to her son.    In New Waves she becomes a CEO of the company where she works.   she lost her husband and Shioon's father

He is a first year student at Nine Dragons High School. He along with other students used to bully Shi-Woon Yi. He has extremely short hair and narrow eyes with very small pupils. He often has a nasty sneer on his face. Because he had previously been punched in the face by an enraged Shi-Woon, he is missing the two front teeth of his upper jaw.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)
Teacher who become Won's girlfriend.
He bears the title of "Northern Black Star" and is a member of the Four Supernovas. He also considers Shi-Woon Yi an ally.

He is So-Chun Hyuk's so-called "adopted brother" who discovered Shi-Woon Yi. He has a great sense of respect and honor, therefore doesn't bow before others when he is told to, but he bows deep when he expresses his respect for the other person. He is also shown to be the type who would avoid conflicts whenever possible. This however does not apply when he can help others by confronting the danger itself. He is not very interested in the Murim's politics and just follows the orders given to him.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

synonyms: Suddenly Became A Princess One Day
One Day, I Became a Princess
ある日、お姫様になってしまった件について
อยู่ๆ ฉันก็กลายเป็นเจ้าหญิง
Un día me convertí en princesa
De repente me convertí en una princesa
description:
The story of Athanasia, forsaken princess of the Obelian Empire, ends with her execution at the hands of her own father—or does it? Her tragic tale is the plot of the novel The Lovely Princess. But now, a modern woman who read the book has just woken up as baby Athanasia herself, filled with her own memories and knowledge of the story she’s stuck in! Determined to survive her doomed fate, infant Athanasia embarks on this new life with a plan: avoid attention and hoard valuables to fund her escape. When her plan goes awry, she suddenly needs to charm her way into the good graces of her father, the beautiful tyrant emperor, so he doesn’t kill her again!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

alternative: アタナシア・デイ・エルジェア・オベリア

characters.description:
Athanasia de Alger Obelia is the main protagonist of the manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess" as well as the first princess and only heir to the Obelian Empire. After reading a book named "The Lovely Princess" on a shunned princess named Athanasia, the protagonist falls asleep with sleeping pills and finds herself in the infant body of Athanasia from the book.

Athanasia, also known as "Athy", is the daughter of the emperor Claude de Alger Obelia and Diana, a dancer he deflowered after meeting at a royal banquet. Claude's harem previously occupied the Ruby Palace, however, he massacred them when Diana died giving birth to Athy.

Athy makes her goal in her new life to avoid the execution of the previous Athanasia on her 18th birthday.
A royal magician working at the black tower and Athanasia de Alger Obelia's chosen playmate.

alternative: クロード・デイ・エルジェア・オベリア

characters.description:
Claude de Alger Obelia is the current reigning emperor of the Empire of Obelia, and the father of the main protagonist in the popular manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess". He is a book character in "The Lovely Princess", and kills his oldest blood-related daughter, the original Athanasia de Alger Obelia. Claude has been shown to be ruthless and cruel, yet also warm and affectionate later on in the story.

In the book "The Lovely Princess", Claude gains the throne by usurping and murdering his older brother, Anastacius de Alger Obelia. His name, Claude, refers to his illegitimacy to become heir, as heirs to the Obelian Empire have names which means "immortal".

alternative: イゼキエル・アルフィアス

characters.description:
Ijekiel Alpheus is the oldest son of the House of Alpheus. He is the male lead in _The Lovely Princess_, ending up as [Jennette](https://anilist.co/character/143630/Jennette-Margarita)'s fiance at the end of the original story. He is disliked by [Claude de Alger Obelia](https://anilist.co/character/136776/Claude-de-Alger-Obelia) and refers to [Athanasia de Obelia](https://anilist.co/character/143632/Athanasia-de-Alger-Obelia) as "Lady Angel" due to the circumstances of their first and second encounters.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

alternative: ジェニット・マグリタ

characters.description:
Jennette was the original protagonist of the book "The Lovely Princess" from the manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess", until the main protagonist of the series transmigrates into the body of Athanasia de Alger Obelia. She is a side character and views Athanasia with admiration.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

alternative: フィリックス・ロベイン

characters.description:
Felix Robane is a side character in the manhwa "Who Made Me a Princess", and serves as the main protagonist's personal guard. He is first seen in chapter six when Claude de Alger Obelia first meets Athanasia de Alger Obelia. He is assigned the role of Athanasia's personal guard when she is 5, and soon becomes quite close with her.

Felix's mother was Claude's nanny, and the two were raised as bosom brothers.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

Lilian York is Athy's main caregiver, as well as being the head maid. Despite being aware of the Ruby Palace incident, she still volunteers to be Athy's nanny due to an admiration of Diana's free spirit.

The two share a close bond in both the book "The Lovely Princess" and the manhwa itself. ~!Their bond is so strong that Lilian died while protecting Athanasia from her execution.!~ Lilian is shown to be a loyal and affectionate caretaker, with Athanasia reciprocating those feelings.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)

Anastacius is the older brother of Claude de Alger Obelia and originally the official crown prince.

~! He is [Jennette Margarita's](https://anilist.co/character/143630/Jennette-Margarita) biological father. !~
Roger Alpheus is Ijekiel Alpheus' father and the head of House Alpheus, the duke family who raised Jennette Margarita.

Diana is a dancer who died whilst giving birth to Athanasia. She is mainly depicted as "fairy-like" and graceful, and has no recorded contact with Athanasia in the manhwa other than brief dreams where Athy sees her mother interacting with Claude (and vice-versa).

In a sense, Diana saves Athy from death during the Ruby Palace massacre and secures her place as Obelia's next heir by giving her child the name "Athanasia", which Claude found humorous. Athy is often told she possesses similar traits to her mother in both looks and personality.

(Source: Who Made Me Princess Wikia)
Penelope Judith is the mother of Jennette Margarita and Claude de Alger Obelia's former fiancée.

description:
After Sirone was abandoned in a stable, he was found by a family of hunters and raised in a loving home. Despite the hardships of the peasant life, he learned how to read from a young age and became obsessed with books, especially ones on the history of magic. One day, he has an unlikely encounter with a mage and learns how to enter the "spirit zone," the first step to learning how to use magic. Although they say only nobles can be mages, will Sirone be able to prove his infinite potential?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: She is the eldest daughter of the Ogent family. She is a genius musician with a kind personality, who knows how to use schema and swordsmanship.
He is the youngest son of the Ogent family and [Shirone](https://anilist.co/character/304076)'s friend.

synonyms: The Great Mage Returns After 4000 Years
4000年ぶりに帰還した大魔導士
มหาจอมเวทผู้กลับมาอีกครั้งหลัง 4000 ปี
description:
Lucas Trowman was the greatest archmage in history until he was condemned by Demigod to spend eternity losing his mind. But 4,000 years later, he’s thrust back into this world, into the body of Frei Blake, the weakest, most un-talented student at the prestigious Westroad Academy for mages. After all this time, the world of magic has barely progressed. Could this be the work of Demigod? Determined to find out, Lucas seeks to reach the highest levels of power once again and get his revenge.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Lukas was captured in the abyss for 4000 years, than he saw Frey Blake who has poisoned himself and died. Lukas took over the body of Frey and thus escaped the abyss.
Westroad Academy's worst student and [Lukas Trowman](https://anilist.co/character/185995/Lukas-Trowman)'s new body.
The apocalypse of swords, a demi god.
Trustworthy companion, she doesn't hesitate to follow [Lukas](https://anilist.co/character/185995/Lukas-Trowman) and to learn more about the way he uses magic.

Lord is one of the most powerful beings in the world. He is recognized by the other demigods to be their absolute leader. ~!The demigod who imprisoned [Lukas Trowman](https://anilist.co/character/185995/Lukas-Trowman) in the Abyss and his main enemy is none other than Lord.!~
Iris Peacefinder is one of the Heroes of the Age of Light.
He was part of [Lukas Trowman](https://anilist.co/character/185995/Lukas-Trowman)'s party that resisted the Demigods. He created the Magic Warrior King arts to fight against Demigods.
Ananta is the Apocalypse who controls poison.

synonyms: テムパル〜アイテムの力〜
description:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description:
__Country:__ South Korea

Sin Yeong-U is the name of the main character in real life, while Greed is the in-game name.

He was an unlucky loser in life. He entered into debt to buy the gaming capsule needed to play the game Satisfy. He experienced a hard life and was forced into manual labor jobs to pay off the enormous debt, but he still played the game despite not being good at it.

His in-game character called Greed found unusual luck in a legendary class change item (Pagma's Rare Book) during an S-class quest. But hidden beneath that luck was his level dropping to -1. This was due to the legendary class change, and the failure of an SS rank quest by dying. He struggled to survive and made money in the world of Satisfy as the first negative leveled legendary class player.

(Source: Overgeared Wiki)

__Country:__ Brazil ~!She laters becomes a South Korean citizen!~

Jishuka, the Bow Saint-Legendary Archer, also known as Godly Archer, is a high-ranked and powerful User. She is a Legendary Class holder, one of the main pillars and the Duke of Overgeared Kingdom.

__Country:__ South Korea

Yu-Ra, known as the 'Blood Witch' and the 8th Servant of God Yatan, is a high ranked and powerful User.

Yu-Ra is a player best known for her beauty and support for the Yatan Church. She is a famous person who frequently appears on TV because of her beautiful appearance and outstanding abilities. Contrary to her creepy nickname of the ‘Blood Witch’, she was well loved and respected, as well as a target of envy. Thanks to her superb beauty, perfect gaming skills and ideal image in the media, she was praised by both men and women. It also transcended race. There were thousands of fan clubs created on overseas servers. At first glance, she was even more popular than Hollywood’s top actors.

Throughout her life, she had been praised by everyone she met for her beauty and intelligence. She is smart enough to see anything through with logic. She used her innate insight on her work, earning her a reputation of a talented person who could be used everywhere. In fact, her control skills were so great that despite being a Black Magician, known for having very weak defense and insufficient attack power, she was at one point able to reach to fifth place on the unified rankings.

~!She obtains the legendary class “Demon Slayer” after betraying the Yatan Church!~

(Source: Overgeared Wiki)

Euphemina, the Mumud's Successor, formerly the Duplicator and the Earl of Eternal Kingdom, is a powerful User and a Private Ranker in Satisfy.

She is the first epic rated hidden class user. As a Duplicator, she secretly collects copies of high-grade spells from rankers and named NPCs. Because of her ability to cast these high-grade spells without chanting, people usually mistook her as having a legendary class and even stronger than Grid. Euphemina holds great pride in her looks. However, she has a complex about her short height and hates to be called a "kid".

~!She is currently a Legendary Class holder, who can also become a Myth in the future, a Meritorious Retainer, an Earl, and one of the main pillars of the Overgeared Kingdom who works under the reign of Overgeared King Grid as one of his loyal retainers and Knights.!~

Braham Eshwald is known as a human and Legendary Great Magician who was praised as the Duke of Wisdom despite not reaching the truth. Hidden behind it is the unspoken tenth child of the Direct Descendant Vampires, who lost his eternal life and was banished from the clan for the crime of harming his kin. Braham who inherited the cleverness of Progenitor Beriache is captivated by the irresistible instinct for knowledge. He faithfully explores all disciplines and magic of the world to accumulate more knowledge and strives to become a perfect existence. For his magic research, all kinds of species were used as his test subjects, including the taboo break of his own kin to lift the Curse of Idleness. Faced with the obstacle of finite life, he completed the Resurrection Magic while being hidden as a human and overcame the curse.
__Country:__ Canada
__Country:__ United Kingdom

__Race:__ Vampire

~!In one of the current arcs of the web novel, she became Grid's 4th wife.!~

International singer from the United Kingdom and member of the Tzedakah Guild.

Yerim is best friend with Shin Sehee, and also one of the most outstanding students at Young Ladies High School. Just like Sehee, she is in the top five of the National Mock Test and her beauty is one of the best in school.

synonyms: 災いクラスの俺様英雄の帰還
การกลับมาของฮีโร่ระดับหายนะ
description:
Humans call them “calamities”—the unknown, destructive creatures that suddenly appeared on earth. To challenge these calamities, the zodiac gods awakened 12 humans known as saints. But there was one more that awoke—unchosen but the greatest hero of all: Geon Lee. His allies betrayed him and left him for dead, but now, 20 years later, he’s more powerful than ever and ready to teach his fellow “saints” a lesson they’ll never forget.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The 13th awakened person, not selected by a god. He was betrayed by the 12 Saints and left to die.
One of the twelve saints with gods blessing and Geon Lee's best friend.
Hugo Sudal's son and Cheon Yooha's younger brother.
One of the twelve saint with gods blessing.

description:
Mysterious tombs appeared all over the world one day, each containing a relic which grants its owner supernatural abilities. Joo-Heon Suh is a tomb explorer, excavator, and raider. Betrayed by his employer, he's about to die at the hands of a powerful new relic when he suddenly finds himself 15 years in the past, before any relics or tombs made their debut. Driven by feelings of revenge, how will Joo-Heon use his knowledge of the future to become the Tomb Raider King?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

characters.description: After getting betrayed by his own boss who feared his rising power and sent to a death mission, he gets help from a strange relic which sends him 15 years back in time, when tombs just started appearing.

Irene Holton is the only daughter of the Holton Family. She was known as the Monarch of Destitution.Irene is an innocent girl that is at first reluctant to do anything.But during the fight against the relic Hand of Midas, with the help of Seo Joo-Heon, she gained confidence and dominate the relic and now have complete control over it. After the event, she gained more confidence and will help Seo Joo-Heon do every tasks.

Before the time rewind, he was (and still is) a specialist in relic restoration. He became known as the Fraud King, something which Chairman Kwon eventually became aware of. Jae-Ha met Joo-Heon through being on the same raiding team.

~!When Joo-Heon tries to seek him out in order to repair his relics, Irene informs him that he is 'dead'. She then recounts that he had sold her brother, George Hilton, a false painting. He was caught for the fraud and was presumed dead after his car fell down a cliff.He's later discovered to be alive when Edward called him on behalf of Chairman Kwon. Since he'd damaged his relic and needed it to be repaired. Something he agrees to.

Joo-Heon lures him out by requesting a relic restoration. His high-ranking relics making Jae-Ha try to scam him with false ones, running away with the real ones. He fails to do so, being caught by Joo-Heon's rope relic.

He is then approached to sign a 'slave contract' which is then reformed to an 'exclusive contract'. In order to rope him in, Joo-Heon offers an explanation for how Richard Chang (his tutor) stole Jae-Ha's art style. In addition to giving him back the elements of art and reputation that Richard had stolen from him.!~

Lee Seol-Ah was a member of the TKBM Tomb raiding team under the command of Seo Ju-Heon.She was a scout skilled at finding people and relics. She is currently working for the Chinese raiding group of Red Flowers. She attempted to thwart Seo Joo-Heon plan of selling the fake Nero's Relic which was presumed to be the relic of Julius Ceaser by destroying it with a B ranked dagger.

(Source: Tomb Raider King Wiki)
Chloe is a medic skilled at healing the injured and suppressing risks caused by relics. She can store relic risks inside bottles and use them.
Jullian Miller was framed by Seo Joo-Heon as the culprit and blackmailer attempting to steal the Julius Caesar relic.

Ilya Volgof was a member of TKBM's Team 13 under the command of Seo Joo-Heon.

He is the most skilled of the Aftermath Clean-up Crew which specializes in modifying memories and disbanding tomb raiding teams.

He is currently working for Kwon Hyuk Soo after quitting his job as a talented Russian exorcism priest at the Vatican in Italy and losing his girlfriend Galina to find a way to revive her without realizing that the Vatican executed her and used her as a sacrifice for Un-Known.

After he regained his memories, he betrayed Kwon Hyuk Soo but refused to rejoin the team which resulted in him being beaten up and forced to sign Seo Joo-Heon's contract.

Im Hae-Jin is a legendary Hunter and tanker whose immense strength and tough skin earned him the titles of Asura and the Ghost of Death. He is like a human weapon that allowed Seo Joo-Heon to only focus on tomb evacuation.
Edward is a world renowned weapons and information merchant and illegal arms dealer.

Kwon Tae-Jun is the main villain of Tomb Raider King.

He is CEO of TKBM Company and TKBM Excavation Team. In previous life, he became the strongest relic user with the help of Seo Ju-Heon and his team.

title.english: The Player Who Can't Level Up

synonyms: The Player That Can't Level Up
The Player Who Can't Level Up: O Mestre dos Egos
เพลเยอร์เลเวลไม่อัป
description:
When Kim Kigyu received his invitation to become a player (a unique-ability player, at that), he thought his struggles were over. But no matter how hard he tries, he just can’t seem to get past level 1! After five years of working as a guide on the lower floors of the tower, he’s finally discovered his ability to link with “Egos” and raise his stats. As his new skills unlock adventures in unexplored gates, Kigyu gets his chance to defy expectations and show the world that rank isn’t everything.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

synonyms: Survival Story of a Sword King in a Fantasy World
Latna Saga: A Jornada do Rei Espadachim
การเอาชีวิตรอดของราชาดาบในต่างโลก
description:
After being recently discharged from military service and just drifting through life, Hanbin Ryu is suddenly transported to another world. However, his “guide line,” the system bestowed upon him to help with his survival and growth, was filled with errors, causing him to be stuck in the tutorial stage for over 20 years. When he is finally released from this personal hell, he finds everyone has turned against otherworlders like him. Just how will this low-level, super-tutorial newbie survive?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Ryu Han-Bin was a normal person who just had been discharged from his mandatory military service, when he was transported to another world

Kivye is the envoy of the Goddess of Darkness Kivryelle. She was sent to Rathnia to search for Ryu Han-Bin in order to ask for his help in finding one of the four heroes, Barolt, for the sake of saving the world of Rathnia from Ormphlaus and defeating Zenovia and Garhan.

Atisse Bennister is a dragon with the ability of transform himself into a human and back to dragon. Among the dragons Atisse is considered very young due to the fact that dragons can live several thousand years as stated by Atisse. He is currently friends with Ryu Han-Bin and Ephyr.

Leonhart is a powerful warrior from Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King, initially part of the Heresy Inquisitors. Over time, he shifts his allegiance and becomes an ally to Ryu Hanbin. His strength and divine abilities make him a key character in the story.
Patault also known as The Sword King is one of the four heroes blessed by the Goddesses. He is a Valterian warrior and the strongest among the four heroes.
Laude Roud is one of the few persons Ryu Han-Bin first interacted with after his arrival to the Onprous City. He offered Ryu Han-Bin to join his party at the same time he mocked him about his level.
Zenovia also known as Zenovia The Archmage is the current Queen of Mage Kingdom of Rune and one of four heroes blessed by the Goddesses. She is considered the strongest Rathnian mage.

alternative: The Trasncendentalist of Life and Death

characters.description: Hollian also know as Hollian The Trasncendentalist of Life and Death is the current Queen of Allendia Kingdom. She is one of four heroes who were blessed by the Goddesses.

description:
Rai wakes up from an 820-year-long sleep and starts his new life as a student in a high school founded by his loyal servant, Frankenstein. But his peaceful days with other human students are soon interrupted by mysterious attackers known as the "Unions."

(Source: WEBTOON)

alternative: カディス・エトラマ・デ・ライジェル

characters.description: Rai is a very elegant and mysterious Noble. He has no knowledge whatsoever of the 21st century, and will often become lost and confused especially with regards to modern day technology (such as using a cell phone). He is often used as the manhwa's comic relief with his love of ramen and the errors he makes with technology. He has fallen into a deep slumber for 820 years, and had woken up in an abandoned building in South Korea. After seeing what most of the humans on the streets were wearing, Rai took on the uniform of a student from Ye Ran High School, which is under the administration of Frankenstein, and inadvertently followed the students there.

alternative: フランケンシュタイン

characters.description: Frankenstein (Kor. 프랑켄슈타인) (commonly referred to as chairman by the children) is Rai's devoted servant. He supports Rai whole-heartedly and calls him "Master". He had tried searching for his master after Rai's apparent "disappearance."  Frankenstein is the principal/director of Ye Ran High School. He was stunned to find Rai in his school office after Rai had woken up and dressed in his school's uniform.  Frankenstein is a very cheerful and loyal person, especially toward his master, but can become quite serious and calculative when the situation calls for it. Although Frankenstein has shown somewhat of a sadistic side during his recurrent battles, like Rai, he is also compassionate towards human beings, especially towards the students in his school.   Frankenstein is immensely powerful but some of his powers had been sealed away by Rai due to him misusing them in the past. After 820 years of sealing, Rai has finally taken off the punishment. But whenever Frankenstein gets serious in fighting uses his full power, Rai shows a considerable amount of anxiety.    ~! He is the "father" of human modification and enchantment. !~

alternative: セーラ・J・ロイアード

characters.description:
Race: Noble
Occupation: student, Loyard clan leader
Eye colour: Red
Hair colour: Silver

Seira has a rather quiet and shy personality. She usually doesn’t show emotion on her face and is very calm, but she does blush when being complimented. She learns to cook very rapidly and is soon responsible for making meals in Frankenstein’s house with the exception of ramen, which is Frankenstein’s personal project.   Seira is the last remaining blood descendant and the leader of the Loyard clan. Her soul weapon is the Death Scythe. Since the death of her family members, she has been under Gejutel’s care. She and Regis are very close and they have a mental connection, due to which they can sense each others presence. When she can’t feel this presence this means he’s either very far away, unconscious or dead.   (Source: Wikipedia, Noblesse Wikia)

Tao is a  young man who possesses a genius-level intellect in computer programming and other technological fields. He was one of the less cold-hearted members of the DA-5 group, made by Dr. Iris, and is yet another a modified human. He is currently residing with Takeo and M-21 in Frankenstein's residence and is also working as a security guard in Ye Ran High School. He is "Number One" of the RK-4 which is a group of four formed by himself.

Takeo (Kor. 타키오) was once a member of the DA-5 created by Dr. Aris. Believing that his sister was held captive by the Union, he participated in its experiments and followed orders in order to protect her.    ~!In Chapter 151, however, it is revealed that this is a ruse concocted by Dr. Aris, who created the facade for the sake of her own entertainment. Takeo is later invited to live in Frankenstein's house after betraying the Union and erasing all traces of his and Tao's existence, which resulted in the Union's belief of their failure and death as experiments. Recently, both he and Tao have asked Frankenstein to enhance their powers in order to increase their capability to protect their comrades, especially M-21, with whom they have formed a strong bond of loyalty and friendship. He is a member of the RK-4 and his codename is 'Number Two'. !~ (Source: Noblesse Wikia)

Han Shin-Woo, a student in Ye Ran High School, popular because of his excellent martial skills. On the day of Rai's awakening, he happens to meet him on the way to school and gradually becomes close to Rai at school, developing a bond which can be termed as friendship. Eventually he gets involved in many strange fights against people with extra-ordinary powers. Rai and Frankenstein rescues him and others from the mess everytime. Later he as well as the others are brainwashed for their own safety and so remember nothing of the strange happenings.  Shin-Woo is an energetic and athletic teenager with bright red hair. He is always seen with a bandage over the bridge of his nose. He is actually pretty good looking but not that many people realize it because of his behavior.  He is well-known within the city to be skilled in martial arts and feared by gangs. Shin-Woo is often shown sleeping (and drooling) in class and slacking off. Though he is shown as a lazy student, he is also very courageous and would protect his friends at all costs. He often tends to be late for school due to over sleeping. He has liked Yuna for a long time and it is disclosed that he confessed to her in past which led to an embarrassing situation. Since then they have been just good friends although Shin-Woo still has a liking for Yuna. Shin-Woo is also starting to like Seira.  Shin-Woo is an amazing Martial Artist excelling in Tae Kwon Do and Hapkido. He is well-known within the city to be skilled in martial arts and is feared by gangs. He is able to match the powers of M-24's Infected, and since then has been getting stronger.  Even for normal human parameters, it's been quoted that Shin-Woo possesses an incredible amount of strength, which he has displayed during his multiple battles; including those with the Infected.  It's been noted that one of Shin-Woo's most incredible atributes is his speed, shown as he instantly disappeared when he went to aid Yuna right after she yelled for help. Alongside his speed, his agility and reflexes have incresed during the progression of the series; to the point he was able to dodge one of Shark's attacks and counterattack at the same time.  Shin-Woo's most incredible strength relies in his durability, since he is able to endure attacks that would normaly kill a human being; as shown when he took a beating from Shark and was even able to stood up against him one more time right after he threatened to kill his friends.

(Source: Nobelesse wiki)

alternative: レジス・K・ランデグル

characters.description: Regis is a young noble. His caretaker is his companion Seira. Regis has high regard for elegance and is extremely prideful. He values manners and honor primarily. He and Seira appeared to investigate the possible appearance of an infected/mutant amongst the humans.  Regis is fairly short and when Ikhan first sees him, he becomes excited at having someone the same size as him. Ikhan has always felt self-conscious, but Regis does not feel bothered by his height.   ~! His grandfather is an old well-respected noble called Gejutel and also the current leader of the Landegre clan. It is revealed Regis father died in the rebellion and betrayal against the Lord.!~  He does not get along well M-21, especially when they first met because he has a strong dislike of modified humans who he thinks sold their humanity for power. However, once he sees how M-21 sacrifices himself for the children he reconsiders his opinion of him, but not enough to fix their "sensitive" relationship.  Against his will and better judgment, Regis gets recruited into Tao's group, Rai's Knights, as RK No. 3.

Age: unknown (>500) Race: Noble Occupation: Kertia clan leader Eye colour: Red Hair colour: Blonde Rajak is the head of the house of Kertia, a clan of murderers, and Rael’s older brother. His soul weapon is Kartas and it takes the form of two daggers, the same as his younger brother’s soul weapon Grandia. Since Rael also has a soul weapon without being the clan leader, Rajak’s soul weapon is incomplete. Initially, it was assumed by Rael that Rajak didn’t know about this, but later it is revealed that he knew. Unlike Rael, he has impressive control over his soul weapon and uses it to hide his aura. This way he can be discreet like a true assassin. He can also create multiple copies of himself to surround the enemy. Combined with his hidden aura and enhanced speed, it is extremely hard for his enemy to know who’s the real Rajak and where the attack will come from. Rajak moves with an air of dignity. When he is ordered by the Lord to go to the human world to bring Seira back, he feels somewhat irritated. Being convinced by his younger brother that the work doesn’t suit his dignity, he lets Rael do it instead of him. When Rai manages to move past him, he couldn’t believe someone overstepped him. He is very loyal to the Lord and executes anything he has been bidden to do without question. He also shows great respect to the other clan leaders and scolds Rael when he insults Gejutel. He executes his job as a clan leader whole-heartedly. When Rael manages to wound Frankenstein during a fight with Rajak by using a sneak attack, Rajak slashed himself to compensate for his brother’s foul play.  Source: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noblesse_(manga) http://noblesse.wikia.com/wiki/Noblesse_Wiki

__Race:__ Noble
__Occupation:__ Lord of the Nobles

Raskreia is the current leader of the Nobles and her soul weapon is Ragnarok. She is the daughter of the previous lord who entered the eternal sleep 500 years ago. Unlike her predecessor, she is more strict and conventional, showing an arrogant and sever attitude. However, according to Gejutel, she is too sentimental in her decisions and this is one of the reasons why she is considered unfit to be Lord by the so-called traitors.   ~!Rai and Frankenstein are acquainted with her, but they’re not on friendly terms. Before the previous Lord’s eternal sleep, some of the clan leaders made excuses and didn’t enter the eternal sleep with him. The previous Lord agreed with their request, but as soon as he entered the eternal sleep they betrayed him.
