Despite almost never showing emotions, he is very caring as he expelled Ryuji as a disciple and killed himself to protect both Ryuji and Chun-Woo Han respectively. He is also very moral, as he told off Chun-Woo Han when his student made the wrong choices in using martial arts to hurt others.

(Source: The Breaker wiki)

Teacher who has mastered 9 styles of martial arts. With a mysterious past who seems to hold a grudge for the martial artists federation relating to the death of his master.  At the beginning of the story he seems to be a perverted middle aged man who came to the school going undercover as a teacher. After Shioon discovering his martial art skills, shioon bribes him with a video clip. Continuing Chun woo discovers Shioon's hidden potential and teaches foot and arm techiniques.As the story progresses, he shows more of his past and growing relationship with his new disciple.

A very attractive woman who uses her sex appeal to make people do as she wishes. She can be very manipulative when she wants, making the likes of Alex carry out jobs which she would prefer not to do. Chun-Woo once claimed that there has never been a person that she has targeted that hadn't been taken in by her. She was a member of the Chun-Nyu-Moon (Heavenly Maiden Skill) and is very skilled at administering drugs, and has a in-depth knowledge of the human body and Ki system. With this knowledge, she has the ability to transfer Ki from one person to another. She drives a Mini Cooper S as her personal vehicle.   ~!Her own fighting skills are also high level, as she was able to escape capture after meeting Won-Jae Hyun and held her own when fighting alongside Chun-Woo against the Alliance.  She died in the hands on Chun-Woo on the top of the Alliance HQ after jumping in front of a gun aimed at Chun-Woo. She was used as a bargaining chip to make Chun-Woo hand over the Black Heaven and Earth Technique when gravely injured, but during the commotion was shot once again unnoticed by a sniper. She was in love with Chun-Woo and saw Yoon-Ji as a rival, always interfering with his attempts to date her.!~

He is the second-in-command of the Sun-Woo Clan, Head of the Elder Council of the Sun-Woo Clan and grandfather of Jin-Ie Kwon. He is extremely dedicated and loyal to the Sun-Woo Clan. Elder Kwon gave up the opportunity to form his own clan even after the Sun-Woo Clan's ruin and chose to stay with the clan. He regards anything that could be a danger to the clan as a threat which must be eliminated. Despite being seemingly arrogant, he is also extremely perceptive as he could identify that So-Jung Chan was attempting to corner the Sun-Woo Clan by asking about their new Ganju as Shi-Woon, and attempted to silence him immediately.  (Source: The Breaker Wiki)

He was a Sun-Woo Clan elder who became Shi-Woon Yi's teacher after Chun-Woo Han. Although his goal was originally to stop the fight between Shi-Woon and Ji-Gun Yoo by exhausting him through an extreme training regime, he later warmed up to Shi-Woon after he reminded him of the previous clan head with his determination.  (Source: The Breaker Wiki)

Kang-Sung, also known as Sammoonryong (lit. Three Arts Dragon), is the curent chief of the Martial Arts Alliance. It is unknown how powerful Kang-Sung really is even with the title of Sammoonryong. Others say he did not pursue the title of Goomoonryong because of obligations to lead his clan.  He is a calm and righteous man who has his own beliefs that differ from Gi-Joo Song, Hyun-Tae, and the previous Alliance Chief. Though Goomoonryong killed his master and Gi-Joo, he doesn't believe in revenge. He initially admires Goomoonryong and tries his best to understand him, despite the fact that the Chief and his own master deemed him as their enemy. He is loyal to the Alliance and greatly values the traditions of the Murim, so when Goomoonryong mocks the relationship between master and student, he considers it as the last straw and is ready to fight him.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

So-Chun Hyuk is the Assistant-Leader of the "Heavenly Way School" and a martial arts prodigy in the Murim world. He is one of the many characters in the series who start out as an antagonist to Shi-Woon, but later become an ally to him. He is the adopted brother of Jang Joon-Ho.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

A Mysterious boy who works with a woman named Sera. Ji-Gum later transferred to Nine Dragons High School. He is very popular with the girls because of his looks and charisma. He appears to get along with Sae-Hee, which in turn makes Shi-Woon worried. In reality, Ji-Gun is the prodigy of the Shin-Rim-Moon school. While little is known about the school or its history within Murim, it is theorized that this boy could defeat So-Chun Hyuk if he used a sword. When Jin-Ie explained to Gyu-Bum Yi about his fighting style, he analyzed his skill, claiming he fought her using his hands. However, Gyu-Bum claims that in the past, he was renowned as a skilled sword master, meaning the style or length of a blade is meaningless (even chopsticks could be used as a sword), summarizing that Ji-Gun's unit of measure is only the length of his finger. His skills are exceptional, being able to defeat Jin-Ie with only a finger (Jin-Ie being in the top 5 fighters in the powerful Sun-Woo Clan). However, during his match with Shi-Woon, it is revealed that he does not, in fact, use the swordless style and is instead simply using a finger technique. It is also revealed that he holds a leather gauntlet on his left wrist, in which he can draw a sword. He later admits defeat to Shi-Woon. He recently found Jin-Ie a new job at a maid café where his friend Do-jin was manager, and later talks to Shi-Woon about Jin-Ie's job.  Chapter 46, he received a call from Do-jin about what happened, and asked his master Sera to get Shi-woon. It is later revealed that Ji-Gum joined S.U.C.'s five captain seat before Ji-Woo Li.

(Source: Wikipedia)
(Source: The Breaker: New Waves volume 1, Chapter 48)

Jang So-Sul / Sun-Woo So-Sul is the former head of the Sun-Woo Clan, like her father. So-Sul is small and has a weak frame due to her unique body condition which makes her seem younger than she really is (a fact that greatly annoys her as Shi-Woon treats her like a little child). In the beginning, she cannot talk due to her unique condition; whenever she does, she is come over with a coughing seizure. But due to Shi-Woon Yi administrating his blood to her as a remedy and then massaging her body, she can now talk more due the vast amount of ki in Shi-Woon's blood.  Despite her appearance, and even her age (15 Years Old), she is incredibly mature, a trait that is shown in her almost aristocratic style of speech and her self-denial of a teenage lifestyle. She appears to be calm even when there is danger although it was revealed that she was afraid since she saw the same things in nightmares and was scared. She seems to be shy and the type that does not show her true desires and always acts as though she is forced to things that she actually wants to do, like when she played with Shi-Woon in the sand making castles.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

He is a prominent character and member of the Sun-Woo Clan, being a somewhat close friend of Jin-Ie Kwon. He is a top master of Sun-Woo and a skilled fighter, as he had been hailed to be quickly recognized in the Murim World. Despite his youthful appearance, he is at least in his mid to late twenties or early thirties as he was seen to be presumably around ten years of age before Jinie was even born. This mistaken impression may also have been helped with the style of fashion he employs.
Childhood friend of Shi-Woon.

A member of the Black Forest Defense Group and a world-class porter. Although his martial arts skills are limited, he is described as a "God" when driving, which was proven when he was able to get a very far distance when being pursued by the Torrent Clan during the Sosul incident while driving a broken down, slow car. He is infatuated with Shi-Ho, and she often uses this to manipulate him into doing her bidding. He drives a Lamborghini Murcielago as his personal vehicle.  ~!He is also able to pilot a helicopter.!~  (Source: Wikipedia)

Ha-ru (Chunmyungrang) is one of the five S.U.C. captains. She is known by her nickname "Thousand Face."

~!It was later revealed that she was in fact a double agent working on behalf of Kaiser.!~

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

He is a member of the Martial Arts Alliance and head of the One Moon School. His school has a large pharmaceutical company as a front for its existence. He is also Shi-Ho Lee's ex-boyfriend. Throughout the series he constantly tried to help and win the affection of Shi-Ho who he still loves.    ~!After Shi-Ho's death at the conclusion of The Breaker, he took her body and placed it in a special chamber as he works to bring her back from her comatose state.!~ (Source: The Breaker Wiki)

She had a stained relationship with her son and neglected him for work. After Shioon is rushed to the hospital, she blames herself for not protected him and starts paying more attention to her son.    In New Waves she becomes a CEO of the company where she works.   she lost her husband and Shioon's father

He is a first year student at Nine Dragons High School. He along with other students used to bully Shi-Woon Yi. He has extremely short hair and narrow eyes with very small pupils. He often has a nasty sneer on his face. Because he had previously been punched in the face by an enraged Shi-Woon, he is missing the two front teeth of his upper jaw.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)

He is So-Chun Hyuk's so-called "adopted brother" who discovered Shi-Woon Yi. He has a great sense of respect and honor, therefore doesn't bow before others when he is told to, but he bows deep when he expresses his respect for the other person. He is also shown to be the type who would avoid conflicts whenever possible. This however does not apply when he can help others by confronting the danger itself. He is not very interested in the Murim's politics and just follows the orders given to him.

(Source: The Breaker Wiki)
Tae-shin is a member of the Sun-Woo Clan. He is one of Jinie's two friends who came to save Shioon's life from Ji-Gum's gang.

He is one of the five Captains of S.U.C. He is first introduced in The Breaker: New Waves as one of the five leaders of S.U.C. It is implied that he's extremely strong and he's often shown together with Ji-Woo Li.  He is always calm and was never seen to lose his temper. This explains his nickname "Cool Guy". He is generally observant as he was able to find a counter-measure for the Soul-Crushing Strike after experiencing in the second fight with Shi-Woon. As stated by himself, he is a person of the Murim before he is a captain of the S.U.C. This explains both his honest character, and that he sticks even to self imposed rules, despite the consequences. He admires courageous people, such as Shi-Woon, though he doesn't admit it to himself.  (Source: The Breaker Wiki)
The Commander of S.U.C. He tasks all orders/missions and over sees everything.

description:
After he’s killed by the righteous leader of his own guild, Woojin gets a chance to start over. This time he’s not interested in saving the world from monsters—he’s got his sights set on revenge! His high-level kills quickly garner him notoriety among the game plebs, while boosting his stats as he masterminds his way closer to the top. But there's something no one can figure out: whose side he’s playing for. Now that he knows how to play to win, Woojin will stop at nothing to destroy the hero!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a 10-chapter side story

description:
Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the Duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Keiram is demon blade with the power of dark magic. Since the power of the demon blade come from the (God of Black Fog) Aer.So Aer consider her as the daughter. In chapter 19 when Cyan Vert meets with Aer for the first time in this current timeline Aer give some of his life force to Keiram. which helps Keiram to materialize her body without consuming any mana from Cyan Vert.
The imperial princess of the Wusif Empire.
Granddaughter of Regens Rainriver, headmaster of the Garam Academy of Sorcery.
Cyan's older sister, the only person in the Vert family who cherished Cyan.
Cyan's direct maid.

Wallace Vert is the Duke of the Usief Empire and father of the protagonist Cyan Vert.

He rule over Velias an estate in the western part of the Usief Empire. He who willingly dedicated his entire life to serve his people. He held back the invasion of demonic tribe in frontline with his exceptional magic power and military strategies. For maintaining peace for the entire continent, he consider this as his duty despite no on forcing him to do so. even if the demon kings army were to kill him.
He's a Guardian Knight who attempted to assassinate Cian at Margaret's behest, but Cian discovered this and executed all of the Knights except Brian.

description:
Aria Roscent mercilessly bullied her stepsister Mielle and paid the ultimate price for her misdeeds—but not before Mielle revealed that she’d manipulated Aria into harassing Mielle in the first place! Instead of dying, Aria is sent back in time and gifted a strange hourglass with mysterious powers. Now, Aria’s just got one goal: to embrace her role of villainess and utterly destroy Mielle’s life!

(Source: Yen Press)

characters.description:
After Aria’s mother Carin Roscente married Count Roscente, Aria became the stepsister of Cain Roscente and Mielle Roscente. Having received a second chance in life, she begins to develop various schemes to get ahead of Mielle, as well as humiliate her and destroy her reputation in ways that parallel Aria’s downfall in the original line of events. Having been quite frank and spoiled after her initial rise in social standing (among other things, refusing to eat vegetables, deeming them commoner food she had more than enough of), Aria now learns to put on a mask and behave in more efficacious ways with regards to her public image.

In doing so, Aria makes various allies, who lead her to experience sincere kindness and affection for the first time in her life. She also catches the attention of Asterope Franz, who respects her due to her sharp intellect and hopes to recruit her as one of his advisors, forming quite a close relationship with him. She remarks herself that she might not have become such a sinister individual had she received such warm and welcoming treatment in her original life. Nevertheless, Aria remains determined to pay back Mielle and does not even consider abandoning her desire for revenge.

Aria is quite intelligent and a fast learner, mastering subjects she had not had any training in in her previous life rather quickly and setting up elaborate schemes to not only destroy her stepsister on a personal and social level, but ruin her in the most humiliating way possible. She is able to turn back time using her hourglass around five minutes every day, though doing so exhausts her severely; she makes use of this power frequently to get out of dangerous situations and put herself in a favorable position with other people.

Asterope is the Crown Prince of the empire. He goes by "Asher" to avoid telling Aria he's part of the royal family. He first meets Aria when he's in town investigating the casino case and she's retrieving her repaired hourglass.

Asher is described as an exceptionally tall young man with short black hair and highly handsome facial features. He has an angled face, pale skin, and ears that redden when embarrassed. Although Asher’s build is rather slender overall, he has very wide shoulders. Most prominently, his eyes have a distinct blue color which is commonly remarked upon in the novel.
Mielle Roscent is the half sister of [Aria Roscent](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent).
Lohan is the young king of the kingdom of Croa, and a close acquaintance of [Asher](https://anilist.co/character/175473/Asterope-Franz).

Sarah is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s private tutor and the only daughter of Viscount Loren. She is kindhearted and an expert at embroidery.

Sarah is one of Aria's closest friends and allies. Though Aria initially only gets close to her because she knows from her first life that she gets married to [Marquis Vincent](https://anilist.co/character/355805), a powerful figure in the aristocratic party, she ends up truly caring for Sarah as well.

~!She later becomes the principal and etiquette teacher at the Imperial Academy for Commoners. After Aria marries [Prince Asterope](https://anilist.co/character/175473/Asterope-Franz), Sarah also becomes known as "the Crown Princess's Best Friend."!~

Carin is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s biological mother. She's a former sex worker who is now married to [Count Roscent](https://anilist.co/character/355799/Count-Roscent). Because she was born a commoner, other nobles look down on her and Aria, though she doesn't care what others say about her.

Carin is a confident woman who cares deeply for her daughter. She does not truly love Count Roscent, and only married him so that she and Aria could escape poverty and have a better life.

~!She later divorces Count Roscent and marries Aria's biological father, [Chloe Piast](https://anilist.co/character/355806/Chloe-Piast), after reuniting with him.!~
Oscar is the brother of [Isis](https://anilist.co/character/355794) and soon-to-be fiancé of [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent). He is softhearted and meek.

Annie is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s maid. She was initially sent by [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/355791/Emma) and [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent) as a spy, but Aria soon brings her over to her side.

~!Annie later marries [Baron Burboom](https://anilist.co/character/355793/Baron-Burboom).!~

~!Bliss is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent) and [Asher](https://anilist.co/character/175473/Asterope-Franz)'s daughter from the future, as well as [Lippe](https://anilist.co/character/355808/Lippe-Franz)'s twin sister. She has the ability to travel through time and space.!~

Jessie is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s maid. She is a kindhearted and loyal servant who genuinely cares for Aria.

~!After Aria becomes the crown princess, Jessie is promoted to her secretary. She also later gets married to [Hans](https://anilist.co/character/355804/Hans).!~
Lane is a noble who works for [Asher](https://anilist.co/character/175473/Asterope-Franz).
Sorke is a man who works for [Asher](https://anilist.co/character/175473/Asterope-Franz).

Baron Burboom is a nobleman who runs a family-owned scented oil business.

~!He later marries [Annie](https://anilist.co/character/355790/Annie).!~

Chloe is the son of [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/355796) and [Marquis Piast](https://anilist.co/character/355801/Piast-Hujak). He grew up in the imperial family as the son of David Franz and Violet, but 17 years ago it was revealed that he had been born out of wedlock, resulting in Chloe and Violet being banished from the empire. They currently reside in Croa.

~!He is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s biological father. After finally reuniting with her mother, [Carin](https://anilist.co/character/355787/Carin-Roscent), after desperately searching for her for the past 17 years, the two get married.!~

~!Lippe is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent) and [Asher](https://anilist.co/character/175473/Asterope-Franz)'s daughter from the future, as well as [Bliss](https://anilist.co/character/355797)'s twin sister. She has the ability to travel through time and space.!~

Cain is the firstborn son of House Roscent. He is [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent)'s older brother and [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s half-brother. Because Aria and her mother were commoners, Cain dislikes and looks down on them. In Aria's first life, he was the one who cut off her head.

Emma is [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent)'s personal servant. She acts as head of the maids, and is often the one who comes up with schemes against [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent). Emma has worked at House Roscent for a long time, and is like a mother to Mielle.

Isis is the most powerful noble in the capital, second only to the royal family. She is an intelligent and cunning woman who holds the real authority in House Frederick, rather than her brother [Oscar](https://anilist.co/character/355788/Oscar-Frederick).

~!After being sentenced to death and beheaded, Isis is reincarnated into the body of a commoner in Croa named Nekke.!~

Frey is a member of the imperial family who is unmarried and working as a judge. She presided over [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s trial.

~!She is the daughter of [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/355796/Violet-Piast) and is the half-sister of Aria's biological father, [Chloe](https://anilist.co/character/355806/Chloe-Piast).!~

Violet is the mother of [Frey](https://anilist.co/character/355795/Frey-Franz) and [Chloe](https://anilist.co/character/355806/Chloe-Piast) and the wife of [Marquis Piast](https://anilist.co/character/355801/Piast-Hujak).

Violet was previously a member of the imperial family through marriage, but she and Chloe were banished from the empire 17 years ago when it was discovered that Chloe had been born out of wedlock. She currently resides in Croa.
Berry is a maid who originally works for [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent), and then is sent over to [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent) as a spy.

Count Roscent is [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s adoptive father who married her mother, [Carin](https://anilist.co/character/355787/Carin-Roscent). He is also the father of [Mielle](https://anilist.co/character/216776/Mielle-Roscent) and [Cain Roscent](https://anilist.co/character/355784/Cain-Roscent).
John is one of [Aria](https://anilist.co/character/168283/Aria-Roscent)'s guards.
Marquis Piast is [Violet](https://anilist.co/character/355796/Violet-Piast)'s husband and [Chloe](https://anilist.co/character/355806/Chloe-Piast)'s father. He is from Croa.

Hans is commoner working as a newsboy.

~!He later gets married to [Jessie](https://anilist.co/character/355785/Jessie).!~
Marquis Vincent is a high-ranking nobleman and a powerful figure in the aristocratic party. He gets married to [Sarah](https://anilist.co/character/355786/Sarah-Loren).
Vika is a well-known nobleman and an acquaintance of [Asher](https://anilist.co/character/175473/Asterope-Franz).
Andrew is [Annie](https://anilist.co/character/355790/Annie)'s brother.

synonyms: I Got a Fake Job at the Academy
description:
Machiavelli and Gerrard are just one of the many names the new professor of Ceoren Academy uses to disguise his identity, and now he can add one more to his list, Professor Ludger Cherish. The real Ludger Cherish dies on board a train during a terrorist attack, making him the perfect target for a new identity. Little does the new professor know, Ludger Cherish was involved in something deep and secret. The new Professor Ludger has to be careful to not get caught by the school and the dangerous secret society.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: A fake professor at Ceoren Academy.

__Relative(s):__ Kaden Lumos(Father), Kamal Lumos(Brother), Katrina Lumos(Sister)

Flora is a second-year student who is a genius among the students at Ceoren Academy. Although she is a very outstanding student, Flora is treated very poorly within her family just because she is born out of wedlock.

Elisa is the president of Ceoren Academy and a sixth-circle mage. She suspects that Ludger Cherish has switched places with the real Ludger and has infiltrated the academy, despite her suspicions, she highly regards his abilities and character as a professor.

Celina is a new spirit professor who likes fairy tales. ~!She is a personality made by Esmeralda to use to interact with other people. Celina knew nothing of Black Dawn Society which Esmeralda is a part of.!~
A true vampire who has lived for over 1,000 years and is Ludger's teacher.
Terinna is the commander and the Security Bureau's lord protector of the Nightcrawler Knights.
Hans is a member of the U.N. Owen and, even though he is a coward, he is the strongest when it comes to combat. Whenever he's bitten by an animal, he turns half-human, half-animal against his will.
The 3rd Princess of the Exilion Empire and currently a sophomore. She is friends with Rene.

Sedena is a half-elven blood Third Order of the Black Dawn Society. She is also a student and the assistant of Heathcliff at Ceoren Academy.

~!Sedena now works as a double agent to gather more information about the Black Dawn Society for U.N. Owen.!~
Chris is a professor at Ceoren Academy who teaches conjuration. He is someone who discriminates against other social classes and uses tricks in duels, but does not discriminate against patients.
John is a First Order in Black Dawn Society who disguised himself as Ludger Cherish in order to infiltrate the Ceoren Academy. He died during a terrorist attack at the beginning of the story.
Bruno is the new professor in charge of teaching the students on golems.
Marie has been working at Ceoren Academy for over 20 years as a pharmacology professor.
Merida is a new professor at Ceoren Academy who teaches charms and visions. She is a part of the Curses and Benediction Department.
Veronica is the vice-captain of Knights of Cold Steel. She is cruel and shows no mercy to anything that seems wicked.
Lemlus is an employee of Rederbelke's Metropolitan Police Agency.

synonyms: I Want to Be You, Just for a Day
ชิงชีวิตพลิกลิขิตชะตา
description:
Tensions are brewing under the seemingly calm surface of the Vasilios Empire, a kingdom ruled by the Imperial Family and the Temple. Lady Medea Solon has lost her place next to Crown Prince Eros, but resolves to do whatever it will take to win back what's rightfully hers. Will she reclaim her throne?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5' 6")

As a reputable, high-ranking noble, Medea possesses a certain level of haughtiness. Though she exhibits proper grace and savoir-faire in public as the duke's daughter, she is also known to have an unpleasant temper. Medea often treats those of lower class, typically ordinary civilians and servants, with contempt and condescension. Many find it difficult to associate with her, believing that her terrible personality will cause her trouble in finding a suitor. Since childhood, Medea is disciplined and diligent in her aspirations to become an individual worthy of being recorded in history. She is extremely intelligent and has extensive knowledge on a wide breadth of subjects, including literature and political affairs. [Eros](https://anilist.co/character/159254/Eros-Orna-Vasilios) once mentioned that Medea is so sharp that she can read an entire situation from a single sentence or glance. She is also thoroughly trained in the art of swordsmanship and taught the fiercest warrior of the empire, [Helio](https://anilist.co/character/159251/Helio-Travium).

__Background:__

~!Medea grew up in the wealthy House of Solon as the eldest daughter of the duke and duchess. As a child, Medea was a sweet, intelligent, and obedient daughter. She exhibited great prowess in the art of swordsmanship and excelled in her studies. One particular tutor observed that Medea was able to master at the age of eight subjects that women typically could not learn until their coming-of-age ceremonies. Despite her efforts, Medea was never able to appease her mother, Duchess Solon, with her accomplishments. The duchess insisted that Medea had to achieve a reputation worthy of being recorded in history. Thus, under her parents' heavy scrutiny and immense pressure, Medea grew to become excessively obsessive with her studies, regularly compromising her mental and physical health. She believed that she could earn her parents' love by becoming the most intelligent person in the empire. She learned to value building her reputation in high society over creating genuine relationships with others. The only people she truly cherished were Helio, her childhood friend whom she taught swordsmanship to, and Nana, a maid in the House of Solon who cared for her in place of Medea's neglectful, critical parents.!~

~!Eventually, Medea's intelligence exceeded that of her father's; she, therefore, used it to privately consult him on political affairs. During the war against the Hennel Kingdom, Medea gave Thesion advice that greatly contributed to the Vasilios Empire's eventual victory. After learning that her father was taking credit for her ideas in public, Medea realized that she could never earn her parents' love and subsequently ceased any attempt to gratify them. Instead, she sought to achieve a status higher than that of a duke's daughter. The opportunity presented itself when Emperor Vasilios proposed that Medea would wed the crown prince and become the reigning crown princess of Vasilios!~

__Height:__ 156 cm (5' 1")

__Background:__
~!Psyche grew up in the wealthy House of Callista as the only daughter of the count and countess. Since birth, Psyche possessed the divine power to heal. She was capable of healing minor to relatively major wounds on her own body, and on those of others within a certain vicinity. Because she had no voluntary control over this ability, Psyche was confined to the basement of the count's manor, forbidden to enter the outside world. Her mother, Countess Callista, wished to protect Psyche and her divine power from being discovered by greedy nobles. Psyche was taught to never question the "god" who had blessed her with divinity and to obediently remain hidden. Even as a child, Psyche wondered why she should appreciate a god who abandoned her in the eternal darkness. Many years later, Psyche reached young adulthood and was finally freed from the basement. Expensive furnitures and lavish decorations were delivered to furnish Psyche's new bed chambers. Psyche then met [Eros](https://anilist.co/character/159254/Eros-Orna-Vasilios), who claimed responsibility for her freedom. Assuming he was her true "god" for freeing her from the darkness, Psyche immediately devoted herself and fell in love with him. She reminded herself to never doubt or question her "god," thus never learning his true identity!~

__Height:__ 177-185 cm (5' 8"- 6' 1")

Helio Niccolo is one of the main characters of Your Throne. He is the young Marquess of the House of Niccolo and the childhood friend of [Medea Solon](https://anilist.co/character/159252/Medea-Belial).
He is the cardinal of Temple of Vasilios.

Dekis is a supporting character of Your Throne and a former lord of the House of Solon (Belial). He is the son of Thesion and the older brother of Medea.
~!He fled the family after discovering the truth behind their fortune and success.!~

She was a maid in the House of Solon and the unofficial caretaker of [Medea Belial](https://anilist.co/character/159252/Medea-Belial).

~!After the crown princess competition, Nana was severely injured as punishment and eventually killed by [Helio Travium](https://anilist.co/character/159251/Helio-Travium)!~
Count Polly is the father of [Psyche Polly](https://anilist.co/character/159250/Psyche-Polly)
Bertie is a maid serving Medea's family.
Lin is Psyche's maid.
Thesion Solon is the father of [Medea Belial](https://anilist.co/character/159252).

description:
Ji-Han Han is your typical high school student -- minus the fact the he’s acquired the special ability to view the world around him as a video-game. Not long after this discovery, he stumbles upon a hidden world filled with others just like him. Now, amidst juggling homework and completing quests, Ji-Han must learn how to navigate his newfound power in order to level up in life.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

characters.description: Han Jee-Han (한지한, Hanjihan) also known as "The Gamer" is the main protagonist of the manhwa The Gamer. Jee-Han has recently discovered that he has a Natural Ability called The Gamer. This ability makes him experience his life in a game-like setting which was derived from his gaming addiction.
Lolikiano Mistream, the Witch of Slaughter is a powerful sage from Europe who specializes in killing weak opponents and devil summoning.

Shin Sun-Il (신선일, Sinseon-il) is Han Jee-Han's childhood friend and a member of Year 2 Class 8. He is also the heir of one of the ruling martial arts clans of the Abyss in Seoul region called Chunbumoon. He is the deuteragonist of the series.

Kwon Shi-Yun (권시연, Gwon shi-yeon) is the tritagonist of The Gamer and a High School student who transferred into 2nd Year Class 8. She hails from the Yunhonmoon clan, the clan that opposes but is currently allied with Chunbumoon.
Hwan Sung-Ah (환성아, Hwanseong-a) is a second year High School student and Ability user currently going to the same school as Han Jee-Han. She is Hwan Sung-Gon's daughter.

Poong Sae-Young (풍세영, Pungseyeong) is a member of Chunbumoon and an Olympic Medalist in Women's Taekwondo. She is also the cousin of Shin Sun-Il and granddaughter of Shin Sun-Oh and heir to a unique branch of martial arts within the Chunbumoon.

Hwan Sung-Gon (환성곤, Hwangseon-gon) is a mysterious Natural Ability user who is came to soul collecting Soul Stones to save his daughter, Hwan Sung-Ah. He recently got instated as a replacement Chemistry teacher and he has connections to the Irregular Magician.

He is extremely powerful summoner and fighter. His rank in Abyss is SSS.

Horutipia Aholting is an European Natural ability user hired by Hwan Sung-Gon to kill all the cleaners coming after him and his daughter. He is a druid warrior that supports his coworker: Lolikiano Mistream.

Han Jung-Sook is the mother of Han Ji-Han. She is the only person with an unknown level and class even after Jee-Han used Observe on her. Jung-Suk is a responsible mother and she often goes to the fitness centers although this may only be a front.

synonyms: Death God of the Drifting Moon
description:
Pyo-Wol was an orphan who wandered around the continent until he bumped into a mysterious man and lost consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself in a dark, confined space with only one iron door for an exit. Wol survives the next several grueling months, trying to keep a cool head and stay in shape. When the iron door finally opens, he discovers he's not the only one in this miserable situation. A group of masked people has kidnapped 300 children to train them into human weapons. Wol must fight and kill the others, for only a handful of the strongest will be selected. Will Wol be able to become one of the chosen and find a way to free himself from his captors?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Su-Chan Jang is an extraordinary college student at the top of the social food chain. But underneath the perfect facade, he hides a pair of insect wings that suddenly grew when he used a mysterious bug spray called "Jungle Juice.” Su-Chan's life crumbles when he bares his wings to the world to save someone's life. When all hope seems lost, Su-Chan stumbles upon a hidden world of insect humans where everyone is accepted for what they are. But the law of the jungle governs this secret society and all must fend for themselves in order to survive.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: A punkish, hard-drinking party girl in Practical Entomology. She's unusual in that she was merged with a scorpion, an arachnid, rather than an insect and was subject to numerous tests and studies before being allowed to join the class.
He is a student in NEST, enrolling in Jun Ji's class in hoping to acquire Cinderella.

description:
There are two kinds of people with special abilities: villains, who are driven by their evil desires, and psykers, who pursue justice and work against villains. Cassian Lee is a very powerful psyker with a good heart. But one day, when he visits his friend in Greece, things take a wrong turn. Following an unexpected chain of events, Cassian ends up in the body of a Korean high school boy... who has just become a villain! Will his sense of justice win in the end or will he end up becoming a cold-blooded villain?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: B+ rank villain of the Gadam Vilzone.
One of Don King's eight commanders.

description:
While running for his life in the woods, bullying victim Gyu-Hwan stumbles upon a shotgun and just enough shells for his classmates. It’s a recipe for disaster. But fate takes an unexpected turn when he returns to find his classmates under attack by brain-eating creatures. Now, the only thing that stands in the way of their ravenous feast is a boy with a shotgun.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

characters.description: Gyu-Hwan Han is the main protagonist of Shotgun Boy and a student at Yeongchan High. He is the school outcast who stumbles upon a major secret.
Gyuhwan's classmate who's good at archery and an outcast in their grade.
The bully of Gyuh-wan Han.
The main non-human antagonist of Shotgun Boy. He is the de facto leader of the variants experimented on by the MM Corporation.
Zero is one of the variants.
A foreign teacher at Yeongchan High
The homeroom teacher of Class 1 at Yeongchan High

The main character of the story. An isolated, lonely teenager who is forced to move when his family dies in a traffic accident. He is eighteen years old and stopped going to high school due to unknown reasons. He spends his time trolling and tricking on internet, as well as playing various RPGs. He sold his old house and moved into Green Home apartments (room 1410) because the money left by his deceased family was insufficient for him to survive as an isolated person. He then proceeds to chose October 25th as a date to commit suicide.

~!Hyun is a human infected with the monsterization, but fights back against both his impending mutation and the monsters that have overtaken the world.!~ His weapon of choice is a handmade electric spear, powered by a large battery that he carries in his backpack.

It was revealed in chapters 81 and 82 that ~!Hyun had a rather happy childhood. Up until his high school years, he was the pride of his family. However, in high school he was targeted by a rich bully who made sure that Hyun was socially excluded. Eventually, even his own sister started excluding him by claiming that he wasn't her brother. His parents took little action, due to the fact that the bully's father was owner of the company Hyun's dad worked at. They did however talk to the school, and the bully stopped picking on him after that incident. However, Hyun was traumatized from the experience, and came out a different person. Eventually, he fell into suicidal thoughts and developed a history of self harm.!~

Eighteen year old Hyuk Lee is the leader of the Green Roof Apartments Survivors and Eun Lee's older brother. He is also one of the deuteragonists of the series with the others being some of the Green Roof Apartment survivors.

Hyuk is an intelligent and level-headed young man with an affinity for leadership. He often plans the many missions the survivors need to undertake. He is unafraid to take risks and is pragmatic, such as accepting an infected human into their ranks, if it helps boost their success rates. He also was prepared to take underhanded measures to tip the odds in his favor. However, as other survivors have learned, Hyuk is extremely blunt in speech and often says things rudely or in a way that would draw their ire. Hyuk is aware of this trait and either uses it to energize people or to provoke people for his own enjoyment. Due to his video game playing habits, he occasionally offers explanations using video game terminology. Because of this and his bluntness, it often embarrasses his sister Eun. Despite this, Hyuk deeply cares about Eun. He notices her actions and is able to deduce that Eun has a crush on Hyun. Hyuk also possesses empathetic traits but masks it greatly for both survival and so that no biases are made when it came to decision making as a leader. However, if there is no harm to the survivors, Hyuk would let emotions and morality guide his decisions.

Jay-Hun is a survivor of the Green Roof Apartments. Jayhun is usually seen with Ji-Su. Jay-Hun was a devout Christian, which other apartment residents found odd. However, despite what he believed in, Jay-Hun was very tolerant of other beliefs. Through Jay-Hun's faith, he was able to work up the courage to do things that would otherwise terrify him. He was also very kindhearted towards others, even towards Hyun Cha who is infected. Jay-Hun used a sword as his weapon.

A young girl, who is Hyuk's little sister. She is quite childlike and even a liar. She is part of the Helping Squad. She has a crush on Hyun.

Shortly after being born, Eun and Hyuk's mother died. Only a few years later, their father's company goes bankrupt and the two are left at an orphanage, and their stay becomes permanent when their father dies in an accident. At the time, Eun was still very young; however, she did not appear to take the events well as she started an underage smoking habit. She and Hyuk eventually move to Green Home.

description:
Once the bullies target you, it’s game over. The school is run by tyrants whose favorite hobby is tormenting the weakest kids in class. But then Gray arrived. This mysterious new student threatens to dismantle the established order. He may be small in stature, but his calculative and brutal fighting leaves unsuspecting opponents lying on the floor begging for mercy. Now the school's toughest bullies have to scramble to take down this new and unusual hero.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
__Height__: 158 cm (5'2")
__Shuttle Patch Website Ranking:__ ~!8th!~

The central protagonist of Weak Hero. Currently a first year at Eunjang High School in Class 1-5, and also attends Hero Cram School in the afternoons. Known by the epithet of "Eunjang's White Mamba", he is notorious for his extremely dirty fighting tactics and uncannily reserved nature.

__Height__: 181.6 cm (5'11.5")

Ben Park, also known by his epithet Big Ben, is the deuteragonist of Weak Hero. Currently, in his first year at Eunjang High School, he is in Class 1-8 and is considered by many to be the strongest in the school. A talented and powerful fighter, Ben Park is infamous for his physical strength, currently ranked 2nd on the Shuttle Patch website.

__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")

A man of few words, Gerard appears at first glance to be a mostly silent and antisocial individual, rarely interacting with others and not speaking unless first spoken to. However, it appears that his quiet personality is mostly a result of his lack of friends, as when seen with Ben Park, Gray Yeon, Alex Go, etc. he freely interacts with them and can carry a conversation easily.

On occasion, Gerard has even been shown to attempt active interaction with his friends. Gerard is quite sensitive of his hair, becoming comically irritated whenever he is teased about it by his friends. However, he refuses to change it. He also carries several eccentric habits, such as when Rowan found him sleeping in a flower bed.

Despite all his quirks, while fighting, Gerard has shown himself to be a capable and level-headed opponent, able to maintain a cool head in the midst of battle and only retaliating against his attackers when things go too far.

__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

Alex is hot-headed and short-tempered, known to power through his fights on pure guts and grit alone. He has mellowed out somewhat after middle school and ignores the trash talk that once enraged him.

Despite his temper, he is very caring towards his friends, especially exhibited when he expressed concern for Gray when he was hospitalized.

__Height:__ 169 cm (5'6.5")

Teddy Jin is a secondary character of the Webtoon Weak Hero. He is a student in Class 1-1 of Eunjang High School. He was an infamous bully from Seong-Il Middle School. Initially, a supporting antagonist of the Eunjang Arc, his fight with Gray Yeon has humbled Teddy into becoming an ally of Gray taking on a more anti-heroic role. Following the Hyeongshin Takedown Operation, Teddy has become a reluctant ally of Ben Park's Gang.

__Height:__ 180.35 cm (5'11")

Donald Na is the main antagonist in the webtoon, Weak Hero. He is currently attending Yeo-il High School and the leader of the Yeongdeungpo Union.

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Wolf Keum is a supporting antagonist in Weak Hero. Wolf is the representative of Ganghak High School and the newest member of the Yeongdeungpo Union, holding the fifth ranking on the Shuttle Patch website. He is known for his overly cruel and violent nature, as stated by Eugene when talking about the Union.

Stephen Ahn was Gray Yeon's classmate and best friend in Byuksan Middle School. He was a model student and an unfortunate set of incidents lead to him being hospitalized and caused Gray to eventually end up enrolling at Eunjang High School.

__Height:__ 180 cm (5'10.5")

Jake Ji is a supporting antagonists in Weak Hero. He is the leader of Daehyeon High School and originally considered the second strongest delinquent of Yeongdeungpo.

Despite being number 2 in the Yeongdeungpo Union, Jake's personality is similar to Ben Park's. Both of them being extremely strong, outgoing and often take things lightly, but if angered, they're almost invincible. Jake is also the leader of his own gang that is similar to Ben Park's Gang, and is very protective of his friends.

~!He was moved down to 3rd after his loss to Ben Park. He is currently only 2 ranks lower than Donald Na himself.!~

__Height:__ 166 cm (5'5.5")

Eugene Gale is a secondary character in Weak Hero. He is a first year student of Eunjang High, of Class 1-5. Eugene is Gray Yeon's closest friend in Eunjang High and a member of Ben Park's Gang. Eugene is an absolute fanatic of the delinquent gang's in Yeongdeungpo. Though he has no fighting capabilities, he possesses a wide variety of knowledge regarding the delinquent gang's of Yeongdeungpo, making him the gang's info broker.

Eugene is quiet and a rather distant person to new people or people who seem “like a bully," but the opposite to people he feels comfortable around. He is a kindhearted person as he is often buying drinks for the group or Eunjang High students after a fight. Eugene is very compliant person, especially to “bullies” known from the past as a shuttle or aka an errand-runner.

__Height:__ 182 cm (5'11")

Rowan Im is a recurring character in the webtoon Weak Hero. After coming back from living in Australia, Rowan now studies at Eunjang High School in Class 1. He is old friends with Eugene Gale.

Rowan is considered to be an airhead and exaggerator of the highest degree. He is also an avid admirer of power, worshipping those stronger than him. He loves talking and often exaggerates about his accomplishments or the accomplishments of others. However, his bravado and loyalty to his allies make him a worthy friend.

__Height:__ 183 cm (6')

Jimmy Bae is a supporting antagonist of the Weak Hero. He is a first year at Yoosun High School. He is the head of Yoosun High and a member of the Yeongdeungpo Union.

Hyeok-Jin is a student at Daehyeon High School, and a member of the Yeongdeungpo Union under his best friend Jake Ji's leadership. He is notoriously known as the number 2 of Daehyeon, being only behind Jake Ji.

~!He is shuttle patch rank 10.!~
Fights alongside Dong-Ha Baek to form the infamous Mok-Ha Duo.
Gong-Sam is a student at Hyeongshin High School and is a part of Forest Lee's gang. During middle school, he was severely bullied by Wolf Keum.
Fights alongside Seong-Mok Do to form the infamous Mok-Ha Duo.

__Height:__ 185.42cm (6'1")

Se-Han Lee is a first-year at Hyeongshin High School, the newest head of Hyeongshin High School, and a member of the Yeongdeungpo Union after the dismissal of Myles Joo. He is a supporting antagonist of the Webtoon Weak Hero serving as a secondary antagonist of the Eunjang Arc.
Eun Chan Hong is a minor antagonist who is friends with Jake Ji and Dean Kwon. He is currently attending Daehyeon however was suspended from school for undisclosed reasons during his introduction.

Myles Joo is the original head of Hyeongshin High and a former member of the Yeongdeungpo Union before he was excommunicated by Donald Na for attempting a coup by allying with the former Manwol Union. He is now the leader of the remnants of the Manwol Union, and is considered the fourth strongest delinquent in Yeongdeungpo.

~!He is shuttled patch rank 4.!~
Seok-Hyeon is a supporting antagonist in the Webtoon, Weak Hero. He is Donald Na's right-hand man and a member of the Yeo-il High School Student Council.
Timothy Park is a minor supporting character in the manhwa Weak Hero. He goes to Daehyeon High and is a friend of Jake Ji. He is especially skilled at gathering data and analyzing it.
Nak-Seong is a minor antagonist in the Webtoon, Weak Hero. He is attending Daehyeon High School and is a very notorious fighter who once was rumored to be on par with Jake Ji.
Harper "Helmet" Ha is a student at Yoosun High School. He is affiliated with the Union and is under Jimmy Bae's command.

title.english: The Regressed Mercenary Has a Plan

synonyms: El mercenario que regresó tiene un plan
逆行傭兵は全て計画済み
แผนเปลี่ยนชะตาของทหารรับจ้าง
description:
Cecil Perdium, the Mercenary King, was killed in battle before he could avenge his family. As he faces death, he learns that Duke Delphine, the man who caused the downfall of his family, didn't work alone. Suddenly waking up as his teenage self, Cecil must work to both overcome his poor reputation and build up his strength to save his family. With their soldiers and knights defecting due to the harsh conditions they must endure, he has his work cut out for him. Can Cecil become the mighty warrior he once was and avert his family's fate?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
Born into the noble Perdium family, Ghislain Perdium harbored a deep resentment toward his household. Consumed by feelings of inferiority, he lashed out in defiance, pushing away those around him. As his reckless behavior worsened, the once proud Perdium estate grew distant, and isolation became his only companion. Unable to endure the growing scorn, he abandoned his home, leaving his past behind.

Years of hardship forged him into something new. As a mercenary, he fought, bled, and survived, sharpening his skills until he stood among the strongest warriors on the continent. He became known as the "King of Mercenaries," a title feared and respected across the land.

But no battlefield victory could erase his regrets. Seeking redemption, Ghislain finally returned to the Perdium Estate, only to find it in ruins. His sister, Elena Perdium, had perished, setting off a chain of events that dragged their household into the flames of war. By the time he arrived, it was too late. The family he once abandoned no longer existed.

Now, given a second chance, he refuses to let history repeat itself.

She is Ghislain Perdium's personal tutor. Since he was little she was the only one who continued to stay by his side despite his idiotic antics. But in Ghislain's past life, after the family fell to ruins, she went missing.

She has taken care of him since childhood and treats him like a son. Ghislain Perdium's mother was the one who brought her to take care of her son. She managed all the funds Ghislain received to maintain his noble status. She is a powerful assassin who acts as Ghislain's bodyguard. She is a specialist in the creation and use of poisons. She would not hesitate to kill and sacrifice allies to save her master.

She's from the Red Flame Tower. She has a genius brain with outstanding knowledge and wisdom, but unfortunately, her constitution itself does not allow her to learn circles like ordinary magicians, so she was ignored when she was in the tower.
Daughter of the Marquess Brandford. She was suffering from a skin disease which Giselle helped cure.

She is the sister of Ghislain Perdium.In past life, she was brutally murdered for war politics and was found in slums later by Ghislaine. After regression, Ghislain kills the perpetrators after finding out who was behind it.
The leader of the Kelveros Mercenary band.
He is the count who protects the north from the barbarians.
The advisor of House Delphine and Duke Delphine'd closest confidant.
Ghislain's fiancée.
Gillian's daughter.
She's a priestess, servant of Juana, the goddess of beauty and abundance.

synonyms: Annarasumanara: El sonido de la magia
АН НА РА СУ МА НА РА
description:
Yun Ai wanted to be a magician when she was little. But now in reality, she is a high school student who cannot even afford new stockings. Since the day she met a real magician at a fair, she desperately wants to follow her dream.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description: ~!Lee Eul or by birth name Ryu Min Hyuk is 30 years old man and protagonist of the Manhwa called Annarasumanara. He was born in Seoul, where he went to school and ranked first place due to his good grades. Yet soon he would drop out and receive treatment for his mental illness, which was due to the high pressure his family and teacher as a police officer implies. Other than that, he is described as smart and handsome yet pure like a child, since he refused to grow up to become a failure as an adult. As such he is abandoned by society and titled as crazy, because he insists he is able to perform real magic.!~

A-I is a girl living alone with her younger sister. She works hard in school and tries to make enough money to afford living expenses. She despises people who lack responsibility, but her life changes when she meets the magician.
Il-Deung is a student who is obsessed with studying and has ranked number one in the whole entire school. He sits next to A-I in class.

title.english: The 100th Regression of the Max-Level Player

synonyms: การกลับมาครั้งที่ 100 ของผู้เล่นเลเวลแม็กซ์
description:
The world was embroiled in a death game involving individuals from ages 15 to 29. Thrown into a game devoid of empathy and compassion, Min Ryu had no choice but to fight for his survival. For the 99th time, he finally made it to the end of the game. Standing alone in front of the final boss’s chamber, Min Ryu was greeted with betrayal as the system killed him for not having four more players with him. On his 100th and final attempt, can Min Ryu find the help he needs to end this ruthless game?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description:
He lost his parents when he was young and was living with his younger brother, Ryu Won, working part-time as the head of a boy. However, he suffered from school violence and was exploited by his part-time job boss.

Then, with the start of the Death Game, his life changes completely. Afterwards, through his 99 regressions,He reaches the final round of 20, but fails because he is the only player left and the requirement for round 20 is 5 people. He eventually decides to aim for a perfect strategy based on the information from his regression as he enters the 100th time.

Ryu Min's classmate. She had a crush on Ryu Min, but couldn't get to tell him. Juri Min also has a bad past; her father failed in business, her mother divorced and left home, and she is in debt, leaving her father to make a living by working at a convenience store.

A celebrity next door to the protagonist. She was mentioned from the beginning as she was a very popular and famous actor. She originally had a soft personality, but she changed after becoming involved with Black Scythe

Ryu Min's younger brother and is in the third year of middle school. He appears to be taller than Ryu Min. He is a fan of Seo A-Rin. His parents passed away early and he is left with his older brother, so he trusts Ryu Min.

He looks gentle as the eldest son of one of Korea's leading conglomerates.

He is also the sponsor of Seo A-Rin.

synonyms: ไอ้เพลเยอร์นั่น ฉันฆ่ามันเอง
description:
Being a character of your favorite game is great! Sure, he’s just a minor NPC, but Corin knows this game like the back of his hand. With his knowledge and the main player Sihu’s abilities, everything’s going smoothly - until Corin discovers Sihu’s been murdering innocent NPCs and stealing their items. Horrified but powerless to stop him, Corin awaits the end of the game - only for Sihu to mysteriously fail at the last mission. Instantly, Corin travels three years back in time. Now, he’s determined to kill Sihu and take on his role - defeat the final boss and save the world.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: The eldest daughter of the Aden family and Alisha's half-sister.
The second princess of the Kingdom of El Ras.
A druid from the Avelorn Forest.
The final boss of 'The Legend of Arhan'. He has a base in the Demon Realm in the northern part of the continent.

synonyms: เลวีอาธาน อสูรใต้ทะเลลึก
description:
The world is submerged, and sea monsters rule the earth. Will Bota and his family ever make it to safety and escape this aquatic hell? And who in the world is Kana?!

(Source: Toomics)

Notes:

- Includes six extra chapters.

- Originally published on Toomics where chapters 1-3 were subsequently combined to form chapters 1-2 on Naver.

characters.description: Kana is one of the main protagonists of Leviathan. She is a three-star Harpoonist from the ship Busan Union who becomes the guardian and mentor for the siblings Bo-Ta and Ri-Ta Ma, the children of her idol Te-On Ma.
Bo-Ta is a drifter who tries to survive the post-apocalyptic waters of the earth.

Ri-Ta Ma (also translated as Li-Ta Ma) is one of the main protagonists of Leviathan. The daughter and youngest child of former Harpoonist Te-On Ma and his wife Narisa, and the younger sister of Bo-Ta Ma, Rita is a young drifter who tries to survive the post-apocalyptic waters of the earth with her brother and their protector, Kana.

Te-On Ma is the father of the series' main protagonists, Bo-Ta and Ri-Ta Ma. Though he is only active during the opening arc of Leviathan, Te-On is a pivotal character whose actions and personality continue to influence the lives of his children.

He was a legendary Harpoonist of the Bosun Union ship, and the only known member to have become a Six-Star Harpoonist before leaving the Union.

Sonia is a former Harpoonist from the Floating City and a former member of the explorer team led by the late Jako Gusto, alongside her partner Gongtae Park, as well as a former resident of Port Oasis. She becomes an associate of the Bo-Ta and Ri-Ta Ma, as well as Kana, joining on their journey.

description:
Yu-Jin is an F-ranker overshadowed by his little brother, an S-ranker. All he does is get in his brother’s way, causing trouble wherever he goes. When a seemingly routine dungeon raid goes wrong and costs Yu-Jin his brother’s life, Yu-Jin decides to use the wish granted by clearing the dungeon to reset his timeline. The plan was to lead a quiet life from now on… but now it turns out he can help other people become S-rankers?! Maybe this is Yu-Jin's chance at building his own entourage of powerful metahumans… but it may be easier said than done.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description:
__Age__: 30 (pre-regression), 25 (post-regression)

Han Yu-Jin is a stat F-rank Hunter. He dedicates his childhood to raising his younger brother Han Yu-Hyeon. When Yu-Hyeonn eventually Awakens as an S-rank Hunter and later sacrifices himself to save his brother's life, Han Yu-Jin goes back in time to prevent his death.

__Age:__ 25 (pre-regression), 20 (post-regression)

Han Yu-Hyeon is one of the strongest Korean S-rank Hunters, and the leader of Haeyeon Guild. He is the younger brother of Han Yu-Jin, for whom he sacrificed himself in the original timeline.
A natural-born S-Class hunter and the guild leader of the Seseong Guild.

Peace was found by Han Yu-Hyeon in a dungeon, and due to his fire-attributed skills, he was taken by him to tame it. Though, he failed to do so, he planned to kill Peace instead, until Han Yu-Jin took him under his wing and successfully tamed him.

Park Yerim is the second female S-class hunter in Korea, who awakened with the help of Han Yu-Jin, her legal guardian after severing her ties with her abusive uncle & aunt. Before the regression, she had originally awakened as an A-class hunter. She is contracted with Han Yu-Jin, and is currently a member of Haeyeon Guild.

Yu Myeong-U is an F-class awakener who receives an SS-rank skill that allows him to craft any type of weapon or armor that enhance the user's abilities. As Han Yu-Jin played a major role for helping him achieve the skill, Yu Myeong-U is forever in debt to Han Yu-Jin, resulting in becoming best friends.

synonyms: 再婚承認を要求します
การแต่งงานครั้งใหม่ของจักรพรรดินี
description:
Navier Ellie Trovi was an empress perfect in every way -- intelligent, courageous, and socially adept. She was kind to her subjects and devoted to her husband. Navier was perfectly content to live the rest of her days as the wise empress of the Eastern Empire. That is, until her husband brought home a mistress and demanded a divorce. “I accept this divorce… And I request an approval of my remarriage.” In a shocking twist, Navier remarries another emperor and retains her title and childhood dream as empress. But just how did everything unfold?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Empress of the Eastern Empire.

~!He is the one [Empress Navier](https://anilist.co/character/173730/Navier-Ellie-Trobi) ends up remarrying !~
Emperor of the Eastern Empire
Koshar is the older brother of Navier.
Grand Duke Kaufman is a Prince from the desert Kingdom of Luipt and a knowledgeable magician.

Mistress of Emperor Soveishu.

~!She ends up marrying Soveishu later in the story!~

synonyms: How to Protect the Heroine’s Older Brother
The Way to Protect the Female Lead's Older Brother
Как защитить старшего брата главной героини
保护女主角哥哥的方法
ロクサナ〜悪女がヒロインの兄を守る方法〜
ฉันขอปกป้องพี่ชายนางเอก
description:
Kidnapping, murder, and risqué relationships! Within the scandalous pages of The Abysmal Flower, the downfall of Roxana Agrece's criminal family is already foretold. So when Cassis Pedelian, the heroine's older brother, is kidnapped by Roxana's father, she can either wait for the heroine's revenge... or take matters into her own hands, since Cassis is the key to her survival. But with deceitful characters on all sides, can Roxana and Cassis trust each other enough to bring down the brutal Agreces?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description:
The name Roxana means "bright, sun, sunlight, sun god, day, dawn". She was named by her father.

Roxana Agriche is the main character of the Roxana series. She is the daughter of Lante Agriche and Sierra Agriche, and the biological younger sister of Achille Agriche.

Roxana is a very cunning individual who has developed the ability to manipulate or deceive others in order to survive or obtain what she wants. While she is always poised and mellow-voiced, she is also able to cut others with her words.

~!As a child, Roxana had no initial desire to follow her cruel family traditions. However, her brother Achille Agriche's death was a wake-up call that led her to work for her father's favour. On the surface, she is always ready to do as told by Lante, working hard to please him and make him proud, hence why he has declared multiple times with pride that she takes after him in many ways. On the inside, she would fully express all her disgust toward her whole family besides Jeremy to a certain extent.!~

~!As part of the tests or 'education' of the Agriche, Roxana has an immunity to poison by drinking such doses daily in mix with her drinks.

Throughout the events of the manhwa, with the help of her knowledge of the novel, "The Abysmal Flower". Roxanna managed to locate the eggs of poisonous butterflies, which are demonic species.
The poisonous butterflies are powerful weapons when used correctly. It can be used to not only hurt enemies, but also use them as trackers or spies if the owner desires.!~

Jeremy is childish and very reckless. He gets very angry when someone tries to harm his sister Roxana Agriche. Because he grew up in a loveless house, he craves his older half-sister's affection and gets easily jealous when someone takes her attention away from him.

Deon is very intelligent and ruthless, even compared to the other Agriche children. He rarely shows emotions unless it is involving his half-sister Roxana Agriche, but has shown to be as sadistic as his parents when he attacked Cassis Pedelian.

Dion is Lant and Maria's child. Like all children of the Agriche, he went through the same education. He is responsible of the death of Achille Agriche.
The heroine of the original novel. Cassis Fedelian's younger sister. She is in favor of Roxana and hopes to connect her with her brother.
[Achille's](https://anilist.co/character/287117/Achille-Agriche) and [Roxana's](https://anilist.co/character/207021/Roxana-Agriche) Mother.

Lant Agriche is the head of the Agriche family. He is a cruel man who will not hesitate to kill his own children if they decide to turn their back on him or are not useful to the family. He views his children as his dogs who should follow his every order.

Achille Agriche is a minor character in the series Roxana. He was the only full blooded sibling of [Roxana Agriche](https://anilist.co/character/207021/Roxana-Agriche).

Achille has curly blonde hair and blue eyes that matches his mother. He is a slender boy, noticeably taller than Roxana Agriche.

Achille was very kind and did not like participating in the ways of the Agriche. He did not posses practical skills either.

After failing the monthly exam by not being able to kill the target in the chamber of illusions, Achille was killed by his half-brother Dion.
Luzak Castro is the heir of the Castro family. He has a phobia of women. He gets easily provoked by Jeremy and is quick to threaten bodily harm.

Charlotte Agriche is a side character of the series Roxana.

Charlotte is reckless, spiteful, and haughty. She has been spoiled to the point where when someone denies something for her, she throws a huge tantrum. She can be easily manipulated, as Jeremy did when he wanted someone to mess up the new toy or as Cassis did with her to be freed from the basement.
[Dion's](https://anilist.co/character/207020/Dion-Agriche) Mother.

title.english: How to Win My Husband Over

synonyms: How to Get My Husband on My Side
วิธีดึงสามีมาเป็นพวก
Como Fazer de Um Marido Uma Aliança
description:
I thought I’d finally escaped my hellish life when I died in an airplane crash, but I fell into another nightmare when I awoke as Rudbeckia de Borgia, a minor villain from a historical novel destined to die at the hands of her husband, Iske van Omerta. Surviving with the dysfunctional Borgia family is hard enough, but now I have to marry the man who will kill me! Still, it’s okay, I just have to convince Iske, his family, and all his countrymen that I’m completely harmless! How hard can that be?

(Source: Tapas)

__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")

synonyms: สูตรสำเร็จแห่งการเกิดใหม่
description:
Despite having only one arm, Daven had finally proven his worth after defeating his cousin Kazin in honorable combat. But Kazin took advantage of Daven’s mercy, stabbing him in the back and imprisoning him for life. 500 years later, the minor god Yulian is reborn and unknowingly summons Daven’s soul into the body of a young boy named Vincent Adenka. As the pair work to reveal the truth of Daven and Kazin, Vincent must relearn the art of combat while Yulian discovers the art of reincarnation.

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: リターン・トゥ・プレイヤー
description:
Ten years ago, a group of gods turned everyone on Earth into players of a sadistic game that forced them to kill monsters in real life -- or be killed themselves. Sehan Kim has already seen how this game will play out: everyone in the world dies except for him. When he’s given the chance to go back in time and start a second playthrough, Sehan is determined to change the course of events and beat the gods at their own game.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: He is the only one that survived at the end of the game of life but, when is decided his time was done, the game suddenly restarted and was able to play a different way to survive in group rather than alone.

synonyms: The Heavenly Demon Can’t Live a Normal Life
description:
“Is this a mission I was sent on by the gods? Or is this just divine punishment?”

Jung-Hyeok Baek, divine demon overlord of Murim, finds that he’s been reincarnated into the body of Roman Dimitri, the dim-witted son of a baron who’s obsessed with the luxuries of the aristocratic lifestyle. But with his new status, Jung-Hyeok is ready to shake things up on the continent of Salamander. Will the divine demon accomplish what he’s set out to do? And will he finally get the answers to this mysterious reincarnation?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter -- love blossoms in all seasons.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Blink Master of the Magic Academy

synonyms: I Became a Flashing Genius at the Magic Academy
Quick Teleporting Genius from Magic School
description:
In the game Aether World, Baek Yuseol is considered the most useless character because he can't use magic like everyone else. His only skill, Blink, is a short-range teleportation ability most players consider worthless. But when he’s tasked with reaching the game's true ending, Baek Yuseol decides to use his unconventional skill to achieve this impossible goal. Can this so-called "trash" character outsmart his powerful peers, form unlikely alliances, and ultimately master the game?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description:
She is one of the main characters in the game. She and the main female protagonist always have arguments.

Originally, she had a cold and hateful personality, with complexes and low self-esteem. However, as the story progresses, she change completely.

He is a 10-year-veteran of the game Aether World and exclusively plays as the trash character Baek Yuseol due to their identical name and appearance.

Although he is a veteran player of Aether World, Baek Yuseol is quite uninterested in the plot and would often skip important story cutscenes. His attention mainly goes towards the PvP and Alchemical Engineering side of the game.
After being transmigrated, Baek Yuseol tries to minimize his involvement with the main characters of the game.
It is mentioned that she have an open personality with everyone, care about their friends, and would save them without expecting anything in return.

alternative: Descendant of the Dark Mage King

characters.description: The son of the king of dark wizards and a human woman, he was born a prodigy. Despite having never fought before, he managed to defeat one of his older brother. Later, he enrolled at Stella, where he became the top student of his year.

description:
Sung-Hoon Lee is nothing but a victim of a changing world, a powerless man in a land infested with beasts and magic. Monsters from another world invaded earth, and they brought with them a sickness that pushes Sung-Hoon’s mother into an endless sleep. To pay off her medical bills, he braved a dangerous job as bait used by powerful superhumans called Awakeners to hunt monsters. But when he found himself at death’s door, the image of his past life flashes through his mind. There, he found his truth: he is the reincarnation of the Sorcerer King!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description: Min Ye-young was a quiet and reserved healer before she meets Sunghoon. Sunghoon recruits her and has her sign a shady contract to work with him indefinitely. Under Sunghoon's leaderships she rapidly grows in confidence and skill and later converts to a damage dealer as a world class martial artist and even develops an undodgeable and unblockable attack that bends space and time to always hit its mark.

One of the highest awakened people in the nation. She works as a celebrity too.

She is known to have two skills, Physical Enhancement and Flame Magic.

synonyms: El cuento de hadas de una madrastra
เทพนิยายของแม่เลี้ยงชูริ
description:
The marchioness Shuri Von Neuschwanstein is no stranger to hardship: her husband dies when she’s still a teenager, leaving her to manage his lands and raise his semi-grown children herself. Her stepchildren never warm up to her, and other nobles disparage her behind her back. Years later, however, it seems her efforts have finally paid off: her eldest stepson is to be married and take over the estate, freeing her of many responsibilities. But shortly after learning the cruel truth that she’s not invited to his wedding, she dies and wakes up on the day of her husband’s funeral seven years earlier! If Shuri is to live these seven difficult years all over again, she’s going to do things differently. Can she write her own fairy tale ending this time around?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.description:
**Height:** 159 cm (5'2") - 164 cm (5'4")

The Marchioness of the Neuschwanstein family. Originally from a minor noble house with nothing to its name, and a toxic family, Shuri's hand in marriage was bought by the Marquess of the highly affluential Neuschwanstein family, Johannes von Neuschwanstein. Shuri spent the next few years under Johannes' mentorship, who at the time was afflicted with pneumonia, learning the necessary skills to manage the estate in his shoes once he was gone. Jeremy, the eldest son, was too young to succeed him, and as he didn't want to turn to his manipulative relatives, he wrote a will on his deathbed, entrusting Shuri with control of the estate until Jeremy became of age. Shuri tries to hold true to her promise with Johannes and endeavors every day to watch over the estate and gain the trust of her stepchildren.
