description:
Due to a misuse of a word joke on live TV broadcast, girl group otaku, 'Jin-Kyung' ended up becoming doxxed and labeled as a "child predator", and ended up getting Social Anxiety Disorder. 3 years later, because of his past incident from the 3D world, his love for only the 2D world manifested, and ended up becoming a "Shut-In Otaku"! Then one day, as Jin-Kyung was no-lifing as usual, he was summoned to ‘Another World’, and came face-to-face with a bright-eyed, hopeful Summoner… Interesting enough, in the world that Jin-Kyung was summoned to, his Social Anxiety Disorder disappeared, and he was also able to wield immense power, and became the strongest summoned being there ever was!! The story of a former girl group otaku turned powerful 2D otaku, and the story of a weak and feeble Summoner commences now!!!

(Source: Toomics)

Notes:

- Chapter count includes a prologue.

- The official English translation is 117 chapters as Toomics English platform tends to split chapters. Our total chapter count follows the Korean release.

characters.description: Jink-Yung was a fan of the idol Group, "Oh My Lady". After he calls himself a Pedophile on live TV by mistaking the word, he receives huge backlash from the viewers. His public life was effectively ruined and he spends his time inside his own room unable to leave the house because of his deep rooted fears, when suddenly one day he is summoned by an Apprentice Summoner - Maina Haze - to defeat a monster.
A rookie summoner who by chance invokes Jinkyung, who thanks to his incredible power, recruits her to stop the demons of the North.
A young slave who served Elleyra, however decided to stop that and follow Ai and Jinkyung on their adventure.

She is a former combatant and survivor from the North, who lost all her companions and her left eye to that place. After that event, he decided to form a group to help the people of the demons, but they do not support the king and those who follow him. She had a magic dagger called Shelcon, but after witnessing the great power of Jinkyung she handed it to her. The Shelcon works by using the mana of the person who is holding it.

Lua is a bard, that means he creates and sings songs for the people of his land, recounting important events so that people know the truth. Bards are someone very important, because people trust their songs.
She is an Eneli, a race from another dimension, unable to lie, but she does not abide by this rule. It belonged to the group of the famous Kaltovia, Godin and Butzholz.

These are powerful summoning sisters who meet Elleyra, but not even she is a match for these sisters. In addition, they "protect" the Divine Beast so that the prayers of the people reach it and it can speak with God (because it is said that because someone pure has the ability to communicate with God directly).
The "best summoner" of her time, however, she is proud and pretentious because of the power she has. She knows Ai because they both went to summoner school and her family welcomed her.
The king at first glance looks like a womanizer sitting on the throne, however it is later known that he feigns that attitude so as not to show his true intentions.
A boy who met the Divine Beast by accident, but he only sees any girl, after meeting her he will help her get to the place where she wanted to go.

Beatrice is a thief from the Abyss guild, who wishes to steal the Divine Beast. Guild Abyss serve Gardon, the lord of darkness, and use his Guul Nadol as weapons (an object that possesses great power), she possesses the Gardon's Shadow. Unlike Shlecons, it could be used regardless of the user's abilities or whether there was mana nearby. This dagger contains the Lord of Darkness Gardon's power. The wielder of this weapon cannot be seen by anyone when they are in the shadows.
It was called "The Wandering Sword". He was kidnapped and turned into a demon by the alchemists.
A magician from the North of Kailiteon, thanks to this character he introduces us to the subject of mana and how magicians are no longer so common and they all became summoners.
He appeared in the early chapters as someone who protected Ai and Elleyra until they reached Elleyra's uncle's house.

He was a bard who together with Kaltovia, Godin and Lille defended people from demons for decades. After such a long time he was ashamed as punishment for breaking his promise to Ea (The Goddess of the Sea), and was found in Jirieya as a ferryman and transporting people across the sea.

Together with Butzholz, Godin and Lille defended people from demons for decades. After so long Kaltovia disappeared, and in the end it was discovered that the alchemists used his body as an experiment and turned him into a demon, the same with Gria.
Together with Kaltovia, Butzholz and Lille defended people from demons for decades. After so long, Godin disappeared, surely he must have been kidnapped by the alchemists.

title.english: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2

description:
Earth lost the fight for survival in the BattleNet system and humanity now faces eradication. However, Jihan Seong is given another chance. He has returned three years into the past before BattleNet became a life-or-death game. With his knowledge of the future, he’s determined to become the strongest player. Will Jihan be able to change the fate of humanity? And more importantly, can he protect the ones he loves from those who want him to fail?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: He possesses a rare "nameless" talent, which made him get another chance at beating the "Battle Net" game when humanity was about to be wiped out. Regressing back to when he was addicted to gambling and drinking, he now tries to make things different.
Seong Jihan's niece. She's the daugher of Seong Jihan's brother-in-law, Yoon Sejin, and Seong Jihan's sister.
Divergent Guild's prominent prospect.

Seong Jihan's brother-in-law and Yoon Se-Ah's father. Also known as the "Sword King", he was Korea's pride and honor, which resulted in a rather fanatical fan club of his being formed. He left Korea for Japan, resulting in him being branded as a traitor by some.

description:
When the war between the aboveground and underground ended, humanity was joined by so-called "dungeon babies," those gifted with supernatural abilities and an obsession with the labyrinths below ground. Despite being a dungeon baby, Kim Jin-U suppressed his instincts, choosing to live an ordinary life as a guide and caring for his family. But when an expedition goes wrong and he somehow ends up becoming the new owner of a labyrinth, he discovers that he cannot ignore his instincts forever...

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: Doctor Elise: The Royal Lady with the Lamp

synonyms: เอลิเซ่ แพทย์หญิงทะลุมิติ
description:
Jihyun is a master surgeon at the peak of her medical prowess. She’s made it her life’s mission to save lives in order to atone for the sins of her past life, but her dreams are cut short when her plane crashes in the middle of the Pacific. When Jihyun wakes up, she finds herself back in her first life as Elise de Clarence - the haughty nightmare of a girl who brought on her own tragic end. The new Elise, however, still has time to set things straight - with her newfound medical knowledge, the reformed Elise sets out to right the wrongs of her tragic first life!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 13 side stories.

Enlightened with the medical knowledge of a master surgeon, is this her chance to mend her past relationships and heal an ailing empire, or is fate sealed to repeat itself?

description:
After spending nine years on Dungeon and Stone, the role-playing game that no player has ever beaten, Han-Su Lee finally reaches the dungeon of the final boss. As soon as he opens the gate, however, he suddenly sees a message that says his tutorial has been completed and finds himself in the body of Bjorn Yandel, a real barbarian within the game. An exciting adventure awaits him as he endeavors to abide by the laws of the fictional world!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

description:
Joshua Sanders, the legendary spearman who ended the brutal civil war, shattered the belief that one must wield a sword to be a master knight. He fought in the service of his friend, Emperor Caesar Van Briton, but it is all for naught when his fearful comrades try to kill him. He’s on the brink of death when his trusty weapon, Lukia, shines and propels him back to the stables of his childhood. With his mighty spear in hand, Joshua is dead set on revenge in this life!

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Joshua's mother.

description:
To Hui-Won’s dismay, the BFF she crushed on and her other BFF are now dating! Seriously bummed, Hui-Won decides to go wild just one time, and find solace with a handsome stranger. A very satisfying one night affair has now turned into more — she’s pregnant! Fate brings them together again, and now the regimented Du-Jun is determined to do the right thing and marry her. But they’re basically strangers! Except... their bodies have been very intimately acquainted. What’s this mother-to-be to do?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

characters.description: The son of a rich family and the CEO of a company. He is always cool and calm and has a plan, but when it comes to Hui-Won's business, he goes out of his way without hesitation.

description:
In an ancient world where martial artists reign supreme, Un-Seong can only watch as his master is brutally beaten to death after a false accusation of practicing forbidden demonic arts. Even after a valiant fight, he fails to kill those responsible and faces his own end. But fate has other plans… Instead of taking his last breath, he awakens as a child, training to be an elite soldier of a demonic sect. Now Un-Seong must embrace the demonic arts and harness power in his ultimate quest for revenge.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

characters.description: Un-Seong Hyeok is the sole disciple of Nok Yu On - the world's strongest spearman and the master of the Spear Master Sect. Under his mentorship, he reaches Transcendence Level and attains great mastership of the spear.

When there is no way out, the way is in. Doomed to die next month, our terminally ill protagonist Chan is too frail and defeated to try anything at all. No wonder he chooses to plunge himself into an RPG world he is only too familiar with. Why should this run be any different? Well, other than the fact that he will wake up inside the game and get struck with an existential epiphany that will make him fight tooth and nail to give Nox, his equally ill-fated RPG persona, a better chance? Maybe, it’s not over until it’s over.

(Source: WEBTOON)

She became a maid for the Lienhaber and later, the direct servant of Nox, who saved her life. She is quite capable and has a fondness for Nox, even becoming jealous when he's with another woman.

description:
Hyeon’s what some may call resourceful, thrifty, or, um, stingy. Whatever you call him, he’s also dedicated—he grinded night-and-day to get a top-tier character. But once he sold it, every last cent was taken away by loan sharks. In the new VR MMO Royal Road, he’s committed to making it big for himself and his family. He knows that he should absolutely NEVER be one of those weak and poor sculptors, so what’s he going to do when he accidentally becomes the Legendary Moonlight Sculptor?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description:
+Occupation: Dark Gamer, Student
Known Relatives: Lee Ha-Yan (sister), Grandma
Profession: Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Necromancer, Warrior, Warrior of the Sun
Alias: Karichwi (Orc form), Art Hand (Dwarf form), Deorol/Clongy (Lich form), (Crow / Raven form), (Bone Dragon form), (Chaos Warrior form), (Ice Troll form), Gold Bug (Dark Gamers), Deruger (Monster form), (Hummingbird form), (Portu Kingdom Archer form), (Barbarian form), (Pony form), (Giant Asian Black Bear form), (Griffon form), Squashy Wriggler (Underground Monster form), (Monkfish form)

Lee Hyeon is a high school drop-out with an enormous debt inherited from his deceased parents. Upon placing his gaming avatar from the game "The Continent of Magic" on an auction, the news spreads nationwide, and a fierce competition to win Hyeon's avatar breaks out. The price is eventually raised to ₩3.1 billion won (around 2.76 million US dollars). However, the great majority of this sum is soon taken by loan sharks who show up to collect the debt owed by his father. He's then left with only ₩90 million won (around 80 thousand US dollars)... ₩60 million of which goes to pay for a small house for his grandmother and sister to live in. The loan sharks leave with a challenge to Lee Hyeon to make the same amount of money in five years to get his revenge on them. Determined to send his little sister, Ha-Yan, to college and take revenge on the loan sharks he begins to train his body in martial arts and learns how to play the most popular game in Korea, the virtual reality MMORPG "Royal Road". Lee Hyeon begin to create a strong and famous avatar in Royal Road in order to make money and get his revenge.

Using his old avatar name, 'Weed', he spends 4 in-game weeks swinging a sword at a training scarecrow nonstop at his starting city, Serabourg City situated in the Rosenheim Kingdom. He befriends players and looks for a class that will make him powerful enough to become rich.

Da-In is a high-level Shaman player in Royal Road. She has exceptional skill due to her unusual style of training, and she is Weed's first love. In the real world, she went through a high-risk medical surgery.
A 50 year old legendary master swordsman known throughout Korea, An Hyeon-Do is the head of the best and largest sword Dojang of South Korea.
She is the younger sister of Weed and she is the main reason behind his actions to make money, as he wants to pay her college fees.

Jeong Hyo-Rin, is a player in Royal Road and a friend of Weed. In the game she plays the Dancer class. In real life she is a successful and worldwide known singer who plays the game to relieve the stress of being famous and single.
Choi Ji-Hun is the son of a rich businessman and plays the gamer character of Zephyr, a quiet and peaceful fisherman.

synonyms: スタディー・グループ
description:
Nicknamed the “school for future criminals,” Yusung Technical High School isn’t exactly the ideal place to study. A rarity among his peers, Gamin is a student with just one goal: to get into university. At a school where it’s every man for himself, he is rejected from countless study groups before he decides to form his own. When Hankyeong, Gamin’s former tutor, joins his high school in hopes of earning her teacher certification, it seems like they’re both reaching for the impossible. Can they defeat the odds and achieve their dreams?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.

characters.description:
__Height:__ 178 cm

Gamin Yoon ("윤가민") is the main protagonist of the manhwa, Study Group. He is a high school student with a dream of entering a 4-year university and becoming a college student. He is the foundeTo hell with circumstances, I create opportunities of Yusong Vocational Engineering High Study Group.
Jiwoo Lee is Hyeonu Lee's older twin sister and a member of the Yusong High study group. She's a chemical engineering major and is skilled in Judo.
He is the son of one of the directors of the White Lead Gang, Yeonbaek Phi.

synonyms: The Knight King Who Returned with a God
ราชาอัศวินผู้มากับเทพ
300年ぶりに神と帰還した騎士王
description:
I returned to Earth after hunting demons in the otherworld for three hundred years. But I did not return alone.

(Source: Naver, translated)

characters.description:
Owner of the sacred lion's heart and guardian of the Holy Grail.

He acts as the king of the world he lives in. On the surface, he has created a new guild called Pantheon.

The mage queen of the Kingdom of Spero.

Although she cannot follow the mandatory nature of divine law, she possesses the highest level of magical abilities and, as a solitary queen, provides significant mental support to Leon.

For 1,000 years, under the orders of humans, he sealed the devil's artifact, the Jewel of Wisdom, and protected it so that no one could take it. Leon recognized him as a dedicated and honorable knight, and he became the Knight of the Holy Grail.

She is an A-rank hunter who was first known as a member of the Korean Government Hunters Association when the dimension to which Leon belonged first opened as a gate. She uses a combat method that combines sword techniques and fire attributes.
Goddess of life and abundance. Among the gods of the pantheon, she was the first goddess to wield her power on Earth.

A D-rank hunter.

He first meets Leon during the Hunter Association's promotion exam and later applies to become one of Leon's Knights. While training with Leon, he is told that becoming a knight requires dedication and honor, not status and rank, and he completes the soldier training course hoping that he too can become one.

description:
A flawless love story of the flawed.
Stuttering lady Maximilian is forced into a marriage with Sir Riftan, but he leaves on a campaign after their wedding night. 3 years later, he triumphantly returns, ready to cherish her. As life with her husband finally begins, she only has one question — does she deserve this love and happiness?

(Source: Manta)

characters.description:
Maxi is abused by her father and compared to her half sister in every way, she is told that she is to marry a knight and she does so fearing the same treatment. She has almost no self esteem, and due to the abuse she suffered she has developed a stutter, something she is very self conscious about.

Maxi's speech impediment is based off of the original author's own personal experience with having a stuttering speech depending on mood and level of excitement. Something the author discussed during a special interview for the manhwa released in December 2021

synonyms: นักล่าไร้ลิมิต
description:
Seong-Yun Han was just a boy when his parents were killed by monsters unleashed during a mysterious calamity called the “Dungeon Break.” Seven years later, Seong-Yun is devastated to find that his grinding efforts to become a Hunter – fierce warriors who seek out and destroy monsters – are entirely in vain, as his fighting attributes have not increased at all. Seong-Yun’s world flips on a dime when he accepts an invitation to join the Tower of Trials, an otherworldly realm where challengers must overcome trials that pit them against monsters and humans alike.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: The main character who goes by the nickname 'Hunter' in Tower of Trials.
A challenger who died on 47th floor of Tower of Trials.
She is an administrator who took an interest in [Seong-Yun](https://anilist.co/character/298422) and made an additional contract with him.
She's a member of the White Silver Guild. She first met [Seong-Yun](https://anilist.co/character/298422) at the Tower of Trials.
She is a famous hunter from America also known as "The Witch of Hellfire".

synonyms: The Chaotic God of Extraordinary Strength
description:
All Jeong wants is a second chance – for revenge! His grandfather’s gruesome death has transformed him into the bloodthirsty and ruthless Scythe Demon. He will stop at nothing until he has killed the man responsible. Yet rage and determination alone are not enough. He must train in martial arts if he ever wants to stand a chance against such a formidable foe. Will he succeed in his revenge on the murderer of his grandfather?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: A blue-rank spirit bound to Mok Gyeong-Un as his familiar spirit. Unwilling to give him her name, Mok Gyeong-Un gave her the name Cheong-Ryeong, meaning blue spirit.

description:
Through posting a "Best Comment", I somehow became the main character of a webtoon!

(Source: Naver, translated)

When in Ego Weapon form, Excalibur's appears like a huge sword with a broad, blue shining blade and a black handle and a golden ring that connects both the handle and the blade.

Seol-Jin is Initially an outcasted and bullied loner in his place of origin, South Korea, with low self-esteem and a love for webtoons. He was then suddenly transported into the world of one of his loved webtoon to embark in a journey to becoming the world’s number one ranked player.
He's the 2nd ranker in the Heavenly Terrarium and is the Red Wings Guild master.
He's a member of Heo Seol-Jin's party and a pretty rambunctious guy.
She’s the 1st ranker in the Sky Tower Terrarium.
He's the absolute god of the world.

description:
A relaxing getaway in paradise, or a death trap? A young man wakes up on a breathtaking beach, but he has no idea who he is or how he got there. Try as he might to piece it all together, untangling this mind-bending mystery won’t be easy when every clue leads to more maddening questions... and the family that welcomes him into their home is not what they seem.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description:
The main character of PIGPEN. He washes ashore an unknown island with no memories of how he got there or who he is.

~! In the turning point of the story, it is revealed that Jin-Hyeok is actually a wanted serial-killer. He then begins to try and murder each member of the family on the island. !~

~! It is revealed at the end that the setting of PIGPEN is actually Jin-Hyeok's own mind, and that the character and plot up to that point was created by his own subconscious. !~
A member of the family found on the island in PIGPEN. She takes a special interest with the protagonist upon his arrival.

Minu is a member of the mysterious family found on the island in PIGPEN. He is responsible for taking care of physical jobs on the island such as woodchopping, but otherwise keeps to himself due to disliking talking to others. He is very devout to his family, and is especially protective of his sister Romi.
A member of the mysterious family on the island in PIGPEN. She is the youngest member, and is often a cause for trouble in the family.

synonyms: チュートリアルが死ぬほど難しい
มิติโหด โหมดฝึกหัด
description:
Lee Ho-Jae had given up his life as a pro gamer, until one day he received a mysterious message:

“Congratulations! You’ve been invited to the Tutorial World.”

Intrigued, he enters the game and confidently chooses “hell” difficulty, but soon learns that he is trapped there. With a mere 0.01% survival rate, Ho-Jae must somehow overcome the game’s agonizing challenges to figure out the real reason he was invited. This tutorial may be tough, but its secrets are what’s truly hellacious.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description:
__Age__: 26

Former pro-gamer who entered hell difficulty of the tutorial.

description:
The descendant of a once great wizarding family, Elric Mervinger is unable to perform magic due to a rare medical condition. While attempting to cure his disease, he stumbles upon the demon Mephistopheles, who tries to possess Elric to free himself from a dragon’s trap. But when Elric ends up absorbing Mephisto instead, the two become bound together. With Mephisto by his side, will this new power allow Elric to restore his family to its former glory? Or will he just end up being devoured?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The sole heir of the prestigious magic family Merbinger. Though he possessed innate talent, he had too much talent, and as such, could not learn magic. However, he then received a blessing left by his ancestors!

title.english: Father, I Don't Want this Marriage
title.romaji: Appa, Na I Gyeolhon An Hallaeyo!
title.native: 아빠, 나 이 결혼 안 할래요!

synonyms: Appa, Na I Gyeolhon An Hallaeyo!
아빠, 나 이 결혼 안 할래요!
Father, I Don't Want to Get Married!!
Daddy, I Don't Want to Marry!
ท่านพ่อ ลูกไม่อยากแต่งงาน!
Juvelian – Vater, ich will diese Ehe nicht!
description:
Juvelian is a villainess so hated by everyone that even her lover and father leave her to die a pitiful death. Just as she’s about to face her fate, she gets the chance to change the course of her story. In order to avoid the tragic end she knows awaits her, she breaks up with her lover and gives up trying to win her father’s love. Instead, she focuses on using his wealth to enjoy her new life to its fullest! But while she prepares for her extravagant life as a lady, her father begins looking for her new suitor. Afraid that he’ll marry her off to the infamously unpredictable and stormy prince, she lands on a desperate solution: a dating contract. And the best candidate is none other than her father’s student.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

title.english: Tyrant of the Tower Defense Game

synonyms: I Became the Tyrant of a Defense Game
成为塔防游戏里的暴君
description:
"Protect the Empire" was considered unbeatable for over a decade until streamer extraordinaire "Mr. Gamer Geek" comes along and defeats the game on its hardest mode. But just when he's about to rest on his laurels, he's sucked into the world of the game by some mysterious figure and thrust into Prince Ash's body! Ash now realizes that every click and command he had mindlessly sent out had real, gruesome costs - including his teammates' lives that he sacrificed for the sake of victory. To make up for his previous actions, Ash promises to keep his whole team alive this time while using his wits and knowledge to survive the hellish onslaught of monsters. But who brought him to this world in the first place, and why? Ash may soon find the answers to these questions - if he can survive the bloody battlefield first!

(Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: The Current King of Everblack Empire

synonyms: ゴッド オブ ブラックフィールド
description:
Leaving only black soot and dead bodies in his wake, Kang Chan, the “God of Blackfield,” struck fear into the hearts of his enemies. But one day, in the chaos of battle, his life was abruptly snuffed out. “I’ve been shot… but the bullet came from behind me!” Revived three years later, this “god” is now a wimpy high schooler with major problems—savage bullies, shady business dealings, and even girls. Revenge seemed like a straight shot, but high school is a battlefield all of its own!

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: ‘Kang Chan’! During the African war, he was called ‘God of Blackfield’, the black land’s God, by his enemies who were terrified but in awe of him. However, during a mission to kill Masallan, the brain behind SISS, the group of sunni supporters, Kang Chan was killed in action by an unknown bullet shot from behind him. As his vision got blurry, he saw his thirteen team members, who had absolute faith in him, getting killed one after another. As Kang Chan was awaiting death after being shot by a traitor, he was saved by a mysterious power and woke up 3 years later in South Korea. However, he was in the body of another ‘Kang Chan’, a 19-year-old high school boy who was being bullied at school.

title.english: My Bias Gets on the Last Train

synonyms: Mi bias toma el último tren
description:
Every night, Yeo-Un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When a shared love for the indie band Long Afternoon sparks a conversation, their late-night encounters begin to turn into something more. But Hae-In isn’t just another fan—she’s the voice behind the band, a secret she can’t afford to reveal. As music draws them closer, the truth may threaten to pull them apart. When the final note plays, will their story end in harmony… or heartbreak?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: A musician and self-proclaimed fan of Long Afternoon's.
A college student and big fan of the indie band Long Afternoon.
The owner of the café [Yeo-Un](https://anilist.co/character/358013/YeoUn-Lee) works at.
A close friend of [Yeo-Un](https://anilist.co/character/358013/YeoUn-Lee)'s from his early college days.
[Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/358012/HaeIn-Sin)'s uncle. He is a live sound engineer and the owner of the studio Hae-In plays at.
A student and part-time worker at the café [Yeo-Un](https://anilist.co/character/358013/YeoUn-Lee) works at.
A popular indie singer and songwriter. He's interested in bringing [Hae-In](https://anilist.co/character/358012/HaeIn-Sin)'s talents to a wider audience.

synonyms: Please Take Care of Me in This Life as Well
ชาตินี้ก็ฝากด้วยนะ
J'irai te voir dans ma prochaine vie
生まれ変わってもよろしく
description:
Ji-Eum Ban has a secret—she can remember the memories of her previous lives...all 18 of them! This means she retains past knowledge, skills, and most importantly, the bonds with the people she cares about. Guided by the bittersweet memories of her last life, Ji-Eum sets out to rekindle the love that was cut short by her tragic death. But little did she know her biggest rival would be her own past self...

(Source: Yen Press, edited)

Note: Include eight extra chapters.

characters.description: Son of a chaebol family, who suffered from a disability and trauma after a car accident while going to an amusement park with his first love when he was 9 years old.
She is Yun Joo-Won's sister.

description:
It’s hard dating someone who won’t give you the time of day. Su-Ae Sim knows that better than anyone, having dated her indifferent boyfriend, Min-U Kang, for years. She sometimes wishes she could be more like her charismatic stepsister, Ra-Im, who seems to have it all. But life takes a turn for the weird when Su-Ae discovers Jellypop, a sentient flip phone, in her locker. Jellypop has a lot to say about her love life, especially as Su-Ee drifts further away from Min-U and finds herself running into Min-U’s friend, Eun-Hyeok. Add to the mix a growing suspicion that Min-U and Ra-Im might be more than friends, and Su-ae might need a miracle to navigate the ups and downs of high school romance!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

description:
Dowan Ha is a bullied gamer, whose bullies force him to grind to obtain in-game items for them. After one such bully demands that Dowan obtain an impossibly rare item for him or be beaten in front of the prettiest girl in school, Dowan games day and night for a week until he drops dead from exhaustion. However, as soon as he dies, he respawns back in his classroom one week before his death. Everything is the same as it was before, except now he has all the skills he’s acquired from the games he’s played in real life! Will Dowan be able to use his newfound abilities and gamified existence to defeat his bullies?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Borame-Dong Associate
Sillim-Dong Representative

Seon-Jae is a part of Sillim-Dong, working under Eun-Seong. He is described as a strange person by Do-Wan Ha as he is often seen conversing with or roleplaying as animals or even food. Eun-Seong on the other hand has described him as "Strongest".
Borame-Dong Deputy
Bongcheon-Dong Representative
Borame-Dong Associate

synonyms: DICE: The Cube that Changes Everything
DICE ลูกเต๋าเปลี่ยน ชีวิต
description:
Whether it's appearance, grades, or social life, Dongtae's at the bottom of the barrel. When popular transfer student Taebin gives him an opportunity to change all of that, Dongtae heads down a path to make things right. This is the world of DICE, where a single roll can change your fate.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
Mio is one of Dongtae's classmates that became a Dicer in the chaos that occurs at their school.

~!Mio later becomes Dongtae's girlfriend.!~

__Rank:__ A-Rank

Dongtae is the main protagonist of DICE. He starts off as a timid kid with bottom of the barrel rankings on every aspect of his life. Whether it be looks, intelligence, height, it was like Dongtae rolled "ones" for all of his attributes. Constantly bullied and incapable of approaching his crush Eunju, Dongtae is rescued from a spiral of despair by becoming a Dicer. His main goal is to get the final dice and make a world fair for all.

Eunju is a female protagonist of the series and Dongtae's love interest. In terms of dice points, she would be a full "six". Initially depicted by Dongtae and everyone that she is the prettiest girl in the whole school, it is often overlooked that Eun-Ju never saw herself as someone special. ~!Having seen dicers lose their humanity, compassion and sensibility for the sake of getting their desires fulfilled and, ultimately, for X's entertainment, she possesses only one single powerful desire to eliminate dice from the world.!~

X is the main antagonist of the series. He is a supernatural entity who controls the production and distribution of Dice and sets the quests Dicers must complete in order to gather them. He also sets and changes the rules of the game as a whole.

(Source: Dice Wiki)
Mu-Yeong is a Dicer and was Taebin's former mentor, and the person who gave him his first Dice. He seems to currently be the most powerful A-Ranker

Choe-Hyeon is a student in the protagonists' school, though one grade lower than him. He keeps his A-Ranker skill hidden until the final battle royal, though he has shown a co-operative stance towards Dong-Tae.
Ji-Eun had something embarrassing that happened to her, because of this she seeks the ultimate dice to change her past. She also hides her face with a mask due to the events of her past.

Tae-Bin is the love interest of Eun-Ju. A transfer student to Dong-Tae's school and classroom, and sitting next to him, Tae-Bin is a Dicer and was initially Dong-Tae's polar opposite. He quickly became one of the most popular students in the school.

Seok-Sun Jeong is a student of First Private High and also an A-rank Dicer. He's dating Na-Ni Kim.

~!He became a Dicer to cure Na-Ni's cancer. He would do quests to obtain dice to increase Na-Ni's HP, trying to keep her alive, he found himself being forced to commit arson and murder for her.!~

~!He joins Dong-Tae in fighting X, but soon afterwards he gets killed during the battle.!~

~!After Dong-Tae succeeds in obtaining the final die, he is able to bring Seok-Sun back to life, and grants his wish of curing Na-Ni of cancer.!~

Na-Ni Kim is a student of First Private High and also a Dicer. She isn't able to attend school, because of her illness. She's also dating a fellow classmate, Seok-Sun Jeong.
~!Dawn attacks her with a fatal blow, leaving her HP rapidly decreasing, she passes away soon after.!~
~!After [Dong-Tae](https://anilist.co/character/181005/) obtains the final die, he brings her back to life, and cures her illness, meanwhile erasing her memories of dice.!~
Dae-Mun is one of Mu-Yeong's previous friends. She survived his attack and was able to escape, leaving her and Tae-Bin the only survivors.

synonyms: The Descent of the Demonic Master
จอมมารจุติโลก
description:
Jinho Kang used to be an average teenager, before an accident took away his family and his ability to walk. After reincarnating in medieval China, he becomes the demon master known as the Crimson Emperor. When his life is tragically cut short, he wakes up back in his previous life, before the accident AND with his powers and martial arts prowess intact. All Jinho wants is to live a normal life, but he soon realizes that monsters exist even in the modern world, and only he can stop them.

(Source: Tapas)

Seong-Woo is a former special forces soldier who has returned to college after completing his national service. His ordinary life as a student is shattered during class one day when he and his fellow students are faced with a mysterious prompt asking them to “select a role.” Seongwu chooses the necromancer, a rare ability that grants him the power to control the undead. With the campus and outside world seemingly on the brink of collapse, Seong-Woo must use his newfound powers to battle fearsome monsters and help save his fellow students. But will they make it out alive?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

synonyms: การศึกษาที่แท้จริง
description:
Hwa-Jin Na’s teaching techniques are pretty violent for someone who works in the Ministry of Education. That being said, when punishments don't seem to work on even the worst of school bullies, there is no better man for the job. Sometimes you can’t get a good education until those bullies are taught a lesson.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.

characters.description: He works in the Ministry of Education.

Han-Rim works in the Ministry of Education. She is of relatively short stature, with dyed red hair, and is extremely skilled at martial arts.

~!She is an Ex-Special Forces soldier from the Military!~

synonyms: Lady Eris – Nur der Tod kann mich erlösen
นางร้ายต้องสังหาร
description:
Eris Miserian just wants to die. Being overworked and underappreciated in the real world wasn’t great, but living as the villainess in a romance novel is even worse. If Eris can die in the novel, she might be able to return to reality, but the story won’t let her. Desperate to escape a life as the protagonist’s tormentor, she sets off on a journey with the help of a witch, a knight, and a high priest. Can she find her way back to her friends and family, or is Eris doomed to a fictional future?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

The world is in constant turmoil, with constant wars breaking out between Heroes and Villains. Gifted with supernatural abilities, one lone girl sets out on a bloody path for revenge against the injustices of the world she lives in. With the constant clashes between titans, no one is safe. If no one is willing to protect the innocent, who are the real heroes, and who are the real villains? What truly separates one from the other?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm
__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Ihwa is the main protagonist and tritagonist of the aptly named webcomic series, Hero Killer.
After her sister Yeon was killed by corrupt heroes, Ihwa sets out to avenge her by killing as many heroes as possible. She would join the villain organization known as the Nameless and works with [Engen](https://anilist.co/character/252729/Engen), the Smiling Man and legendary villain as they work together to destroy the Hero Clan.

Ihwa's gift is the ability to steal, borrow, and absorb the Gift of another Gift user. She has two categories of her powers - temporary and permanent. The temporary 'borrowed' gifts she gains from contact with the gift user and can be used for a limited amount of time any time after obtaining them. She can use these gifts simultaneously with other gifts. Permanent gifts are obtained whenever Ihwa kills the user, she must be directly responsible for their death. She can then use the gifts for an unlimited amount of time, but only within the limits of her EST, and only one at a time. She must also understand how to use the gifts by observing the original user. Ihwa's power has grown stronger per use, and the duration of these abilities has also increased.

__Height:__ 189 cm
__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Engen, also known as the Smiling Man, is the deuteragonist of Hero Killer.

He is the leader of the villain organization known as the Nameless who was once a central figure of the major conflicts from the previous era that fought in both the War of Inheritance as an heir to the throne of Nera and as its second king during the Great War, afterward he went into hiding and somewhere along the way saved [Rachel Sinclair](https://anilist.co/character/308061/Rachel-Sinclair) and organized the survivors of the war. While not all of his motives are clear, he wishes to defeat The Iron Witch, the mysterious woman who gave him his iconic scar, and destroy the Hero Clan.

Engen is a stoic, calm, and collected man at nearly all times, which shows an aura of mystery. However, Rachel says that this is just a front and he's quite crazy, which he used to be more open about in his youth, although it still surfaces from time to time. According to [Chain](https://anilist.co/character/328674/Chain), Engen has always had a creepier side to his personality even in his youth, but he has become more twisted as time passed.

A first-class villain, Engen is incredibly ruthless as he won't hesitate to kill his opponents and isn't against harming a great number of bystanders when necessary.

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

She is one of the Elders, the nine strongest individuals in the world and the poster child of the Hero Clan as the strongest hero.

Victoria has a rather laid-back attitude due to her immerse power and how typically easy it is for her to win fights. Like most characters in the series and as an Elder, she has little to no value of human life and is brutally sadistic whenever she feels like it.

Rachel is an upbeat, energetic and friendly member of the Nameless.

She always seems to be happy and carefree even in dangerous situations. She has the ability to control plants and create them from the surfaces near her.

Abilities:
~!Flora Manipulation: Rachel has the ability to control plants and create them from the surfaces near her. Although she mainly use vines with daisies extending from her body, she can also take her victims to another "realm" which is filled with plant themed things like green grass, herbs, creepers, etc. Her appearance and powers change there. She can make grotesque looking yet dangerous weapons from plant matter and also demonstrates skill with using close combat weapons and her signature vines. It has been noted by Stonefist that she was far stronger in her realm than in the real world. Her Gift consumes a lot of EST so she doesn't use it very often.
!~

Childhood:
~! Used to be a sweet girl living happily with her mother in a harsh but simple life as a bastard child of her father. While she was at least happy with her mother and uncle, when both tried to escape from the kingdom with her after her abilities manifested, her uncle and mother got killed. Sinclair was punished, being dragged by carriage through snow, but was rescued by Engen. Rachel is driven by the desire to kill the one responsible for ruining her life, her demigod-like Elder father.
!~

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

Hekate is Victoria's "sidekick", personal assistant/servant and a member of the Hero Clan.

Hekate is portrayed a passive, quiet woman who usually makes small conversations and usually only talks and follows Victoria.

Jeremy Bernstein, also known by his codename Chaos, is a retired member of the Hero Clan as well as a former member of the clan's Special Forces, the clan's most powerful of elites gathered for their combatant prowess as he once the strongest hero in District 17: Dust City before his powers started declining with age and overwork. He is also the older twin brother of Rebecca Bernstein, also known as Highnoon

Chain is a villain and an ally of [Hero Killer](https://anilist.co/character/232113/Hwa-Lee).

Chain, at first, came across as a dim-witted and cowardly gangster boss type of man. However, behind those traits is that of a serious, deterministic, and respectful man. He is also shown to be selfless when it comes to protecting peoples that are important to him with it being the catalyst of his gift.

__Height:__ 162 cm
__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Baekji is a member of the Nameless as the group's information gatherer and tactician.

Unlike other Nameless members who have a slightly soft side, her tendencies are biased towards evil.

Ijincheon, also known as the Sword Hunter, is the Executioner of the Silver Forest of the Four Swordsmen and a former disciple of the first late Executioner, as his youngest pupil. He was once known by the nickname of "The Incompetent One" due to his nonexistent abilities with the sword and being the weakest one of the Executioner's students, but he never once gave up on his dream of becoming a strong swordsman.

~!Ijincheon was revealed to be the father of [Hero Killer](https://anilist.co/character/232113/Ihwa) and her late older sister, Yeon. But he was forced to abandon his daughters after deciding to choose their mother over them.!~

__Affiliation:__ Nameless

Vector is a villain and the doctor of the Nameless. He is a gift user and is considered an essential part of the organization because of his gift.

Vector is probably the only one in the Nameless who isn't abnormal, weird, entirely ruthless, or outright crazy.
He can be mostly calm and composed but is easily excitable (both negatively and positively) when the situation calls for it or escalates.

~!It was revealed that he was once a member of the Hero Clan's science and medical division over a decade ago but left the clan after being involved with the mysterious Shard Transplant Experiment!~

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

Padrius Encilion, or more commonly known as Bishop, is one of the Elders, the nine strongest individuals in the world and a powerful hero currently affiliated with the Hero Clan. He is the ruler of District 16: Cloud Garden.

Bishop on the outside is a polite, positive man, especially around guests or in public. In the past and his younger days, he used to openly display it with a sinister looking demeanor. Aside from that Bishop has shown himself to be quite wise and pragmatic.

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

Crimson Dragon, also known by her real name Muine Langjer, is a member of the Hero Clan. She works closely with the Prosecutor, The Defender, and Highnoon as they work together in District 16: Cloud Garden.

Muine is compassionate girl and cares deeply about civilian casualties.

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

Highnoon, also known by her real name Rebecca Bernstein, is a member of the Hero Clan and the twin sister of Chaos.

Similar to her brother, Highnoon is a self-aware wild card that's earned a reputation for being crazy and eccentric. Despite being a hero, she has no true allegiance to the Hero Clan, but rather the friends and family she's made in it, with her decisions in life being made to protecting what she has the best she could.

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

The Prosecutor, also known by his real name Saulcai, is a top tier member of the Hero Clan's Special Forces and one of the strongest heroes of his generation. He is an incredibly strong hero that operates in District 16: Cloud Garden.

~!After the transportation of The Torch, he was captured by Villains and given to the Puppeteer to be used as a human weapon.!~

Jintae Yang is a villain and the leader of his gang of villains. He is the current wielder of the One Hundred-Sided Blade which he took from his former mentor after killing him.

Jintae is man of questionable character with arrogance matching his ideals. He comes off as a quiet and old-fashioned man with a sharp and quick mind.

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

Dalia Mendoza is a member of the Hero Clan's Black Hand and the leader of The Fingers.

It is the first finger of the Black Hand, which handles all the dirty work of the hero clan, and is the only one of the six fingers of the Black Hand that does not hide its identity.

He is the father of [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/308061/Rachel-Sinclair) and Larkspur, and has quite a few illegitimate children at Ashen Castle.

He is so cruel that he would not hesitate to use his Gift to torture his own relatives. The purpose of this act is to create a life form that surpasses the Elder, and is aimed at growth at the moment of death, when the desire for life reaches its limit. In short, he is a bloodless and tearless human being who carries out human experiments on his children without hesitation. What's so bad is that even [Victoria](https://anilist.co/character/244578/Victoria) clicked her tongue and said, 'It's a crazy play house.' The reason he has so many illegitimate children seems to be to secure test subjects needed for experiments on ability growth.

Yushin, also known as the Ghost of Dust City, is an infamous Villain and extremely powerful swordsman who was once a member of the Elders, the nine strongest Gift users in the world but lost his position after being defeated at the hands of a young swordsman known as the Skysword in a one-on-one duel. He is Hero Killer's former teacher and caretaker that fostered her after her older sister Yeon's death.

Yushin is a very quiet man that speaks in a formal manner. However, in his youth, he was known to be wilder and acted in a more aggressive attitude with scenes of him radiating an air of potent bloodlust while smiling/smirking with a sadistic look on his face even during heights of danger.

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

Raxfer Sinclair is the son of the Elder, Reagan Sinclair and one of only 3 of his children that have been recognized by his father.

Raxfer is seen as a polite and friendly man when meeting new people or talking with other fellow heroes. However, upon seeing unapproved actions or villains, he attains a menacing aura and twitches his hands while standing silently. He can stay surprisingly calm even when a knife was being held against his throat.

__Affiliation:__ Hero Clan

Kirine, also known by her codename Sharpshooter, is a member of the Hero Clan and the former disciple of Chaos.

synonyms: นางร้ายหุ่นเชิด
description:
I woke up as Kayena Hill, the novel's villainess, praised as the greatest beauty in the empire. Who knew that her story would catch my attention because I was her in my past life? Destined for terrible ends, I've died twice—but I refuse to die a third time as a pawn in someone else's scheme. I’m no longer the vain and naïve princess. Now that I know how the story will unfold, I’ll turn the tables around and have everyone dancing to my tune. This time, I’ll be the one pulling the strings.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description:
Kayena Hill is the first princess of the Eldyme Empire. She is the most beautiful woman in the Eldyme Empire, and is often praised for her beauty. Her beauty is such that it puts famous paintings to shame.

~!In her first life, Kayena was a foolish, wicked, and arrogant woman who couldn't even realize she was being used and manipulated. She loved to receive praise, and it took only a few compliments to melt her heart and manipulate her. Even after Regef's betrayal, she couldn't grasp her powerless position and dark fate until she herself witnessed the consequences of her evil deeds. She was also a shameless woman who abused her position as the Empire's Princess to harass and humiliate Olivia, and she even harassed Raffaello by not respecting his boundaries and touching him without his consent which made him extremely uncomfortable. It also seemed that she harassed the maids who served her by yelling at them and whipping them unreasonably. It was also said that her mouth always blathers on and on, and she was never really calm.

In her second life as a Korean, she seemed to be a powerless, docile, and submissive woman who was easily manipulated and controlled like a marionette by others.

In her third life as a reborn Kayena, she amends her past mistakes and completely changes into a new person. She is clever, observant, modest, scheming, and Princess-like. She's also a kind person as shown by her kindness towards Ethel when they first meet in the academy and her willingness to help Vera get a title to sustain her siblings.!~

Raffaello Kidrey is the heir of the Kidrey Dukedom. He is one of the most handsome men and highly sought after bachelor in the Eldyme Empire along with Regef.

At first glance, Raffaello can come off as a cold, powerful, and stern knight which adds up to his masculine charm, but deep down he's a warm and kind person who cares about others. Since he was a powerful military warrior ever since his youth, he's skilled at swordsmanship, combat, and strategic thinking. Since he survived in the battlefield for many years and came out victorious, he's presumed to be a great tactician with high intellect.

~!He's also highly intelligent as shown when he learned everything quickly when he was a child, and he seems to have a lot of patient, endurance, and perseverance since he survived the wars he was sent to at a young age, his parents' ill-treatment, and Kayena's torment for years without having a mental breakdown. Despite all this, he has a major flaw which nobody knows- he suffers from mysophobia.

Because of this, he absolutely hates it when someone touches him since it feels as though nasty insects are crawling all over him. His mysophobia was so severe that it felt like abuse and torture whenever Kayena touched him and held his hand to get his attention. Because of this weakness, he never touched nor has held even the hand of a woman, and thus his reputation was getting damaged by rumors that he had a problem with his sexuality/sexual orientation.!~

Regef Hill is the first prince of Eldyme Empire who aims to become the next Emperor. In contrast to his angelic demeanor and handsome face, he's a person whose cruel disposition is unmatched.

~!Since Regef was raised as a depraved child deprived of love and affection, he has a twisted personality which turned him into an utter tyrant in his past life. Regef is also highly possessive and power-hungry since the Emperor always warned him that everything he has could be taken away in an instant if he doesn't have power and authority, and hence he always gets angry when someone tries to take anything he covets.

He's also very cunning and manipulative as shown when he manipulates and uses the past Kayena as a marionette for his own selfish desires, and does anything he can to achieve his goals even if it means using others as his pawns. He's also a short tempered person who doesn't hesitate to kill others as shown when he proceeds to kill Lydia after she enrages him, and has the habit of breaking nearby objects while throwing tantrums when he's angry. Despite this, he has a soft spot for those who genuinely care about him like the current Kayena, but he inadvertently ruins/hurts them because of his possessiveness and selfish desires.!~

Ethel Lindbergh is the illegitimate son of Emperor Esteban.

~!Ethel is a quiet child, but he has quite the temper. Because of the numerous betrayals he has faced, his vigilant eyes always look out for changes, and he's distrustful towards others. Even when someone is genuinely kind to him like Kayena, his eyes show his hesitation towards accepting their kindness since he's afraid of getting hurt again by unfamiliar tenderness. Nevertheless, he's a kind and caring person who deeply cares about those close to him, especially his mother. He's deemed to be a promising knight candidate because of his innate muscular strength and agility, but he uses this talent to harshly beat up his bullies.!~
Vera Lexton is a court lady and Kayena Hill's first lady-in-waiting. She is quite perceptive and sensible, and is a very ambitious person who works hard to achieve her goal.

Olivia Grace is the eldest child of Viscount Grace. She is clever, observant, loyal, and considerate, but she’s also self-reliant, brave, and strong.

~!She has a lot of patience, endurance, and perseverance as shown when she silently endured Kayena's torment and bullying for a long time without breaking down, and she's proven to be an optimistic bright girl in many instances since she always stands up for herself despite the many insults and scandals hurled at her. This also shows that she can calmly do her work even under high pressure and negative atmosphere, and she never gives up her hopes. She's also said to have all the qualities of a typical heroine who's the protagonist to whom everyone is attracted to, and hence she's presumed to be a charismatic person.!~

Jannon Evans is the eldest son of Marquis Evans and heir to the Evans marquisate. He is calculative and strategic. However, he is also very arrogant. Jannon is Prince Regef Hill’s lieutenant and one of the key figures of the Imperial Prince’s faction.

Susan Lepore is the second daughter of Count Lepore. She is known as the viper with a sword in her mouth. She is smart and has a lot of talent, but she easily writes people off as insignificant. She does not mince her words, so she is not very popular in the social world.
Julia Evans is the famous daughter of the Evans Family. She is often called the most beautiful woman in the east.

Henberton Gillian is the eldest son of Viscount Gillian.

He is obsessed with collecting beautiful things, and thus has a mad obsession with Kayena Hill who he believes is the most beautiful "thing" he has ever seen which will be a fine addition to his collection.

~!Initially, he was engaged to an unnamed woman, but he immediately broke his engagement after dancing with Kayena in the ball. That's when his obsession with her began, and he started stalking her and looked for ways to obtain her.

In his past life, Regef sold Kayena to him and the two got married. But he repeatedly abused her physically to the point she had to wear clothes with long sleeves to hide her scars of abuse, and he kept her locked inside his dark castle. Since Kayena always tried to hide from him, it seemed like a game of hide-and-seek to him, but the reason why he abused her isn't known. Once, he commented how foolish she was after he found her letter addressed to Raffaello asking him to rescue her, and told her that neither will anyone come to her rescue nor will she be able to escape from him. He mercilessly continued his abuse until he finally killed her.!~

description:
At the brink of death on an otherworldly battlefield, Jihoo Seol is granted the chance to relive his life. But all magic has its limits, and Seol only retains a few fragments of the man he will become. Memories of a future he has yet to live manifest in sporadic dreams and magic grants him unearned luck. When his magic fails, Seol's life takes a turn for the worse. Desperate and alone, he's approached by a mysterious woman with an offer that will change his life forever. Will his dreams be enough to save him from the horrors that lie ahead?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: At the start of the story, Seol is a gambling addict, deep in debt and scorned by his family and ex-girlfriend. However, due to an opportunity granted to him by his past life, he obtained a second chance to set things right.
A Paradisian and the princess of Haramark. Pink hair and eyes.

__Height__: 170 cm

Seo Yu-Hui is a Unique Ranker and the Daughter of Luxuria, otherwise known as the Executor representing the Goddess Luxuria. Prior to the beginning of the story she retired from active duty however recently returned to the Lost Paradise.

synonyms: ย้อนชะตาล่าข้ามภพ
description:
The past has changed, but like a fiery comet, he still comes. Mugi Hwa, the one without equal, slashed through Murim's skies with his sword, toppling every lord who dared to face him–even Cheonma, Mugeuk Geom’s father. But Mugeuk didn’t accept defeat. Instead, he turned to the forbidden: a time-bending ritual that hurled him into his own past. Now, retracing his steps, he races against the clock until Mugi emerges once again. But this time, it's not just about power, but mending old wounds and forging new bonds to unite his people and prepare for the bloodtide to come.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
He is the second son of [Wu-Jin Geom](https://anilist.co/character/346843/WooJin-Geom). He was an incompetent young master who could not properly compete with his older brother and was easily deprived of the position of successor. However, when he lost everything, from his father to everyone around him, he decided to use The Great Regression Technique. After many years, he gathered all the necessary materials for the regression technique and decided to return to the past to take revenge on Moogi Hwa.

After being able to reach the past, his goal would be to kill the one who deserves to die and save those who should not die. Because he lost everything to Hwa Moogi, he has a vengeful side, but more than anything, after losing everything to Hwa Moogi, he looks back and says he has no good memories, and tries to get closer to his father by talking to him, for his own good.
Cheon-Pa Gu, the Blood Heaven Blade Demon, is a One of the Eight Demon Supremes of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult.
Woojin Geom, the Heavenly Demon, the Strongest of This Era, the Cult Lord of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult.
One of the Eight Demon Supremes of the Heavenly Demon Divine Cult.
Lee-An is a Mu-Geuk's Bodyguard.
A man who was bound by shackles.
Dae-Ryong Seo is a a special investigation officer.

synonyms: การกลับมาของฮีโร่
description:
With the unexplained emergence of dungeons came a relentless onslaught of monsters that overwhelmed humanity. Even the Awakened, humans with special abilities to fight monsters, couldn’t stop the destruction of the world. In the end, only Seong-In Kim, the most powerful Awakened, was left standing. Upon his death, Seong-In wakes up twenty years in the past as an unassuming high school student named Su-Hyeon Kim. He’s not sure how or why he was brought back, but he does know this is his second chance to save the world and redeem himself as a hero.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Gaming geek Su-Hyeon Kim hates school, and the dislike is mutual. Every day he faces relentless bullying from his classmates, leading him to wish his life was more like the RPG quest games he plays. Su-Hyeon’s wish is granted when a quest prompt pops up in real life with an easy quest and an enticing reward. With nothing to lose he takes the chance, and one quest soon leads to another. As the stakes get higher and the rewards get bigger, Su-Hyeon soon finds he’s gone from being an ostracized nobody to the top of the school. Just how far will Su-Hyeon take his quests, and how far will he fall if he refuses to participate?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

In that setting, he taught himself boxing using a magazine in order to beat his dad, a goal he accomplished once he became a middle schooler, feeling no regret for it.

description:
Lee Jain has existed on Earth for 3.5 billion years, dying and being reborn as countless animal species. Now in his final life, he is reborn in South Korea as a human, his most hated species. Having inherited all the animal superpowers from his past lives, Jain is determined to survive and wipe out humanity. But when a sudden car accident erases his memory, Jain crosses paths with new beings that force the question: is humanity worth saving, or is it bound for extinction?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: คว้าหัวใจคุณพ่อของจอมมาร
description:
Ack! I'm trapped in this webnovel, "Brigitte Wants to be Happy!" No prob, I KNOW what's gonna happen so I'll just—wait. I'm not Brigitte? I'm her aunt, Princess Yerenika?! Uh-oh. I'm stuck 20 years before the main plot... and everyone in my generation ends up tragically dead! Her parents, dead. Me, dead. Villain's dad, King Euredian, dead. A-ha! That's the key. I just need to prevent the villain from being born... time to break out some seduction schemes and flirt like my life depends on it!

(Source: Tapas)

Chapter count include 19 side stories.

characters.description: Mother of the villain from the original novel. Black Wizard from the magical tower of the Bellecourt Kingdom.

synonyms: ความลับของนางฟ้า
description:
After binge-watching beauty videos online, a shy comic book fan masters the art of makeup and sees her social standing skyrocket as she becomes her school’s prettiest pretty girl overnight. But will her elite status be short-lived? How long can she keep her real self a secret? And what about that cute boy who knows her secret?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 33 side stories.

characters.description:
__Height:__ 6'1

Suho is very studious in academics, unlike Ju-Gyeong and Seojun, and spends most of his free time studying. He is a talented cook and generally stays away from social media. He was best friends with Seojun in middle school.

~!Later in the series, he leaves to care for his father in japan for around 3 years - leaving the relationship he had built with Ju-Gyeong behind.!~ ~!They later meet again and proceed to officially start dating - getting engaged later in the series.!~

__Height:__ 187 cm (6'1)

Seojun Han is at first a bad-tempered reserved former K-pop trainee. He has a sister, who befriends Ju-Gyeong, which leads him to become best friends with Suho and Ju-Gyeong. He has great piano skills and is known as a great singer, prompting many idol companies to scout him.

~!He is shown to have an interest in Jugyeong, later becoming her boyfriend in the series.!~ ~!After Suho returns, they eventually break up due to Seo-Jun's busy idol schedule. He is shown to never properly get over their breakup.!~

__Height:__ 169cm (5'6)

Ju-Gyeong is the main protagonist of the story True Beauty. Through YouTube, she masters the art of makeup, changing her look completely.

At school, she mains her "pretty girl" image by faking her personality, such as lying about her music preferences and eating small portions during lunch. At home, she sheds her image and revertts to her "geeky" self, spending her time reading comics, listening to rock music, and eating fatty foods like fried chicken. Later in the series, she persues her dream of working in the beauty industry, and becomes a popular influencer online.

~!She later begins to date Seojun, after Suho leaves korea.!~ ~!After breaking up with Seojun to allow him to persue his music career, she officially begins dating Suho - her "first love". They later get engaged in the series.!~

Sujin Kang is an antagonist of True Beauty. Despite her posts on social media, her life is not as what it seems. Sujin often criticizes Jugyeong's makeup skills secretly. She pretends to be Jugyeong's friend but she secretly dislikes her. She is very gorgeous. She may know that Jugyeong’s ‘real face’ is actually not her real face.

Selena Lee is a makeup artist who Jugyeong has admired since high school.
~!She is the older sister of Suho.!~

Gowoon Han was initially introduced into the story as a co-worker of Jugyeong Lim, who had just started working at a convenience store. Later, it was revealed that Gowoon is a junior at the same school where Jugeyong studies and also the younger sister of Seojun Han.
Sua Kang is a supporting character in True Beauty. She is Jugyeong Lim's best friend.

Aiden Kim is a supporting character in True Beauty trying to make a debut through the reality television survival show, Pick Pick Boys. Which he later did, in a group called PVC short for Perfect Visual Club. Although he as stated that PVC was struggling. He was also a trainee under ST Entertainment, before leaving to join his new agency after debut. As well as a senior student at Je-Rim Arts High School when first introduced. In the later chapter's it is revealed that he joined the TV program "Prince of Prince" to boost PVC's exposure to the general public.
Heegyeong Lim is the older sister of Jugyeong Lim and works for ST Entertainment.
Woohyun Ji is a supporting character of True Beauty. He is the friend of Sujin Kang and Jugyeong's ex-boyfriend.
Juyoung Lim is the younger brother of Jugyeong Lim and Heegyeong Lim.
Heeyeon Shin is a supporting character in True Beauty and an idol under ST Entertainment.
Seyeon Yoon was a member of No-Time, a Korean idol band, and close friend of Suho Lee and Seojun Han.
Jooheon Lee is the widowed, famous actor and the father of Suho Lee and Selena Lee. He works in both Korea and Japan. He also had a relationship with his co-star from one of his movies.
Min-Ah is a supporting character in True Beauty and one of the girls who regularly bullied Jugyeong during middle school.
Jeonghye is a supporting character in True Beauty and one of the girls who regularly bullied Jugyeong during middle school.

title.english: The Reincarnated Assassin Is a Swordmaster

synonyms: The Reincarnated Assassin Is a Genius Swordsman
description:
Raon was once a loyal assassin for House Robert until Derus killed him. Not willing to give up, Raon prayed for vengeance and woke as a member of House Sieghart, the most powerful noble house. He’ll need all of their near-infinite resources to get revenge. Though he carried over knowledge of a powerful Flame Link technique, he also carries the Curse of Bitter Frost, something that’s slowly killing him. As if that weren’t enough, the demonic embodiment of Wrath is trying to take over his body.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Legend of an Asura - The Poison Dragon

synonyms: Poison Dragon: The Legend of an Asura
Legend of Asura - The Venom Dragon
description:
The mighty Medicine Faction has fallen to the evil hands of the Venom Clan. As they travel across the land, taking out each clan under the faction, Zhen Ziqiang becomes a test subject for the Elder of the Venom Clan. After being injected with various poisons, Ziqiang rises from the depths of hell as an Asura. Full of anger, he escapes and begins to plan his revenge as the sole survivor of his faction. Now, his goal is to destroy the entire Poison Faction and give them a taste of their own venom.

(Source: Tapas)

When you go from level 99 to level 1 and start all over again.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description: Former top ranked player of Lucid Adventure.
She was saved by HCLW once and when she sees him being beaten down she helps him out. She holds him in high regards even though he's a complete jerk.
Heart hitter's boss, Dark. His Grandfather owns a World scale corporation "Giga" and he is looking for him. He decided to hire HCLW to Power Level him.
The player who controls Hardcore Leveling Warrior.
A loan shark and former Dragon Knight. Doesn't like idiots. People can get special high-ranking requests from him.

alternative: 동부연합극의 수장 (Leader of the Eastern Alliance)

characters.description: Doo-Yeop, known as Yopi in Lucid Adventure, is the King of Yopi Land , and the leader of The Eastern Alliance. Along with Akira, he is a winner of a previous iteration of The Combat Tournament.
Ko Eun-Woo, known as Choco Bibi in Lucid Adventure, is a member of Master Swordsman's Guild and a former member of the Zara Guild.

Lee Ji-Hoon, known as The Best Swordsman is a player in Lucid Adventure. He was the Vice Guild Master of the Zara Guild and is the Guild Master of Grass Roots Guild. After Zara Guild disbanded, he formed the Grass Roots Guild and plans to complete the Absolute Quest to honour Armes memory.

Two years before the start of the series, The Best Swordsman was the Rank no.3 under Giga's Ranking System, but lost his ranking after getting defeated by Hardcore Leveling Warrior in a PvP duel. Despite his loss, he was still one of the Top Rankers in the game. He was a Blade Master in season 1 and one of the strongest characters in the game.

Post time-skip, The Best Swordsman has become even stronger. He has completed his 5th job advancement to become a Master Swordsman. By the start of The Great War, he was confirmed to be Ranked No.4 under the Lucid Ball Ranking System.

Along with the Grass Roots Guild, The Best Swordsman has joined up with Dark to find the missing Hardcore Leveling Warrior.

alternative: 제로의 유일한 실패작 (Zero's One and Only Failure)

characters.description:
No Name is the Queen of New Nightmare. She took part in the last ever Combat Tournament as a member of Team Giga No.8 in the Siege Round and Team Taoist in the PvP Round. Her team was knocked out by the eventual winners, Team Dark.

Sometime after the end of the Combat Tournament, No Name became the new Queen of Nightmare and founded New Nightmare. Her goal is to conquer Lucid Adventure and lead the Nightmares to the end of the game.

alternative: Manager of the Special Investigations Department

characters.description:
Jin-Won, known as Constant in Lucid Adventure, is a member of Giga. He is a General Manager and the Assistant Team Leader of Giga's Special Investigation Department.

For some unknown reason he became a 'member' of Chairman Kim's Workshop and was treated like a slave and beaten regularly. In the early years of Lucid Adventure, Constant was a member of Zara Guild. Through the machinations of Sad Smile and Han Gun-Ho, Constant inadvertently caused Armes to be captured which eventually led to the collapse of Zara Guild.

Not long after Armes' disappearance, Constant joined the Giga Guild.

alternative: 루시드 어드벤쳐의 조정자 (The Moderator of Lucid Adventure)

characters.description:
Zero also known as The Master Black Smith, was the Moderator of Lucid Adventure and one of the main antagonists of the Season 1. She started out as a mere tool without an identity that was used to create the world that Han Gun-Jae envisioned, but during her research of the human world, she changed. Her goals became to destroy the Gods and destroy Lucid Adventure.

She was responsible for resetting Hardcore Leveling Warrior's stats and tried to regain her former power to destroy Lucid Adventure and the Real World.

At various points in the past, Zero had used other characters to attack the Gods. She was one of the Gods that picked a team in order to become the Absolute God of Lucid Adventure, backing Team Open Your Mouth, Here Comes the Healing. After the death of Han Gun-Jae, Zero revealed herself and ended up fighting both God of Combat and Gods of Time and Space. She was killed when Yopi used his Last Card to summon 'The Creator' who killed her and the Gods. In her final moments she laughed maniacally and mocked the Gods for trying to save humans who ended up killing them.
The No.1 ranker after Hardcore Leveling Warrior who is also the vice of the Elixir Plant Guild lead by Principal.
Taek, also known as Grand General Taek, was a player in Lucid Adventure. He was the Grand General of Yopy Land and one of Yopy's confidantes.
God of Combat was one of the Gods and creators of Lucid Adventure. He hosted the annual Combat Tournament.

alternative: Union Leader of the Yopy Land Union

characters.description: Lee Je-No, more commonly known as Chairman Kim, and known as Sad Smile in Lucid Adventure. He is the Chairman of Miso Corporation and the owner of an infamous workshop in South Korea. In Lucid Adventure, he is the Lord of Cobalt Castle and the Union Leader of the Yopi Land Union.

Han Geon-Su, known as Light in Lucid Adventure, is the 2nd son and the youngest child of Giga's Chairman, Han Sung-Gong. He was the former Vice President of Giga and the former Lord of Totoras. Light is not officially a Ranker, but based on the power he displayed in the PvP Rounds, he was estimated to be Ranked No.3 under Giga's Ranking System.
Kim Jin-Woo, also known as Drip Soup in Lucid Adventure, is a current member of the Master Swordsman's Guild.

God of Blessings is one of the Gods of Lucid Adventure. The God of War seems to think he is dead. According to Choco Bibi, he is a bearded pessimist.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)

The God of Death supports a large frame, with mostly of her body covered in black hair. From her lower body, it is fully filled with hair, while having muscular legs that of a goat. Her upper body resembles of a burly women, sharp fingers and a head made of black fur, only having the large maw of jagged teeth left uncovered.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)

Nutella, also known as Mage Nutella, is an elite fairy from the fairy city Uni. She is one of the summons of King Yopi.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)

Cocomori is a player in Lucid Adventure. She is a former member of Giga and currently a member of the Grass Roots Guild. After her team got knocked out of the Combat Tournament during the Siege Round, she was discarded by Han Soo-Ah and has sworn to get revenge on her.

She joined the Grass Roots Guild to participate in the PvP Round and to get her revenge on both Han Soo-Ah and Giga.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)

Cha Jin-Hyuk, also known as Tempest in Lucid Adventure, is a member of Master Swordsman's Guild. He was a member of the Zara Guild before it was disbanded.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)

Pooh Upooh is one of the representatives of Yopi Land and serves as an Advisor to Yopi and is Yopi's left hand.

(Source: Hardcore Leveling Warrior wiki)
The Dragon of Evil is the Master of Dragon Mountain and is one of the prime beings in Lucid Adventure.

The Dragon of Light is one of the prime beings in Lucid Adventure. She is one of the two Dragons created by Han Gun-Jae to act as a balance to The Gods.

After the Gods were destroyed, The Dragon of Light felt a shift in the balance of the world and chose Elixir Plant Guild and started giving them powers.

title.english: The Male Lead's Little Lion Daughter

synonyms: I Became the Male Lead's Adopted Daughter
主人公の養女になりました
ฉันกลายเป็นลูกสาวบุญธรรมของท่านดยุก
description:
The handsome Duke Voreoti is the most terrifying man in the empire, with the coldest of demeanors and a gaze that can kill. But one day, he suddenly says that he wants to… adopt a child?! And that child is me?! After finding me at a shady orphanage, he whisked me away to his snowy palace without a second thought. Now I’m learning all the ways of the feared Voreoti family from his knights. However, things get dicey when the Duke becomes suspicious of my origins. With these fangs and jet black hair, perhaps we are more than just kindred spirits…

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The adopted daughter of Duke Voreoti.
The empress of the Belius Empire and the daughter of Marquis Hesperry.
The imperial consort of the Belius Empire.
The emperor of the Belius Empire.

synonyms: เซียนสัมผัสดาบ
description:
For as long as he can remember, Woonhwi So has been the black sheep of his family and clan. Because his spirit core has been destroyed, he has no choice but to serve as a third-rate spy for the Blood Cult. One day, during his mission to find the legendary Blade Scroll, he is killed and sent 10 years into the past. When Woonhwi regains consciousness, he realizes that he has been sent back to the day he was kidnapped by the Blood Cult, and that he has gained a mysterious ability to hear the voice of a dagger.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: He is the third son of Ikyang Soga.

synonyms: ตัวตนสุดเบียวของเพลเยอร์ผู้กู้โลก
description:
The real world is suddenly ambushed by rifts that threaten to spill out monsters from the VR game “Chronicles of Arcana.” These rifts can only be closed by “players,” people who have awakened as their in-game characters with all the same stats and skills. Unfortunately for protagonist Lee Ho-Yeol, his awakening is the opposite of cool as his avatar happens to be the one he made during the height of his awkward phase in middle school, giving him all the mannerisms and speech of an absolute cringelord. Just how will he go on to become the hero humanity needs most?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

alternative: 格蘭佩爾·克勞迪·阿爾佩斯·羅密歐

characters.description:
__Level:__ 55 (at start of series)
__Class:__ Demon Hunter
__Background:__ Successor of a great family
__Affiliation:__ Mage's Tower

The last surviving Demon Hunter in the world after the Arkshan Base was destroyed.

Lee Ho-Yeol awakens as his Arcana character "Granfel Claudi Arpheus Romeo" who he created at the height of his cringelord phase in the second year of middle school. After assimilating with his character, he struggles to control Grandfel's aristocratic personality and behavior. Because of this, Ho-Yeol's true self is sometimes depicted as a separate entity attached to his physical body like a ghost.

description:
