After saving one world, warrior Min-Su Kim returns to Earth only to find that he’s lost everything... so he decides to destroy the world he used to call home. In his rampage, he kills teenager Jeong-Su Park and his family. But instead of dying normally, Jeong-Su is transported to another world, where he finds that he's now a warrior himself. After killing the demon king of this alternate world and honing his skills as a warrior, Jeong-Su returns to earth, hell-bent on revenge against Min-Su. As the two warriors fight with the fate of their country in the balance, who will emerge victorious?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description:
__Height:__ 176 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior → Independent
__Epithet:__ Sword Warrior
__Abilities:__ Exceptional swordsmanship and superhuman physical abilities
__Blessing:__ Goddess Seraphine's blessing
__Holy Relics:__ Durandal sword, armor
__Family:__ Kim Sung-chul (father), Lee Hyun-jung (mother)

Pre-Fallen Hero: Kim is a young-boy that is empathic, deterministic, strong-willed, kind, and helpful. The other world's heros noted that Minsu was humble and very soft-spoken. Minsu was determined to see the other world's salvation and was very selfless in this regard.
Post-Fallen Hero: He is an extremely depressive, nihilistic, thoughtless, cold-hearted, genocidal, and cynical individual who lost almost all of his humanity.
~!Demon King: Minsu Kim’s personality becomes even darker and emptier.  His despair, hatred and contempt for the world reached a new level and he has now becoming completely nihilistic and omnicidal, now only desiring to completely slaughter the entirety of the human race.!~

__Height:__ 178 cm
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ The Spear Warrior, The Warrior of Revolt, The Warrior of Warriors
__Ability:__ Grants excellent spearmanship and superhuman physical abilities
__Holy Relics:__ The World of Creativity, the Spear, Magic Armor, Didantium, the Transformation Belt, Martial Arts, Chronos, and many other sacred relics
__Family:__ Park Da-bin (younger sister)
__Appearance:__ Episode 2

Jeong-Su Park was once a normal boy who lived a good life, with a good family. However, it takes a big turn when the world is now being taken over by the Sword Hero. His family tried to evacuate from Seoul only to end up being killed by the Sword Hero, Jeong-Su is taken to another world where he spends his time solo battling against all sorts of threats without needing the allies by his side.

After successfully defeating the demon lord, he eventually resurrects the demon lord and even gave him a potion that turns him far stronger. Only to end up killing the demon lord for the second time, his only ally understands very clear that his revenge purpose must be very important. Eventually, she decides to help him, at the same time, telling him that he must not lose his humanity to despair and vengeance to become a monster.

~!Jeong-Su, later on, returns to his world and eventually starts his quest in taking revenge on those who have brought despair and hopelessness to humanity!~

__Height:__ 180 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior  ~!Independent!~
__Epithet:__ Return Warrior, Future Warrior
__Ability:__ Status Window, Infinite Return
__Family:__ ~!Jung So-min (wife), daughter!~

He is currently a warrior of the destructive force and rules over Incheon and Gyeonggi-do. Instead of Kim Min-soo who only commits acts of destruction, he rules over the district and gives orders to his colleagues as his proxy, giving a strong impression of being Kim Min-soo's right-hand man. He seems to get along well with his colleagues with his joking attitude, but he is hiding something.

~!It's later discovered that he killed Kim Min-Soo parents!~

__Height:__ 170 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Warrior of Faith
__Ability:__ Faith through fear

She is one of the warriors of the destructive force who stood on the side of the warrior of the sword, Kim Min-soo , and destroyed the Republic of Korea . If Hans is the embodiment of the crowd psychology of human society, and Damian is the angelic form of faith, Baek Ha-na is the devil, the fearful side of faith.

__Height:__ 173 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Sea Dragon Warrior
__Ability:__ Sharing magic power with the sea dragon, magic
__Holy Relic:__ Atlas's Spear
__Family:__ Haeryong (husband)

Shin Sua serves as one of the main antagonists, and fallen heroes of the manhwa series known as Hero Has Returned.

__Height:__ 152 cm
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ Magic Warrior
__Ability:__ Various magic, servant horse Nyancaron
__Holy Relic:__ Sweet Crystal
__Family:__ Ma Ye-Som (younger sister), ~!Hong Hwa-Rang (husband)!~

She is known as one of the warriors who stood on Minsu Kim's side and brought down the Republic of Korea, but she is actually a warrior of the resistance forces opposing him.

__Height:__ 175 cm
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ Shield Warrior
__Holy Relic:__ Shield of Joseph of Arimathea
__Family:__ Minsu Kim (husband)

She was the Shield Warrior and one of the Resistance Warriors who sided with the South Korean government against the 9-Warriors. However, she was seemingly killed before the main story began.

__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ Metamorphosis Warrior
__Ability:__ Super-speed ability
__Holy Relic:__ Transformation Belt
__Family:__  An Ye-ji (sister)

He is the younger brother of Yeji Ahn and the Metamorphosis Warrior.

__Height:__ 167 cm
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ Combination Warrior
__Ability:__ Summoning, The Combiner, the pinnacle of human physical power
__Holy Relic:__ Key
__Family:__ Choi Min-jae (step-brother)

He was the Combination Warrior and one of the Resistance Warriors who sided with the South Korean government against the 9-Warriors. However, he was killed at some point before the main story began.

__Height:__ 185 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Vampire Warrior, Exorcist Warrior
__Ability:__ Blood manipulation
__Holy Relic:__ Hammer and chisel

He is a vampire warrior and a member of the destructive force led by the sword warrior Kim Min-soo . His area of ​​control is Chungcheongnam-do.

Although he has a light-hearted atmosphere, according to Jeon Seung-woo's comments, he rules with a cruelty that rivals that of Baek Ha-na, and he actually has a cruel personality that kills citizens without mercy when he is offended.

__Height:__ 169 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Golem Warrior
__Ability:__ Create and control golems
__Holy Relic:__ 10 rings

Jeon Sung-Woo serves as one of the antagonists of the manhwa Hero Has Returned, he is a fallen hero that chooses to enslave humans in his territory for the sole purpose is to force them into labor.
She is the hero Ma Ye-Rin younger sister.

__Height:__ 202 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Iron Arm Warrior
__Ability:__ Transcendent strength and durability, Syrum-008

He is a warrior with an iron arm and belongs to the destructive force led by the Sword Warrior.

__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ Time Warrior
__Ability:__ Warhammer that increases mass at the cost of superhuman physical abilities and longevity
__Holy Relic:__ Retirement Chronos
__Family:__ Im Do-won (Father), mother

An old warrior with a white beard and a helmet with an X-shaped notch. He is currently only 19 years old, but when he went to another world, he was an ordinary 18-year-old student. The reason he, who was ordinary at 18, suddenly aged in just one year is that he fought as a warrior of time, dedicating his life to it. After defeating the Demon King, when he returned to Earth, he had only 6 years left to live. His appearance as a middle-aged man is briefly revealed in a flashback, and apart from having a beard, he resembles his father a lot.

__Height:__ 179 cm
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__  Martial Arts Warrior
__Ability:__ Heavenly Horse God

A martial arts warrior, he belongs to the destructive force led by the Sword Warrior, [Minsu Kim](https://anilist.co/character/251435/MinSu-Kim).
he is the team leader of the heroes division who works against the heros.

__Height:__ 270 cm (Based on her robot form)
__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior ~!Independent!~
__Epithet:__ Reformation Warrior
__Ability:__ Mechanized body, advanced science and technology

She is one of the warriors who sided with Minsu Kim and helped destroy the Republic of Korea. She is a modified warrior whose entire body is mechanical. Originally an ordinary girl, she went to the modified world and transformed her entire body into a machine to fight against the Demon King.

Although her human body was placed as the core inside the machine, she has become indistinguishable from a machine and seems unable to exit the machine on her own. Because of this, she no longer considers herself human and has doubts about her identity. After returning to her original world, people did not accept her as a cold machine and saw her as a monster. Eventually, Lee Garam, filled with resentment, joined Kim Min-soo's destructive acts and became a warrior of destruction. Her ruling region is Chungcheongbuk-do.

__Height:__ 163 cm
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces, Reconstructed Government
South Korean government (Formerly)
__Epithet:__ Verdant Warrior
__Ability:__ Plant manipulation
__Holy Relic:__ Bow
__Family:__ father, mother, younger brother

He is the only survivor of the group of warriors who sided with the South Korean government against the 9-Warriors.

__Affiliation:__ Destruction Force Warrior
__Epithet:__ Plague Warrior (given by government), Warrior of Perfection
__Ability:__ Spread of the plague

He is a warrior belonging to the Destruction Force Warrior. He is called the Warrior of Plagues due to his abilities, but he was chosen because these abilities were the most suitable for granting the death desired by the residents of the World of Perfection. His official title is the Warrior of Perfection.

__Height:__ 170 cm or taller
__Affiliation:__ Resistance Forces
__Epithet:__ Magic Warrior
__Ability:__ Various magic through circle magic
__Holy Relics:__ Grimoire, Staff

He was the Magic Warrior and one of the Resistance Warriors who sided with the South Korean government against the 9-Warriors, though he only did so for his own selfish reasons. At some point before the main story, he was slain by Minsu Kim.

synonyms: Actually, I Was the Real One
ฉันนี่แหละที่เป็นตัวจริง
description:
A prophecy foretold that the Grand Duke would only have one water elementalist born from him. Though she lacks her father’s affection, Keira knows she’s destined for those powers. But after years of doing what was right and proper of a noble, she’s executed after the conniving Cosette appears, claiming to be the Grand Duke’s real daughter. But then—Keira wakes up with newfound purpose: make changes, allies, and even friends before it’s too late. Will it be enough before Cosette hatches her plot?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: A talented magician of the magic tower; Daphne Schaur's older brother

description:
They consider themselves the best of friends. Others seem to think otherwise. There's something about their relationship that's hard to describe. What will become of these two "friends"?

(Source: Lezhin US)

 Note: Includes a prologue, an epilogue, one special and 16 side story chapters.

synonyms: Does the Lord's Coin Not Shrink?!
领主大人的金币用不完
คอยน์เจ้าเมืองไม่ลดลงเลย?!
description:
Aaron Steelegard's fortune was basically set as he discovered a book that allowed him to trade across dimensions—until his enemies take both his life and his riches away. But Aaron is brought back as his younger self, armed with his past knowledge and a chance at revenge! Now free to amass coins, he's gaining powerful abilities and moving up the ranks of the interdimensional trading markets. Will Aaron gain enough coins to survive this journey of vengeance and reclaim his honor?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: การกลับมาของแรงเกอร์
description:
During the early years of the hottest MMORPG called Arena, the world’s top-ranker Meleegod vanished after setting every possible record in the virtual world. In the real world, this deathly melee damage dealer was the happy-go-lucky Kang Hyeon-U, who simply deleted his character and quit his hobby to finish mandatory military service and inherit his father’s company. This rosy future dissolves within two years when a business rival makes his father go bankrupt. Hyeon-U struggles to make ends meet with a string of part-time jobs, but his best friend has a better idea. He urges Hyeon-U to conquer the Arena once again and earn a cushy living as a gaming celebrity. Vowing to strike it rich and avenge his father, the former Meleegod returns to the Arena as a newbie. Only this time, he’s out for blood!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

characters.description: Hyeon-U's pet.

synonyms: The Best Childhood Friend in the World
description:
Yang-Cheon Ku, born to the virtuous House of Ku of Sanseo, the Little Star and next Head of House. Status: The world’s most hated demonic martial artist. Cause of death: Defeated during the Virtuous-Demonic War, tortured upon capture. Or so he thought. Moments after dying in the arms of his childhood friend, the Heavenly Sword herself, Seol-ah Wi, he finds himself back in the past. Already things have changed, but is it enough to ensure his second chance at life doesn’t end with the same regrets?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: Once Again Into the Light, Alone
description:
When Princess Alisa is framed for a terrible crime, she is shocked to learn that her own family wants her executed. Feeling defeated, she finds herself reborn as the princess of a rival empire. And though her new family acts sweet and kind on the surface, she’s not sure they can be truly trusted. Luckily, with this new life comes new power. But what exactly is this mysterious magic that awakens in her? And more importantly, can she use it to get vengeance against those who once betrayed her?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Confucius of the Duke of Beltmore and close associate of Isis.

The daughter of Rollang Marquises, she has the talents of a spirit warrior, but this talent is her most pressing need, something she's been honing day and night to be recognized by her, given that her mother, who has given her her purple eyes and hair, is a fairly cynical personality.
She is Marquis Rusel's wife and Iris mother.

synonyms: ヘルムート～魔物に育てられた子～
赫尔穆特·魔物养育之子
description:
Helmut was only a baby when he was left in the Forest of Pahe, an evil place full of beasts where sinners are banished for eternity. Luckily, one magical beast and an exiled swordsman take pity on him and raise him as their own. But with a dark seed growing inside him, Helmut decides to take up the sword to prevent the seed from turning him evil. As Helmut grows stronger, he seeks out the family that abandoned him, but will Helmut end up following his human heart or his beastly instincts?

(Source: Tapas)

alternative: Bearer of the Seed of Darkness

characters.description: Helmut was a child who had been abandoned in the Magic Beast Forest at birth. Raised by Magic Beasts, the first human that he met was the Sword Saint Darien. Little did Helmut know that the chance encounter would soon shake the foundation of his fate.

synonyms: エンディングメーカー
Ending Maker: Os Arquitetos do Fim
description:
After "outboxer009" wakes up in the body of Jude Bayer from Legend of Heroes 2, he soon discovers that his rival "sandstorm" has also entered the game world as Cordelia Chace. These top-two-ranked old pros come to realize that navigating this game world is much harder than just pointing and clicking. With the apocalyptic conclusion of the game looming before them, they'll have to combine his quick wit, her foul mouth, and both their gamer mindsets to make a new, less cataclysmic ending.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

synonyms: ดรูอิดแห่งสถานีโซล
description:
What started out as an ordinary day turned upside down when an unknown catastrophe struck Earth, transporting Suho Park to a different planet. He eventually learns how to adapt and fight for his survival in this foreign world, but one day, just as suddenly as he was sucked into this new planet, Suho is pulled back to Earth. He quickly learns that return to life as he remembers it is no longer possible, as Earth is in constant battle with monsters who’ve managed to infiltrate the planet. How will Suho fight against the monsters attacking Earth, and will he be able to survive this time with his current skills?

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: ชีวิตที่สองของนางร้าย
description:
From childhood, Artezia Rosan's happiness was dependent on ensuring the success of her brother. As a master manipulator and schemer, she became his most valuable ally in seizing the empire’s throne. That’s exactly why her brother's betrayal cut so deeply when Artezia was imprisoned as punishment for all of her crimes. Soon after being rescued by Grand Duke Cedric Ebron, she vows to help him overthrow the cruel new emperor by sacrificing her own life with forbidden magic. Now waking up several years earlier back in time, she will forsake her own family to help Cedric at all costs. They say that blood is thicker than water, but can Artezia destroy her brother while her own romance blossoms amidst the chaos?

(Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: Artezia "Tia" Rozan is the apparent heir to the house of Marquess Rozan.
The Grand Duke.
He is the half sibling of the female lead, the son of the emperor and mother of Arteria Rozan. The female lead before returning back, gave her all for him and made him the emperor but was betrayed.

title.english: My Daughter Is The Final Boss

synonyms: Minha Filha é a Chefã Final
description:
Lee Seojun could only watch as his daughter, the witch Lee Seola, turned into the wicked final boss who destroyed the world and brought upon his death. Though never a good dad, as he loses consciousness, Seojun gets a new quest: “Change The Future.” Upon awakening, he sees a 5-year-old Seola standing before him. Now, Seojun must raise Seola to avoid the misfortunes that originally turned her wicked and become the caring father she never had. The price of failure? Only the end of the world.

(Source: Tapas)

After being put on trial, the deity once known as "The Divine Twilight" is offered a job by Thanatos, king of the underworld! Now, the fallen deity is back on Earth as his former self, Lee Chang-Seon, and is tasked with sealing those trying to invade from beyond. With the promise of a fresh start, Chang-Seon is gathering the gear and skills needed to get the job done, but he's feeling some watchful eyes on him... Will this Divine Twilight see a new day, or is the sun setting on his second chance?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: I'm Not That Kind of Talent

synonyms: Je ne suis pas celui que vous croyez
description:
A talented individual who is respected by many and welcomed anywhere? Not at all! A bloodthirsty battle fanatic who knows no defeat? Couldn’t be further from the truth! In reality, Deon Hardt is a sickly human who coughs up blood from receiving the tiniest bit of stress and gets sunburns from standing in the sun for ten minutes. But due to an unfortunate misunderstanding, he becomes “Demon Arut,” the notorious 0th corps commander of the demon army and the demon king’s joker. Caught in a war between humans and demonkind, Deon must find a way to survive!

(Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: Demon King, he is an individual that only can be killed by a hero. He is also responsible for managing the demon realm's safety, and due to his long lifespan he has mastered all weapons techniques and arts. Furthermore, he was also the one that recruited Deon Hart, a human that he misheard as Demon Arut to become the specialized Zero Corp's Commander after witnessing Deon "kill" the Hero.

synonyms: The Constellation That Returned From Hell
A Constelacao que Voltou do Inferno
description:
One fateful day, a mysterious place called the “Abyss,” which is full of celestials and monsters, appeared on Earth. These celestials from the Abyss required the faith of believers to maintain their power, making Earth and its great population a jackpot for them. Unfortunately, among the good celestials who handed out blessings to humans in return for their faith, there were evil celestials who preferred to use more powerful means to just take over Earth. Yeonseung Choi is one of the many hunters on Earth who protect people from the threat of the dungeons and the monsters that come from the Abyss. However, he is obsessed with training and becoming stronger, to the point that a celestial has a vision of him saving Earth from a calamity involving demonic celestials swallowing up Earth whole. Thus, she makes a contract with him to have him train and become the hero from her vision. Will Yeonseung really be able to endure the arduous training in the Abyss and return to Earth to save it?

(Source: Tappytoon)

We all hate the greedy villains hell-bent on sabotage. Enter Carnelia Easter, the awful secondary villainess of the romance I’m reading, who trapped the prince in marriage at the behest of the evil empress. I didn’t shed a tear when her head’s lopped off, but now I’m Carnelia! I gotta play this smart and convince him to divorce me instead! Still, between the prince, the empress, the heroine, the second prince, my terrible health... this story’s getting unpredictable. Will I survive after all?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The first prince, and a maid's son.
She came from a household of aristocrats that had no power.
Canaria's personal guard and Cesar's friend.

Gracie is the heroine of the original novel, and the original candidate to be Caesar's wife.

~!She does not want to get married, as doing so would not give her freedom. Gracie wants to be the head of House Lancaster, but as a woman she wasn't allowed to.!~
Oscar is Empress Evgenia's aide.
Third son of a fallen noble family. One of Caesar's faithful subordinates.
One of Ceasar's faithful subordinates.
A mercenary and Caesar's closest confidant. One of Caesar's faithful subordinates.
The Empress and Noah's mother.
Gracie's cousin and the current candidate to be the next head of House Lancaster.
Masha is an errand boy in noble society, who knows the tastes of all noble ladies. He helps Caesar pick a gift for Carnelia.

synonyms: 废柴重生之我要当大佬
description:
Ju Seo-Cheon, a man who survives the age of war through sheer luck and becomes the elder of the Hwasan faction, only to live a life full of regrets and doubts. As he lies on his death bed, waiting for the inevitable, he is returned to the past...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.description: Seo-Cheon is the main protagonist of the story. In his past life he was an elder of the Mount Hua Sect that survived the "Age of War".

Known as the Poisonous Phoenix of the 5 Dragons and 3 Phoenixes, Dang Hye is an elite that stands above all the other young prodigies in her generation. Not only is she exceptionally beautiful, she is also an extremely formidable martial artist from the Dang Clan.
Top genius of the 4th generation Mount Hua Sect. The granddaughter of the Iron Blooded Blossom Sword.

synonyms: เกิดใหม่พร้อมพลังแห่งราชัน
description:
In a world where one's worth is determined by how powerful their skill is, Taehyeon is 35, unawakened, and barely able to scrape by as a pack bearer for monster hunters. But when a mysterious being calling itself “the King” gives him a skill of his own, Taehyeon gets a second chance at life. Now he’s back in high school and armed with Gluttony, a skill that allows him to block and absorb the skills of others!

(Source: Webtoons)

A young man set forth to avenge his master, a once powerful martial artist who was betrayed by his own men and barely escaped with his life. Armed with his master's supreme martial art techniques, he is ready to bring terror and wreak havoc among the murim. But before he even got started, he learns that the ones who had betrayed his master are already dead... Erm, so what happens now?

characters.description: Disciple of Dokgo Ryong, the Absolute One.

Yong-Bi is a senior member of the old Murim, being a part of the Sage Forest. In the past, he was a bounty hunter and once served as the Black Lancers' Lord Commander and as a general under the Grand General's Command (대장군부, Daejang-gunbu), the most powerful military organization in the country which was under the direct command of the Emperor.

alternative: The Ice Jade Empress of the Fan

characters.description: Jin Garyeong is the current Lady of the Baekma Valley having inherited the position from her mother.

synonyms: My School Life Pretending To Be a Worthless Person
description:
The world discovered the essence of the human soul, Ideia, and found a way to materialize it. The stronger one's Ideia, the more power one has. In a society where hierarchy is determined by this power, F-rank Park Jinsung has always been his school's punching bag. In reality, though, he is an S-rank with extreme bloodlust, which he has been hiding to keep others safe. With only two years left of high school, will Jinsung be able to hide his killer side and prove rank isn't everything?

(Source: Tapas)

When a goddess transports Hansoo Kang and his classmates to a magical fantasy world to become heroes, it’s like a dream come true. But when Hansoo declines to risk his life for a world that isn’t his own, the goddess leaves him for dead, alone in the forest. That’s when he realizes she’s not what she seems. With the help of a loner god, Hansoo faces the hostile new world and earns powerful blessings to help him survive. But his goal isn’t to save the world; it’s to return home… well, after he gets revenge on the goddess that is.

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: I Became the Wife of the Male Lead
ラスボスの私が主人公の妻になりました
成為我筆下男主角的妻子
ฉันกลายเป็นภรรยาของพระเอก
description:
Evil mage Fiona Green was destined to die at the hands of the protagonist couple in “The Emperor and the Saint.” That is, until the story’s author became Fiona herself! Though mistreated, cast out by her pompous family and thrown into the battle at Heylon, Fiona is determined to use her magic for good. But things take a rather unexpected turn when she rescues the male lead, Siegren, turning him from foe to friend… Will she successfully rewrite her fate without changing the story’s happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description:
The final boss in the original novel. Being the illegitimate child of Count Green, she was subjected to a miserable childhood. However, unbeknownst to anyone, she carried a great talent for magic, which would earn her renown as a great mage. For unknown reasons, the author one day wakes up as her.

~!Following events in the capital, she officially became Abel Heylon's adopted daughter and heir, becoming Fiona Heylon.!~

Duke of the North. He's Siegren's mentor and Fiona's benefactor. Though cold to outsiders, he shows a much warmer side of him to his allies, and especially Fiona, whom he regards as his daughter, even insisting on her calling him "father". ~!During the events in the capital, he gains Fiona's consent in adopting her as his heir, thus giving the Heylon name to her!~
The bastard child of the emperor, born to a commoner mother. He is Abel Heylon´s disciple.

description:
Ha-Neul has a secret hobby: taking photos of his crush, Chan-Il. But when Hyeon-Un stumbles upon Ha-Neul's cloud storage with its impressive collection of Chan-Il's photos, things escalate pretty quickly. At first confident his secret is safe with Hyeon-Un, Ha-Neul continuously finds himself in compromising situations, making him question Hyeon-Un's true motives.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

characters.description:
__Height__: 182 cm (6')

Chan-Il’s friend and the one who discovered Ha-Neul’s collection of photos.

__Height__: 173 cm (5' 8.5")

Has been part of the photography club since his first year in high school. His hobby is taking pictures of his crush, Chan-Il.

__Height__: 185 cm (6'1)

Has been part of the photography club since his first year in high school, and is currently receiving lessons from Ha-Neul.
A friend of Cirrus and the sister of Da-In.

synonyms: ソウル駅のネクロマンサー
เนโครแมนเซอร์แห่งสถานีโซล
description:
After years of fighting for survival on planet Alphen, Kang Woojin had become a fearsome necromancer and ruler of his own territory. But now that he’s finally found a way back to Earth, he’s nothing more than a low-level player clearing dungeons for cash. Soon enough, though, Woojin’s undeniable skills have major guilds vying for his attention. And just in time, because with Woojin’s old enemy threatening invasion, those skills might be the only thing standing between humanity and destruction!

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: U-Jin's familiar, a succubus.
Jae-Min's older sister.

synonyms: The Monster Duchess and Contract Princess
description:
The Speràdo family line possesses a secret: shadow magic. But it’s been 100 years since someone last wielded it. When Marquis Speràdo tries to sacrifice Leslie for her favored sister Ellie, little does he know that this awakens the power of darkness in her instead. To escape her family’s greed and abuse, Leslie’s out to make a deal with the Monstrous Duke: adopt her, and her powers will be at the duke’s disposal. Will Leslie escape her parents’ cruel grip, or succumb to their evil exploits?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 20 extra stories.

characters.description: Leslie Shuya Salvator formerly Sperado is the main protagonist. She is known as the Black Saint and is the only daughter and lady of the Salvator family. She is the former second daughter of the Sperado family, and was born to be a sacrifice for her older sister, Ellie de arne Sperado.

Acela Benkan Salvatore is known as the Monster Duchess as well as a powerful swordsman and magician. She quickly adopts Leslie after seeing the power of the Black Saint.
She is Sairaine's wife.
Eldest son of Duke Altera and Ruenti's friend. He is a paladin knight of the Tesentraha temple. Konrad entered the temple when he was around seven years old.
Duchess Salvatore's second son, Bethrion's younger brother.  He becomes Leslie's teacher.
Duchess Salvatore's eldest son.
A mercenary and Acela's husband.
Konrad's little brother.

description:
What would you do with the chance to become far greater than your greatest rivals… before they could even start? When a dominant guild gangs up on Rokan to humiliate him and destroy his hard-earned achievements in the world's most realistic fantasy VR game, he becomes desperate for revenge. But just when Rokan thinks he's lost it all, a twist in space-time sends him back to right before the game is even launched. Now, this former SSS-ranker sees the perfect opportunity to return to glory!

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: Nhan sắc bí ẩn của chồng tôi
description:
Another lifetime, another hard life—Letitia’s misery continues as her uncle sends her off to the “Monster Lord” to fulfill an old pledge. Imp attacks! The three witches! A hideous masked devil hunter husband! Terrifying is an understatement. But as she becomes the lady of Halstead, the rumors fall apart. Lord Erden is caring, he likes bunnies, and that *gasp* perfect face under the mask! How can he not know he’s HOT? Can she help protect the castle from devils and help Erden see his true self?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Na Kang-Rim is a high school student who generally likes webtoons. One day, he experiences something bizarre: the female main character from a webtoon he often reads appeared before him.

The incidents that happened in the webtoon started happening in the real world too, but the problem is that there is no hero to save her this time! So Kang-Rim decides to become the hero and save her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

characters.description: Na-Ri Yoo is the little sister of [Da-Hee Yoo](https://anilist.co/character/246583/DaHui-Yu).

__Affiliation:__ Team DO (Former)

She has had a talent for games since childhood, and because of that talent, she doesn't get along well with others.

From her days as a promising player before her pro debut, perfect self-management, schedule and training, and high performance to match, she has done everything. Even so, it is said that she could not find a smile on her face. However, thanks to Song Eun-Sa, whom she met while preparing to become a pro gamer, she realizes that her talent is a gift. As soon as she debuted, she won the championship, so she is a top-tier player called the Empress. As she is a rare female player in her industry, her popularity is at an all-time high both at home and abroad.

synonyms: Legendary Youngest Son of the Marquis House
The Margravial Household's Phenomenal Youngest Son
The Youngest Son of a Marquis
description:
After getting revenge on the Thulcaan Empire, Jack Valantier took his last breath. But just when he thinks it's all over, he finds himself transported back to when he was 14! From his negligent and wicked family to his loyal servant and caring sister, it's all just as he had remembered. But this time, Jack is armed to the teeth with decades of experience from his previous life! He's ready to give them hell, and those that have wronged him will pay dearly. Because this time, he's invincible.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The third child of the Valantier family, Jack Valantier. The protagonist of the story.

description:
Having been summoned to the alternate, game-like universe of the Whole Plane 10 years ago by mysterious angelic beings, Su-Hyeon has finally reached the Apex of the world. But at what cost? Using his privilege as the Apex, Su-Hyeon invokes the power of Code Zero to go back 10 years and rectify his past filled with tragedy.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

characters.description:
__Height__: 181 cm (5'11")

~!After losing his brother and beloved ones, he decides to climb to the zenith of the hall plains to obtain "zero code" which will grant him any wish.!~

description:
A medical mission turns fatal as Dr. Jin’s life slips away. Miraculously, he wakes on a battlefield. Instinct takes over. He tends to patients before realizing that this is the martial arts world of The Reigning Heavenly Demon! He’s reincarnated as a child with mastery of modern medicine and soon his skills draw notice. From the renowned White-scaled Doctor to the infamous Gongson Family, everyone sees his potential. But how much is Dr. Jin willing to sacrifice before risking death again?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: ตำนานการเกิดใหม่ในลัทธิมาร
description:
Tired of the yoke of the Divine Justice Alliance, master assassin Cheon Ha-Jin attempts to flee, only to be confronted by martial artists of all allegiances, both orthodox and deviant. Succumbing to the wounds of his ferocious struggle for freedom, he awakens in the body of Seo Ryang, a prince of the notorious Heavenly Demon Cult who suffers from a disorder that prohibits him from the use of qi. In order to survive in his new life, Ha-Jin must contend with the many dangers and enemies that lurk within the cult.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description:
Cheon Ha-Jin was an assassin of Divine Justice Alliance and is one of the Ten Great Masters. He was known as Dam Sa-Yeong's faithful hunting dog. He was later killed by Gwak So-Gyo, the Queen of Soaring Beauty.

After dying, Cheon Ha-Jin reincarnates to the body of Seo Ryang, the third prince of the Heavenly Demon Cult and a student of the Demon Lord, who fell victim to qi reflux and spent six months in a coma.
Lee Cheon-Sang is the Ninth Great Heavenly Demon of the Heavenly Demon cult. Grandmaster of the Demonic Path and the lord of all demons.

Wi Hong-Ryeon is the captain of the Ruthless Demon Barbarians and is the youngest and most aggressive among all the combat unit captains. She joined the Demon Cult to find a way to survive after her family was destroyed when she was still a child.

Hong-Ryeon received bribes from the fourth prince which lead her to meeting Seo Ryang.

Ma Dong-Pil is the team leader of the Third Defense Team in the Heavenly Demon Cult and  is one of the strongest masters in the Defense Team. He is described as talented, experienced, and honest. He was assigned to be Seo Ryang's bodyguard in the Bamboo Forest of Solitude.
She is the personal maid of Seo Ryang.

Hong Yeo-Rin  is the daughter of the Red Serpent, one of the seven houses of the Demonic Path and the younger sister of the fourth prince. She has been working as a demon warrior for the Hall of Joy.

Hong Yeo-Rin is renowned for her strength and intelligence, she is recognized as a fotmidable figure by the Demon Cult in the martial arts realm.
Hong Wi-Mun is the fourth prince of the Heavenly Demon Cult and a student of the Demon Lord. He is the son of the Red Serpent, one of the seven houses of the Demonic Path.
Mu Dam is the grand guardian of the Defense Team of the Heavenly Demon Cult.

synonyms: Conquering the Academy with Just a Sashimi Knife
I Took Over the Academy with a Single Sashimi Knife
ชำแหละอะคาเดมีด้วยมีดแล่ปลา
description:
Chef Kim, Korea's legendary sashimi master, is transported into the world of Blessing M, a mobile game he once played. But instead of being a hero, he finds himself as Geomma Kang, a mere background extra. Forced into a new life, Geomma discovers a new power: the Blessing of the Blade God. Now, to survive in this game-like world, he must slice through challenges and enemies alike. Will his unmatched skills in the kitchen be enough to carve out a new destiny?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Daughter of the Broken Bow.
Blade Emperor's granddaughter.
Spear Saint's niece.
Seven Star Hero Sage and the director of Joaquin Academy.
He's from a branch of Spear Saint's family.
Seven Star Hero Blade Emperor.

synonyms: ท่านพ่อไร้เทียมทาน
description:
Ga-Jang No is a strong, dedicated, and humble man, with much respect for the martial arts. After the death of his lovely wife, this muscle-for-hire just wants an easy job that allows him to be a good father to his three little babies. He’s even happy to pull guard duty and fend off amateur fighters if it means he can return home safely each night. But when a creepy cult starts stealing children from the city, Ga-Jang must step up to the challenge and discover his true warrior potential.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description: No Ga-Jang is the main protagonist of Peerless Dad. He is the adopted son and disciple of Mo Wei and the successor of the Trillion Blows Art.
She is the youngest children of Noh Gajang. She is extremely intelligent and has a great talent for martial arts, surpassing her older siblings and apparently any child of her age.

Seo-Mun Mira was Noh Ga-Jang's first wife. She died as soon as she gave birth to the triplets. Noh always found traces of nobilty in her based on the way she acted and behaved, yet no clue was found.

She always brought happiness to his household until the day she died giving birth.

synonyms: ผู้เล่นขั้นเทพจากเกมติดบั๊ก
description:
Taepung Shin knows every nook and cranny of his favorite MMO video game Paradiso like it was the back of his hand! However, his gaming adventures suffer an abrupt end after his untimely death. But this is not his last hurrah since he's reincarnated as Jared, a delinquent lord of a frozen province... in Paradiso! Now, he must brave the world he loved and take advantage of all glitches he knows about and turn himself into the main character of his new solo adventure!

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description:
Haze, a cute, loyal, heartwarming side character and love interest of Jared, serves the role of a maid for Jared and has been serving him for over a decade.
~!She now assists Jared in his management of Caribia as well as being the designated healer for the dukedom. During her time of servitude, Haze had fallen in love with Jared.!~

description:
An ordinary middle schooler, Lee Seong-Min, is summoned to a world called "Eria". He endures dozens of years with no skills or powers, and makes it through all kinds of hardships to survive, but dies miserably in the end.

However, before he dies, he gets sent back to the past after obtaining the ‘Stone of the Past Life’ by chance, and gains the opportunity to start his life anew.

Yet, he still lives a life without any talents; nothing. Although he can’t approach the powerful people around him due to the "wall" surrounding them, he moves forward step by step with firm determination, never giving up.

"No matter what, I’m going to live a better life than my previous one even if I have to struggle!"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

characters.description: __Age:__ 18 ~!2100+ (Post-Consciousness World)!~

synonyms: เกมของยอดมนุษย์
description:
Seventeen years ago, the world was saved from destruction by the Seven Heroes. But it came with the sacrifice of the strongest one among them, Seomun Yeop. Now that there is peace, beings like the Seven Heroes known as “espers” no longer have use for their supernatural powers. That’s where Battle Field comes in, an action VR game specifically created to allow espers to showcase their skills. Unfortunately, Korea hasn’t been doing so well in the recent tournaments, making it hard to believe that it was once home to the greatest esper in history. But just when all hope seems lost, Seomun Yeop miraculously returns! Will the legendary hero be able to save his people yet again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Fresh out of a breakup, game developer Woo-Jin has little going for him. So when he hears that the middle boss of their game is based on him, he can't resist adding a few traits to make his virtual alter ego a tad more noble. Little did he know, he would soon end up trapped in said villain's skin! With a 1 in 1,000 chance of survival, Woo-Jin now has to navigate the countless variables leading him to his impending doom. Will the tweaks he made to the character tip the scales in his favor?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: U-Jin Kim is a game developer, who possesses the body of Deculein, an in-game villain.

Deculein's fiancée.

Her relationship with Deculein is not very good. From the day of their first engagement, she was disappointed by his actions as if he was trying to buy her with his wealth. After that, she learned of all the corruption and evil deeds that Deculein committed to get in her way or gain power in the Magic Tower, and she came to hate him even more.
She is the daughter of the former head of the Yukline family and his second wife, and is Deculein's half-sister.
Yuria is an in-game character who got possessed  by Kim U-Jin's ex-girlfriend, Yuara.
She is a named character who can kill anyone with just a single strand of her hair. A true warrior and adventurer who has reached the pinnacle of physical strength.
She is the chairman of the Imperial University and a wizard who rose to the rank of Ether at a young age.

synonyms: สไนเปอร์กระสุนเวท
description:
A series about a hyper-realistic fantasy game!

"Sargent Ha, you crazy bastard. You shot another full round of bullseyes?"

The sharpshooter Ha Lee-Ha simply wanted to be a part of the army forever. However, due to an unfortunate accident, he became paraplegic and was tossed back into society. The revolutionary VR game [Middle Earth] presented a new life to him. Money obtained in [Middle Earth] has real-world value! Yet, he ruined his chance by selecting the lowest-tier character!

"I'm not like the others. This is all I have."

Black gunpowder, iron balls, and ramrods... I'll show you all what a real 'musketeer' is!

synonyms: 悪神に仕える司祭になった
description:
Not all job classes are created equal! Marnac was pulled into a game while trying to play as one of its worst job classes, cleric of decay. Now he’s the only cleric of the Order of Decay, serving a goddess who’s been reduced to an animated hand that repeats the word “MURDER!” Will the Order’s last cleric become powerful enough before the prophecy of “the end” comes true?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Though he usually seems like a good priest, he shows a radical side that mercilessly kills wrongdoers and enemies.
The heroine of the fantasy novel The Corrupt Priestess.
As one of the three unique priests and masters of the Blue Flame in the Seonghwa Church, the Mother of Corruption gives him four and a half out of five fingers.
She is the god that Marnak worships and she cannot say anything except the word "murder."

title.english: My In-Laws are Obsessed with Me

synonyms: ครอบครัวสามีเห็นทีจะคลั่งรัก
description:
Pereshati Jahardt is a count's daughter who got remarried after her mother’s passing. When her father died, he left her all his fortune. Then, Pereshati's greedy stepmother and stepsister conspire with Pereshati's lover to kill her. However, under mysterious circumstances, Pereshati is brought back to life and travels back in time before her murder. To buy some time before getting her revenge, Pereshati visits the handsome yet notorious grand duke, Therdeo Lapileon, to marry him. During her visit, she uncovers a horrifying secret of his family. How will Pereshati deal with it? Will she be able to take her revenge?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

alternative: 佩雷莎提 拉菲雷昂

characters.description: Pereshati Zahardt is a countess. She was murdered by her familly due her father's fortune and ended up travelling back in time. She signed marriage contract with the Grand Duke Lapileon in effort to stay alive.

alternative: 賽莉西亞 拉菲雷昂

synonyms: มือใหม่พันธุ์เก๋า
description:
After learning 15 miserable years of his life as a failed gamer was one long nightmare, Lee Eojin is glad to be a newbie again. Vowing not to repeat the same mistakes, Eojin starts anew as the hotshot, Old-timer. He’s conquering monsters, getting sweet gear, and making enough dough to set himself up for life. Loved by fans and hated by foes, both old and new, will Eojin break the game and triumph, or will the game break him once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description:
__Nicknames:__ 1 in 7 Billion (용냥이), Drakie

Ranked No.1 in the Archers ranking and has mastered the unconventional "Archer" class. He was the indisputable #1 on PK rankings, with many players recognizing him as the "True World Rank #1". Drake is especially fond of PVP in Deus Ex Machina and does not hesitate to fight against a player. He uses a crossbow and a dagger for close combat, but is also able to set up traps.

synonyms: From the Lowest Foot Soldier to the King
The Story of a Low-Rank Soldier Becoming a Monarch
description:
When Chris, a one-armed mercenary with considerable experience and skills, swallows an artifact after an unlikely encounter with a savage looter, he finds himself back in the past as a 15-year-old lowly foot soldier... with both his arms. This time, he will not let his life take an unfortunate turn. This time, he will not let his friends die in vain. This time, he will use his knowledge and reach for the sky.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

synonyms: ปลูกผักพิชิตหอคอย
description:
Se-Jun, your average Seoul underdog, didn’t expect to grow tomatoes full-time when he stumbled into the mysterious dungeon full of monster quests and extravagant rewards. Yet, there he was, as a farmer growing and selling cash crops while clearing numerous quests that came his way. Will Se-Jun make it out of the dungeon with the plush rewards he hoped for? At least he has what it takes: optimism, resourcefulness, and a group of loyal furry friends.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description:
__Race:__ Human
__Class:__ Farmer

Park Se-Jun is the protagonist of The Top Dungeon Farmer who had been dreaming of going into the dungeon. He was transported to the 99th Floor of the Black Dungeon after forcibly jumping into the Vanishing Phenomenon and was regarded by the administrator as a mistake. There he earned the class of Farmer.

__Race:__ Cat
__Occupation:__ Peddler

Teo is a cat from Granier Village who impulsively becomes a peddler after being rejected by the cat he had a crush on. Right after becoming a peddler, he was scammed by another peddler who sold him "special" products and gave him a map that showed the new Seed Store member's location. This led him to the 99th Floor where he met Park Se-Jun and signed a contract with him as business partners to sell the crops to other hunters.

Teo is gullible and he also has lucky paws that itch if he's near a special item.

__Race:__ Black Dragon
__Occupation:__ Black Dungeon Administrator
__Race:__ Crimson Grizzly Bear

__Race:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Hunter
__Guild:__ Phoenix Guild

title.english: I Get Stronger the More I Eat

description:
Known as “Pet Shop,” Mr. Kim has the unique ability to absorb the skills of the creatures he eats. One day, Pet Shop is mysteriously transported to a magical world full of orcs, trolls, and monsters. A new world, new chow, and new skills. Now Pet Shop is determined to become the most powerful creature in the world. Follow his epic climb to the top of the food chain.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: ยอดคนเลเวลทะลุ
description:
Dungeons and monsters suddenly appear and the world falls into chaos. Ki-Bong Kim, an ordinary young part-timer, has been sucked up into an awakening dimension for 3000 years to train his powers. When he makes his return to reality, he is a max-leveled player who only has one wish -- to reconcile with his loved ones. 10 years have passed in the real world during his absence. How will Ki-Bong be able to find his place in the world with his new limit-breaking abilities?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: He was trapped in the Awakening Test for 3000 years.
He likes to follow Kim Ki-Bong around.

synonyms: 剣任せでレベルアップ
description:
Though Leon has years' worth of training in swordsmanship, it's still not enough to defeat his rival at the royal academy, Lionel. That is until one day, the holy sword Elsyd appears and names Leon as his chosen hero and new pupil. The young swordmaster didn't expect the holy sword's instruction to be easy, but now Elsyd is even trying to teach him how to... see? If Leon can manage to endure this, will he finally be strong enough to beat the privileged Lionel and earn his place in the world?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: I Used to Be a Boss
description:
Baphomet is the ruthless, dispassionate lord of the Abyssal Tower, a mysterious, monster-filled dungeon plaguing the human world. Many Hunters seek to defeat him and bring the tower down to no avail. Despite his demonic power, Baphomet grows curious about humanity. One day, Baphomet is defeated by Raven, the strongest Hunter, and realizes that his true wish is to be just like the humans he previously looked down on. In death, he is granted his wish, as he awakens as a human – without his powers!

(Source: WEBTOON)

On his deathbed, the supreme dark leader is given an ironic second chance at life. He’s reborn as Jin-Mu, a young disciple of his rival clan, the righteous Mudang. Determined to make the best of a bad situation, he resolves to plunge the clan into corruption and debauchery by becoming their master disciple. Oblivious to this nefarious scheme, the Mudang begin to fall for Jin-Mu's audacious approach to life and martial arts. Will Jin-Mu be the Mudang Clan’s downfall or just the kick in the pants it needs?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

synonyms: お見合い相手はうちのボス
I Got a Date with the President
description:
After being worked to the bone at her office job, getting introduced to her longtime crush’s new girlfriend, and dealing with her family’s debt hanging over her head, Hari Shin's life seems to have hit rock bottom. Luckily, her friend Youngseo has a business proposal for her: go to an arranged date in her stead and Hari will receive a hefty compensation. Things grow complicated, however, when it turns out that the other party is Hari’s new CEO—and he's dead-set on marrying whoever shows up to the date!

(Source: Yen Press)

characters.description: The secretary of Tae-Mu Kang.

synonyms: 俺一人だけカンストレベル帰還者
ผู้หวนคืนเลเวลแม็กซ์
description:
The world falls into a state of panic when 120 million players of a popular VR game, Eternal World, vanish without a trace one day. A few months later, they begin returning one by one after dying in the game. But they’re not the only ones to make it back—monsters also start to appear and wreak havoc on Earth. All hope seems lost until the Masked Monarch, the most powerful player of Eternal World, returns. He quickly assembles his old team back together to defeat the beasts and the nefarious Demon King once and for all. But man-made weapons are useless against the enemies they must fight, and players are struggling to level up without the game’s special items or rewards. The Masked Monarch has a few tricks up his sleeve, but will they be enough to save the world?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Erkin, a young pharmacist from the north, was orphaned from the war between the Northern Nations and Mormeratta. After making a name for himself in Mormeratta, he is summoned to treat a mysterious “master of the castle” whom no one has ever seen. He reluctantly agrees, hoping it will bring him one step closer to finding the infamous Witch of the Sun who killed his parents during the war. Little does he know, on his quest for vengeance, the witch may have been by his side all along. What will Erkin do when confronted by his sworn enemy turned friend?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

characters.description: One of five guardian knights of Mormeratta - also known as the Equites. Elder sister of Anetta Elva.
Younger sister of Griselda Elva.
Terion's younger twin sister. Clever and outspoken, she is next in line to head the Widehen family and act as warden of southern Mormeratta.

One of Hildegar's oldest friends, Prince Leonard is the only son of former King Valdekis and Queen Dowager Lestrephia. Born with a frail constitution, much of his youth was spent in the territory of Rovency, or at the palace in Emrik. This sheltered upbringing, along with his lack of political power and his habit of spending his days drinking & fooling around with women, has resulted in him being nicknamed the "Prince in Name Only."
Albrecht is the Commander of the Royal Emrik Knights. He is the Uncle of Terion.

synonyms: เลดี้ผู้ห้ามแตะต้อง
description:
Noblewoman Hillis Inoadenn has had many lives so far (seven, to be exact) but she has always been regarded the same in all of them: meek, submissive, and a pest. But in her eighth resurrection, she no longer bends to the nobles that encircle her, nor does she continue to live in the shadows of her wicked brother and half-sister. With a sacred power passed down from her lineage and the title of Family Head, she sets out for revenge and to change the grave destiny that awaits her.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Hillis' personal maid.
Hillis' and Gabrielle's elder brother.
The former head of the Inoadenn family.

synonyms: นักฆ่าย้อนวัย
description:
After devoting his life to the crime organization, Glory Club, Peter retires his status as a legendary killer and spends his remaining days running a quiet used bookstore. But after being ambushed and nearly killed one day by the very organization he dedicated his life to, Peter finds his body magically reverted back to its teenage years. Now that Peter was back to his peak physique, he sets out to settle the score with Glory Club.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: The best hacker from Glory.

synonyms: โรแมนซ์ต้องรอด!
description:
When Chaerin Eun becomes the protagonist of the romance novel she is reading, she expects a fairytale ending with the novel’s love interest, Jeha. But when a bizarre twist makes her realize the story is not playing out as it does in the book, she’ll need the help of an unlikely character from her class to defy the new storyline and find her happy ending -- if only she can figure out who this ‘Unknown Extra’ is first!

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
A woman who appeared in the world of a novel after dying. She became the main character - Chaerin Eun, a "drop-dead gorgeous" girl who was only liked by her admirers. She lives a comfortable life inside the novel, until the day on which Jeha was supposed to confess to her comes.

She tries every way to live a normal life again. After living and dying around 400 times, she meets a mysterious extra who dies in front of her afterward. After reviving, she promises herself to find her helper and dedicates her time, life, and resources to help the classmates.

__Height:__ 148 cm

A student in Class 2-3. Mihui runs a MeTube channel called HuiHui TV.

~!The unknown extra that helped Chaerin.!~

Ji-Hyeon is the seventh student Chae-Rin is able to see, when she takes Chae-Rin's side against Ms. Lee.

Ji-Hyeon is kind and considerate. She is on the volleyball team, but otherwise is not mentioned much in the original novel. However, Chaer-Rn learns that the day before the zombie incident, she sprained her ankle. She is also a singer who uploads her songs to MeTube.

__Height:__ 164 cm

A student in Class 2-3. Skilled in kendo, Jinhui has won a national kendo competition.

Ri-Na is the tenth classmate that Chae-Rin is able to see, after Chae-Rin promises to take her to Min-U Ha. The most violent girl in the class and the main bully of Chae-Rin in the original book. She is incredibly strong and is shown to defend herself easily against the zombies on many occasions. She loves the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms and idolizes the character of Lu Bu. She is in love with Min-U Ha, who she calls her "little pop rock".
Eun Chae-Rin's classmate and bully. Se-Yeong is in love with Chae-Rin and wants to create a rift between her and Jeha.

Chae-Ram is the eighth student that Chaerin becomes able to see, when she kills Ms. Lee. Chae-Ram is a capable gymnast who was able to scale the side of the school building to another floor and jump onto the shoulder of a monstrous zombie. She seems to be aware that Chae-Rin cannot see their faces, and that she's lying about being from the future.

The second male lead in the book. Due to him being a main character in the original novel, Chae-Rin is able to see him. After the zombie outbreak, he leads a band of male students, including the student who killed the Unknown Extra. His group gains control of the school snack shop and he uses a BB gun to defend himself. He is also the twin brother of Chae-Rin's classmate Seon-U Ha.

She is the first person other than Je-Ha that Chae-Rin becomes able to see. She is a "rumor amplifier," who can make any gossip seem realistic and spread it around. In the original novel, she spread rumors about Chae-Rin and Je-Ha. Chaer-Rin takes advantage of Se-Eun's talents to convince the other class members she is telling the truth about the zombie apocalypse.

Sin-Bi  is the third student in the class that Chae-Rin becomes able to see, after Chae-Rin confronts her about the voodoo dolls.

She usually takes the bus to school, but Chae-Rin texts her to get a car ride instead to avoid becoming infected. In timelines where her infection was not prevented, she infected the rest of the class. She is good at making things with her hands and used to make voodoo dolls and leave them in Chae-Rin's desk. She is friends with Ju-Ri Ma.

Depicted as an extremely tiny girl with a mushroom growing out of her head. She and Ha-Na Do are the fourth and fifth students Chae-Rin is able to see, becoming visible to her at the same time when she recognizes their strengths.

Her locker is always full of various things, and Chaerin's bullies used to hide Chaerin's belongings in there.

In addition to Ri-Na Song, she is another of Chae-Rin's bullies in the original book. When she leaves the classroom on her own she is shown to be athletic and adept at fighting zombies. She is friends with Shin-Bi Yun.
She never bullied Chae-Rin but is resistant to trusting her. She is the twelfth student to be revealed after appearing at the entrance of the science room when Chae-Rin exits.
Ha-Na is the class president. She and Seon-Yeong Kim are the fourth and fifth students Chae-Rin is able to see, becoming visible to her at the same time when she recognizes their strengths.

She is "naturally suspicious and cautious", needing proof before acting, and helped Chae-Rin when she was bullied. Min-U Ha's twin sister. She is the thirteenth student Chae-Rin is able to see after seeing her twin brother.
Like Jin-Seon Yeom, she is resistant to trusting Chae-Rin.

The male love interest of the original novel. He is the only person Chae-Rin can see at first, with all other characters appearing as indistinct shadows. He always becomes infected on the first day before he can confess his love to Chae-Rin.

synonyms: リターン～ある外科医の逆襲～
description:
Kim Jihyun, who lived his life as a disreputable surgeon, gains a second chance to relive his life. He then goes back to his middle school days, and live his life to the fullest unlike before, he studies nonstop. His goal is to become a dermatologist who make lots of money instead of the poor surgeon he was from previous life!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The best-known VR game in the world, 'Kaillan'. A certified game addict well known in the virtual world, Ian. Despite having a Level 93 Archer character in the top leaderboards of Kaillan, Ian decides to delete it despite everyone around him telling him not to. All to convert to a hidden class he obtained by chance. The class he chose is the most worthless class in Kaillan, the Summoner class. If he wants to avoid getting an F in college, he needs to level up to his previous level within two months... Kaillan is notorious for its very cruel leveling system, where it is said to take over a year to reach level 100. His struggles to reach level 93 in only two months unfold... Level quickly, thoroughly and persistently. The legend of the 'Taming Master' begins!

synonyms: It's Time to Change the Genre
I Will Make an Effort to Change the Genre
ジャンル、変えさせて頂きます！
นิยายเรื่องนี้ ฉันขอเปลี่ยนสตอรีให้เอง
description:
I woke up inside my favorite novel, not as the protagonist, Luca Winterwald, but as Judith, his abusive aunt and the first character to die—time for a rewrite! I’ll hand Luca off to his loving, long-lost uncle as scripted, and then live my own life far from danger. At least, that was the plan. When his uncle arrives, Luca suddenly calls out, “Don’t leave!” Now, I must protect Luca from impending family tragedy, raise him to become the hero, and turn this villainess’s ending upside down!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

synonyms: เล่ห์วิวาห์ไร้รัก
description:
Bianca de Arno was a ruthless countess in the Kingdom of Sevran, infamous for being a wicked and selfish wife. While her husband, Count Zachary de Arno, bravely risked his life out on the battlefield, she sat at home and spent his money. It wasn’t until her final day that Bianca realized the error of her ways. Before she dies, Bianca prays for a second chance, swearing she will do better, and wakes up in her 19-year-old body. With her second chance, Bianca starts to see everything in a new light… starting with her husband.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 46 extra chapters.

alternative: The Count of Blood and Iron

characters.description: Lord Zachary is the count of Arno and madame Bianca's husband. He's known as the Count of Blood and Iron due to the way his silver hair glistens like a well-forged sword when soaked with the blood of his enemies on the battlefield.

The eldest daughter of Gustave De Blanchefort of the prestigious Count Blanchefort family. Born in a noble status, firm and strict, educated and strong under a father who strictly observes the dignity and etiquette of a nobleman, she is a typical aristocratic girl with a keen personality.
Yvonne is Bianca's personal maid.
He's one of three Count Arno's loyal commanders.
He's the commander of Arno’s military force.
Vincent is the head butler of the household of Arno.

synonyms: Chronicles Of The Martial God’s Return
description:
After being sealed away for 1,000 years, the War God Duan Yuxian has come back to a world that has forgotten him and his malevolent past. As he wanders aimlessly through the central plains ruled by the martial world, he comes across a dying little girl named Xiaomei and revives her out of pity. Although they try to live in peace as a family, the factions of the martial world refuse to let them be. Now, Duan Yuxian has no other choice but to remind them that the War God has truly returned.

(Source: Tapas)

Yeon Jeokha had to suffer years of abuse from his father's first wife for being the favored second wife's son. His fortunes change upon finding a mirror with a spirit who teaches him the Nine Heavens Sword Art, a powerful technique his father created. After an arduous decade of training, he successfully escapes and heads to the mountains, where he joins the Obong Outlaws as their strongest member. But he soon learns that the stronger he gets, the more enemies and rivals are bound to follow...

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: Warrior High School - Dungeon Raid Department
description:
A cosmic anomaly has opened interdimensional breaches on Earth, creating exotic hybrid environments called “dungeons” inhabited by deadly otherworldly creatures. Yoo Jaryong, left to fend for himself as his father’s health deteriorates, secretly cultivates the superhuman potential arising from the anomaly and becomes a dungeon smuggler to pay his bills. When elite dungeon raiders discover his skills, he is given the chance to train at the alma mater of the world’s heroes: Yongsa High School.

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: เส้นทางสู่เทพมาร
description:
A scout in the infamous Demon Cult, Seol-Hwi is on a routine patrol when his squad unexpectedly encounters a fearsome master of the Mount Hua Sect, the sworn enemies of the Demon Cult. Without warning, the Mount Hua Cult master slaughters the entire squad. As Seol-Hwi lies dying, lamenting years of service to the cult with nothing to show for it, he is suddenly faced with a video game prompt, asking if he would like to start again. Given the opportunity to start over and make different choices, Seol-Hwi vows to survive and become stronger so he can rise to the top of the Demon Cult.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: So Ryeong is a female cult member from the Red Demon Court.

synonyms: Time Slip of the Fist King
description:
In a world where humans enslave non-human species, the powerful wizard Leppenhardt creates an empire to safeguard these beings. However, his reign ends when he's defeated by the brutally strong Tesron, the "King of Fists." But death isn’t the end, because Leppenhardt awakens in Tesron's young body! Now armed with incredible strength and a new identity, he sets off to free the non-human races again. Can the new King of Fists reshape the world for all, or will his second chance slip away?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: Her tale of Shim Chong : Loin des yeux
她的沈清：丞相夫人與她的秘戀
description:
Based on a Korean folktale, two very different women find themselves making the same wish - to leave this world behind. One is Shim Chong, a young beggar living off the kindness of others to support herself and her blind father. The other is the bride-to-be of old Chancellor Jang, sold off to him for the sake of her family. When Shim Chong rescues this new bride from the river, their relationship triggers both love and hidden intentions. But will these two women be able to find their way forth in a world that favors men?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

characters.description: Sim-Cheong is a beggar girl. She lost her mother when she was only 7 days old, and lives with her blind father, who she provides food for through her begging.

Madam is the new wife of the village minister. She is initially seen as a beautiful bride, but then is suspected to be a fox when her husband falls sick and the Indangsu river  does not allow pass of ships. She is found and saved by Cheong in the river when she falls off a boat that her brother uses to catch 'the golden turtle' which they gift to the minister instead of a dowry. She invites Cheong to the mansion to help care for the minister, and the two begin to share a deep bond, becoming romantic over time.

~!The minister's son and his subordinates blamed her for bringing 'the golden turtle' out of the river which was fed to the minister who fell sick and eventually died. They claimed that it angered the Dragoon King which was why the Indangsu river would not allow for passage. She was to be sacrificed as a virgin bride for the Dragon King, but her nanny lied and said her marriage with the minister was already consummated thus she was not the appropriate sacrifice. Instead she invited Cheong with the intention of making her into a maiden fit to be the sacrifice for the Dragon King. However she soon began to fall for Cheong, only feeling happy and truly free from the burdens that society had forced upon her for being a woman when she was with her. She realised that she only cared to be with Cheong and was willing to abandon her life in the mansion and go against what she had been taught from a young age- to be always be submissive, devoted and stripped away of her own personality and will in order to be loved. She used to believe that it was being loved that gave her the power she needed to survive, before meeting Cheong who inspired her and gave her the strength to be truly strong. She ended up killing the minister's son in self defence, and valiantly risking her life as she attempted to save Cheong from being thrown into the river.!~
A single mother whose son was severely burned in a fire that broke out while she was working. She looks after [Shim Cheong](https://anilist.co/character/147644/Shim-Cheong) and is a fortune teller.

title.english: Demon King of the Royal Class

synonyms: The Demon Prince goes to the Academy
description:
Upon dying, the author of "The Demon King is Dead" is given two choices: go to hell or be reborn in his novel and survive till the end. The problem? He's reborn as Baalier Junior, a weak demon prince, after his realm was conquered! To make things worse, his attempt to escape somehow gets him enrolled as a student of the Royal Class in Gradias Temple, a prestigious human school. In the midst of plotlines and political schemes, can this author keep his identity a secret and reach a happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

People are no longer afraid of vampires but that doesn't stop humans from discriminating against them. Can Mari Baek hide her identity when she falls in love with a popular boy who hates vampires?

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
Ma-Ri Baek is the main female protagonist in the webtoon. She is a vampire but regularly attends school without any of her schoolmates knowing her true identity. Ma-Ri is shown to be very quiet and lacking in emotion. She also turned down multiple boys without hesitation, thus earning her the nickname "Ice Princess".

She seems to have had friends in the past, but whenever her true identity as a vampire was revealed, no one wanted to stay with her since they feared they'd be bitten. This resulted into Ma-Ri being regarded as a monster, which is probably why she keeps her real identity to herself.

Jae-Min Jeong is the main male protagonist. He is a handsome teenager who is known to be the school's most popular student. Jae-Min seems to have a hatred for women and acts very cold towards them. At one time, he even yelled at them just because they touched him.

synonyms: I'm a Stepmother, but My Daughter Is Just Too Cute!
I'm the Stepmother, but My Daughter Is Too Cute
Solo soy una madrastra, ¡pero mi hija es tan linda!
I'm Only a Stepmother, but My Daughter Is Just so Cute!
ฉันเป็นแม่เลี้ยงนะ แต่ลูกสาวน่ารักเกินไปแล้ว
description:
Fairytale stepmothers are notoriously wicked. But after a children’s clothing designer is reborn as young Princess Blanche’s stepmom, she’s determined to break the mold and shower her daughter with love. Now she just has to convince the girl’s cold-hearted father to do the same. In her quest to make a happier home for Blanche, Abigail begins to uncover secrets and schemes within the palace. Will devious forces tear the Freidkins apart, or can Abigail stitch them back into a family?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: สามีคนนี้แจกฟรีให้เธอ
description:
When Jiwon, a 37-year-old cancer patient, walks in on her husband and best friend, she realizes her whole life has been a lie. What’s worse, she dies a tragic death at the hands of her husband. Would things have been different if she had made different choices? Fortunately for Jiwon, she is given the chance to rewrite her fate when she is reincarnated as her younger self. This time, she vows to live a happy life. But first comes revenge. Her plan? To marry off her now former best friend to her lying, cheating husband.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

synonyms: ランダムチャットの彼女！
สาวจากแรนดอมแชต
description:
If you lived through – or are still living through – high school, you can relate to Joon-U. An outcast and a loner, his only joy comes from the hours he spends on his phone, randomly chatting with strangers. It’s all weird and meaningless, until Joon-U strikes gold – as he’s matched in a private chat with a pretty young girl his age. Jackpot! But when he discovers that this same pretty girl is actually his classmate Seong-A, things get a little too real for a guy who’s never even remotely been kissed.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

characters.description: Ha-Min usually an intimidating demeanor but shows empathy for those that are close to her. She is extremely intelligent and is the top-scoring student in the school due to the fact that she spends lots of time at cram school. Ha-Min is also quite popular but she usually ignores anyone that tries to talk or befriend her because she doesn't care about expectations of her. It also makes her uncomfortable to interact with strangers. She is very observant as well, solving mysteries using her quick wit and intellect.

Appearing at the start of the series as a timid, gloomy and lonely guy, Jun-U thinks of himself as an 'outsider' and rarely ever felt that he fit in with the others at school. During the progression of the series, he is described as a selfless person, as he always goes out of his way to help the ones dearest to him.
Jun-U's friend from middle school

Tae-Yang is reckless and hot-tempered, but also will swallow his pride if he thinks he has made a mistake. He is shown to trigger at the slightest irritation, and won't hesitate to beat someone up, even when he's outnumbered. He is called "reliable" by Joowoon because of his dedication to help his friends. Even though he is always ready for a fight, he won't start fight for no reason.
She's the best friend of Yoon Sungah.
Jun-U's friend

description:
In the Era of Adventure kickstarted by the spawning of Gates, marked by absolute hopelessness, destitute, desperation, and despair, everyone had given up their hope and lost their courage to continue fighting - except one adventurer that refused to go down until his last breath. "You are the only one left, Last Adventurer Elpam." As the history of adventurers was forced to come to an end, the Last Adventurer returned to where this story all began.

(Source: WEBTOON)

It’s a rude insult when lowly and headstrong servant Edna comes to marry Duke Eli, instead of the noble daughter he expected. But the ambitious maid hides an even bigger secret behind her obvious ruse – one that could change the kingdom’s very history. Can the two find freedom, redemption – and love – without drawing their swords on each other? Based on the hit novels.

(Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: His family died because of poverty. He is now one of Eli's men. His weapon is a whip

Ritrel's sister, she is a specialist of medicinal plants.

~!Her scar is a burn. She has been hunted for being a witch because of her knowledge!~
One of the friends of Eli, he fights for him.

description:
Only I can see the future in this deadly game.
Yoon-Jae leads an empty life after his wife and daughter are brutally murdered. One day, his journal reveals one mysterious sentence: “You can see them again.” Yoon-Jae is pulled into a parallel universe where everyone is a player in a lethal game, and the final survivor will be granted any wish. Desperate to be reunited with his family, will Yoon-Jae succeed in fighting his way in this hellish world to be the last one standing?

(Source: Manta)

characters.description: He is kind to his comrades and friends, but he is cruel and merciless to enemies. He is calm and quick to adjust to situations and also won't hesitate to kill people that try kill other "innocent" players.

title.english: The Perks of Being an S-Class Heroine

synonyms: Preferential Treatment for the Possessed Person
สิทธิพิเศษของผู้สวมร่าง
description:
On the outside, Ailette Rodeline is an adorable child prodigy. Cooking, brewing tea, alchemy; you name it, she can do it. But this little girl has a big secret: Ailette is a transmigrator! After dying prematurely in her past life, she becomes a character whose world is destined for destruction. With all odds stacked against her, Ailette must figure out how to survive before her life is ripped from her again. Fortunately for her, she finds her salvation in… an insurance package?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Perks of Being a Villainess

synonyms: What's Wrong with Being the Villainess?
Isn’t Being A Wicked Woman Much Better?
เป็นนางร้ายก็สบายดีนะคะ
description:
Do-Hee lived as a pushover, died miserably, and was reborn in a novel as a notorious villainess. But it turns out that her new life is not without its perks, as Deborah Seymour is also the richest villain alive. Now, all that's left for her to do is lay low and enjoy her carefree lifestyle... if not for the fact that Deborah is fated to be sent to a monastery! Will this ex-doormat find a way to avoid yet another tragic ending, or will the challenges of being a villainess be too much for her?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description: Deborah is described as a cold, calculating, and cruel woman by most people. She is the daughter of Duke Gorgias Seymour, a genius mage, and Marian Seymour. She is the younger sister of twins Rojard Seymour and Belec Seymour and the older sister of Enric Seymour.

Isidor is a highly skilled swordsman and heir to the Bisconti family, one of the most prestigious ducal families in the Asteia Empire. He is described as one, if not the most handsome man of his time by both women and men. He has complete confidence in himself and his abilities. According to Deborah, he does not appear in the novel she knows.

~!Isidor is the main male protagonist. Besides being a skilled swordsman, he is a great mage and also the master of Blanche, an information guild. He doesn't appear in the original work under the name of Isidore but rather under his second identity, the Master. Deborah describes him as "the crown prince's cheatkey in the novel" because he solved most of the problems in the original novel.
