characters.description: Yulian Provoke, also known as "Young Glow" is the main protagonist of the webtoon Red Storm. He is the first son and successor to Pareia's glow Baguna Provoke, as well as the only disciple of his master, Cheon Myeong-Hunn. He is the founder and Commander of the Red Storm military division.
Cheon Myeong-Hun, or better known as Noya, is the master of the main protagonist of the Red Storm manhwa.
Trickle Wikito was a Commander of Red Storm. A shaman-turned-warrior, Trickle was a proficient fighter, but primarily notable for his combination of tribal magic, sword skills, and brilliant mind.

Haisha Sanaken is a warrior in the Pareia Tribe and the Vice-Captain of Red Storm. He is a wise commander and strong warrior but his prowess falls short in comparison to his friends. He is usually a cool-headed and reliable individual.

Thrint is a warrior of the Pareia Tribe and an officer of Red Storm. Due to the nature of Thrint's powers, he requires a lot of sleep. Due to this he is usually sleeping and being carried around in a sack by his friends.

Shubeon is a warrior in the Pareia Tribe and an officer in Red Storm. His physical prowess is only second to Yulian Provoke and he strives to one day beat him in a fight. Shubeon is generally straightforward and pushes through difficulties with persistence.
Venersis of the Blood-Stained Hand is the Shuaruri Tribe's Great Warrior, captain of the Desert's Blade, and a War God of the Red Desert.

synonyms: How to Be a Dark Hero's Daughter
วิธีเป็นลูกสาวของวีรบุรุษนอกกฎหมาย
ダークヒーローの娘になる方法
description:
Duke Kallen de Lewelton is bloodthirsty and ruthless when it comes to killing criminals, but a total sucker when it comes to his new daughter! Peasant girl Lae learns this herself when a fateful run-in with the duke results in her adoption into the Lewelton home. Armed with a sharp mind and the knowledge from her past life, Lae makes the perfect addition to the family’s quest to quell injustice. But as the mysteries of the capital’s underbelly rise to the surface, will she and her new family withstand the return of a true criminal mastermind?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Head of the Lewelton family and the first supreme dark magician to have been born in the last 500 years. A man who holds all the power and riches of the Kingdom in the palm of his hand. He is also the protagonist of the story "The Life of Duke Lewelton.", a villain that kills villains.

description:
Yoseob, normally very quiet and composed, is in the police station convicted of stabbing 8 civilians with a knife. Everyone's wondering whether he actually committed the crime. Does he, a mere high-schooler, really have any reason to have done such a horrifying act? Does his obsessive love for his older brother, Jaeha, have something to do with it?

(Source: Lezhin)

title.english: I'm the Queen in This Life

synonyms: Sister, I Am the Queen in This Life
Sister I'm the Queen in This Life
Yo soy la reina en esta vida
Ariadne – In diesem Leben bin ich die Königin
description:
The Etruscan Kingdom is stained with blood when the king’s illegitimate son Cesare conspires with his fiancée Ariadne to usurp the throne from his half-brother Alfonso. Despite Ariadne’s devotion to the new king, her faith is shattered when she is betrayed by him and eventually murdered by her own sister, who wishes to be queen. To her surprise, Ariadne finds herself sent back in time to her 17-year-old self. As she navigates the perils and opportunities of palace intrigue, Ariadne must make the most of her guile and grit to ensure that her tragic future does not repeat itself.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
Ariadne is the illegitimate daughter of Cardinal de Mare and Lucrezia's former maid. She was banished from the cardinal's manor and sent to live on a farm due to her mother's lowborn status.

Ariadne was in love with Cesare and devoted eight years of her life to him and his path to becoming king. She is later told that she is nothing more than a consolation prize to Cesare as he has always wanted her older sister Isabella. She is killed by her sister only to return to her seventeen-year-old self and given a second chance in life to undo her past mistakes.
The prince of the Etruscan Kingdom and the half-brother of Cesare, who Ariadne and Cesare killed in her former life.

The half-brother of Prince Alfonso and the illegitimate son of the king. Conspires with his fiancée Ariadne to usurp the throne only to betray Ariadne because he only has eyes for her sister Isabella since she is the most beautiful woman.
Adriande and Isabellas younger sister. The youngest daughter of Cardinal de Mare.

Ariadne's sister who was married to Prince Alfonso in her former life before he was killed by Ariadne and Cesare. She only seeks power and status, so she goes behind her sister's back and plots to marry the man Ariadne loves to become queen. Isabella also killed Ariadne in her former life after confessing to Ariadne about why she was marrying Cesare.
Cardinal de Mare's mistress of highborn origins. Though they are not legally married, she acts as the cardinal's loyal wife.
A man of the cloth who has had his fair share of women. He is the father of Ariadne and Isabella.

synonyms: Memoir of the King of War
description:
Sayu was an orphan living amongst people who hate him. But when he loses the two people he had left... He is ready to go through hell for revenge.

(Source: Toomics)

With the appearance of the mysterious Sky Castle, people all over the world have awakened with supernatural powers and the ability to fly! Well… everyone but Jung Si-Woo that is… At least that was his fate until he saved Su Ah-rin, an awakened player who is now bound to Si-Woo as his personal healer! With Ah-rin by his side, Si-woo just may break into the player’s life after all!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

synonyms: Han Dae Sung Returned From Hell
地獄から帰ってきた絶対者
description:
After being mysteriously transported to hell, Han Daesung has endured years of grueling battles against hellish creatures. When he finally defeats the ultimate boss, he earns a ticket to return to his home, planet Earth. However, upon his return, he discovers that Earth is overrun by monsters and demons emerging from mysterious gates. Once again, Daesung is forced to fight for his survival in this hellhole. Will his experiences in hell help him overcome another catastrophe?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: ข้าราชการพิเศษ
description:
Socially-awkward Ma-Ru Han bombs his fifth attempt at getting a dream job in the civil service. But after a strange creature attacks him in the mountains, he finds himself recruited into the Special Civil Service for the Ministry of Environment. This secret organization is dedicated to fighting nachal, human-devouring demons who appear in clouds of yellow dust. As Ma-Ru struggles in his new job fighting nachal, he must find out why they're mysteriously drawn to him before the prophesied end of the world arrives.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

synonyms: The Older Sister of a Maniac
She's the Sister of a Maniac
Second Life of a Trash Princess
เมื่อฉันเป็นพี่สาวของอันธพาล
description:
After losing her father, bratty brother, and the Elias Empire to her traitorous fiancé's schemes, Princess Legina makes a wish upon a magic ancestral stone and returns to when she was 15. With one last chance to right everything, she comes up with a plan: train her spoiled sibling to be the next ruler by becoming an even bigger brat and get Aaron Vestein, the most beautiful man in the empire, to replace her fiancé! But will just wits, resolve, and a new suitor be enough to change Legina's fate?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

characters.description: The Princess of the Elias Empire.
The younger son of Duke Vestein, the second Duke of the Elias Empire.
A sorcerer capable of controlling hundreds of people.
Legina's younger brother who will become King later on. First prince of the Elias' empire.
Legina's fiancé in a marriage arranged by the Emperor.

synonyms: I Found a Husband When I Picked up the Male Lead
ฉันได้สามีหลังเก็บพระเอกไปคืน
description:
Notorious for her extravagant spending, Wilhazelle Fossier drove her house to complete financial ruin. To pay her family’s debt, she resolves to collect a bounty from the wealthy Duke Heillos by finding his missing nephew. Although her search is successful, until the skeptical duke can confirm the young boy’s identity, Wilhazelle must spend one month living at the Heillos manor. But when one month turns into one year and a contract marriage, she starts to wonder if the money is worth it!

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The heir of Heillos duchy, until his parents died in a carriage accident and he lost his memories.
The current Duke of Heillos.

synonyms: It's Mine เธอเป็นของฉัน
description:
There’s nothing that Yo-Han Do doesn’t know about his crush, Da-Jeong. Where she sits in class, works after school... and even where she lives. But unable to approach her, he watches her every move from afar and will do anything to protect her. Anything.

"What can I do to get closer to you?"

Today, just like yesterday, Yo-Han Do is watching.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
Da-Jeong is someone with a straight heart who can't pass people in need and can't stand injustice. She is also a thoughtful student who often takes care of her aunt, who is currently being hospitalized.

~!Her parents died in a car accident and she suffered all kinds of humiliation and bullying. Because of that, she is capable of self-defense, enough to subdue an adult man.!~ She is in judo club.

synonyms: เมื่อฉันถูกเลี้ยงโดยเหล่าวายร้าย
description:
Neglected by her family, Cha Mi-So dreams of life in her favorite novel as the beloved main character. Then one day, she wakes up inside the novel, but as Eileen Etam, a downtrodden side character who will be kicked out of her home! To avoid further neglect, she plots to leave before that occurs. But when Erno Etam, the crazy heir to House Etam, claims that Eileen is his daughter, her plans are foiled, and Eileen finds herself in the middle of a conflict between House Etam and a cast of villains.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: Your Majesty, Please Spare Me This Time

synonyms: Your Majesty, Please Don't Kill Me Again
Ваше величество, пожалуйста, не убивайте меня снова
ฝ่าบาท อย่าฆ่ากันอีกนะเพคะ
description:
Following the emperor’s unjust massacre of her family and her own miserable death, Laliette Bellua wakes up to find that she is in the body of her 12-year-old self. She immediately sets her sights on a single goal: suck up to Emperor Rupert Edgar Laspe Vellelum and save her family. Laliette’s plan is foolproof, except for one tiny detail… In her present timeline, the future emperor is still masquerading as a princess named Rapertte! With only a single suitcase and some change in her pocket, she sets out for the capital to become the princess’s closest and most beloved attendant. Can Laliette prove her ability to keep a secret? And more importantly, will she be able to win the favor of the cruel and sadistic Rapertte?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

synonyms: ポイズナー 〜毒を喰らうヒーラー〜
description:
In a world where monster hunters are hailed as heroes, Cheon Hae-Sun has been treated like an outcast because of his abnormal looks. As if that wasn't bad enough, a pack of monsters attacks his neighborhood on the day he discovers he's dying from an unknown illness. With his sister's sacrifice, Hae-Sun survives and somehow awakens to become a Poisoner, a rare hunter with toxic healing abilities. But will his poisonous powers cure Hae-Sun's illness and guarantee a normal life he's always dreamed of?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

characters.description:
__Occupation:__ Hunter
__Relative(s):__ Cheon Song-Hwa (Sister)
__Type:__ Healer
__Guild:__ ~!Cleanup Clan!~

__Relative(s):__ [Cheon Hae-Sun](https://anilist.co/character/337415/Cheon-HaeSun)(Brother)

Cheon Song-Hwa has been taking care of her brother ever since their parents passed away. She has also been working to pay for [Cheon Hae-Sun](https://anilist.co/character/337415/Cheon-HaeSun)'s surgery.

__Occupation:__ Hunter
__Rank:__ S
__Type:__ Knight
__Guild:__ Glory Guild(CEO)

description:
Nothing makes Eun-Gi feel anything anymore. Life is a blur between attending college classes, having meaningless drinks with classmates, and maintaining the nearly defunct guitar club. That is, until one day, he comes across a freshman named Jeong-Woo, who is eager to make a good impression on his senior. Though Jeong-Woo's bubbly personality rubs Eun-Gi in all the wrong ways, Eun-Gi can't help but feel a little warm when he thinks of him. And when Jeong-Woo joins the guitar club, that warmth in Eun-Gi's chest only grows. Has Eun-Gi finally found someone to breathe some life into his jaded indifference?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

characters.description: Eun-Gi is a sophomore majoring in business at A University. He is good-natured and reserved. He's shy even though he pretends not to be. He's pretty awkward when it comes to showing affection, but very sincere to those close to him. He typically doesn't say much unless it's necessary. However, when he does speak, he's very straightforward and honest. Eun-Gi has astigmatism, but doesn't wear glasses because he thinks it kills his look. He has to squint to see things, so many people get the wrong idea and think he's glaring. Eun-Gi doesn't have any hobbies besides studying. He doesn't enjoy playing video games, and he only works out to keep in shape. When he felt he should follow his peers and participate in an extracurricular activity, he joined the guitar club. Before he knew it, he became Club President.

Jeong-Woo is a freshman majoring in business at A University.

He is sweet and smiles often, but can also be very sensitive, with a thirst for affection. He is bright and optimistic by nature, so he's chatty and lively with people. Although Jeong-Woo is a people-person, he gets tired after long periods of social interaction. While he does have a lot of friends, there aren't many he can truly open up to. When he's by himself, he gets lost in his thoughts and often gets the blues.

Jeong-Woo's hobbies include: uploading daily looks and food pictures on Instargram, doing puzzles, and collecting socks and scarves. He enjoys reading and watching movies of all genres, but prefers mystery and thriller novels the most.

His parents are divorced, but he lives with his mother and a big sister who's six years older.

synonyms: A Modern Man Who Got Transmigrated Into the Murim World
Modern Man Who Fall Into Murim
description:
I was a public official who worked part-time to survive. I was knocked out by a speeding car while making deliveries in the middle of the night. I have a strong memory of dying prematurely in a hit-and-run.

“…I’m Jo Hwi?”

At some point, I became the second son of the collapsing Jo Ga-Cheol Clan. This family has neither the authority to drop a flying bird nor the power to carry out one’s will. There is only an enormous amount of debt that can annihilate the entire family. There’s only one way out!

“Father, please pass the Jo Ga-Cheol Clan on to me.”

The story of a successful modern man who has to utilize all the knowledge and experience of a public official begins now.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

As the poor, illegitimate son of the king, the only way for Raymond to have a decent life is to become a healer. However, his healing ability is abysmal, and it looks like he's doomed to a life of hardship. Until one day, Raymond finds himself receiving information about something called "medical science," which can cure things that healing can't! With this revolutionary knowledge in hand, can Raymond overcome the prejudice against him and his methods in order to achieve his dreams of fame?

(Source: Tapas)

Mabel’s been mocked her whole life for her nonexistent magical ability, but when she finally meets her true father, it’s the all-powerful archmage, Raquiel! Forced by an imperial pact to let her go long ago, he can now welcome her into his home, with his half-wolf butler, three nymph sisters, a fox halfling, and a kind disciple to watch over her. But dark secrets from his past threaten to catch up with them. Will his magic be enough to protect her? Could she even come into power all her own?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: My Little Brother Is The Academy’s Hotshot
勇者の弟はアカデミーガチ勢
勇士弟弟超懂學院大小事
description:
Ruud Denatos' life of living in the shadow of his talented older brother Aesir, a genius dragon slayer, ends when Aesir is killed in a brutal battle. After the fight, a hidden dragon lord appears and sends Ruud to a past where Aesir doesn't exist! In order to find answers and his older brother, Ruud takes Aesir's place and wows the school with his skills and knowledge. But will Ruud continue to impress the academy, or will the lackluster skills of his past catch up to him?

(Source: Tapas)

A world in which Korea is the global capital of combat sports. At Nam-Il High School where the best and most talented students of martial arts reside, Jiu Ji-Tae suddenly finds himself thrust into their midst despite being a total weakling.

By neutralising his physical shortcomings through jiu-jitsu, can he rise to the top of the fight classes?

characters.description: Nam-Il High School fight class second year captain. Korean-Brazilian.
Kwon Tae-Yeong is a first-year student in Nam-Il High's fight class 1. She was awarded with the Promotion Excellence award by the principal at the first semester ranking match ceremony.

Yeo Eun-Sol is a high ranking first year student in Nam-Il High's fight classes and the first year fight class 1 class president. She was awarded with the Star Student award by the principal at the 1st semester ranking match ceremony and is ranked the highest academically among the first years in the fight classes.

Cha So-Wol is an unranked student in Nam-Il High fight class 1-1. She finished the preliminaries for the ranking matches and was one of the finalists, but was later disqualified from attending the semester ranking matches due to her part in an unofficial fight against Lim Hyung-Chul, another student. She ranked the lowest academically among the first years in fight classes at the Grade announcements. Acquainted with and is often shown hanging around Jang Chun-Soo and Oh In-Taek.

Sim Ha-Min is a high ranking first-year student in Nam-Il High's fight class 1. He was awarded with the S-rank of the year award by the principal after the first semester ranking match ceremony. One of the first year captains.
Gi Ba-Ram is a fair-skinned man with a toned physique. He has short black hair parted at the side. He is occasionally drawn for gag reasons with a horse face, as he is mounted by Kwon Tae-Yeong.
Nam-Il high school regular class first year, studying nursing. Granddaughter of the owner of the boarding house Ji-Tae is staying at. One of Ji-Tae's close friends.

Jang Cheon-Su is a first-year D-ranked student in fight class 1 at Nam-Il High. He was awarded with the "Failure at Success" award for failing in the first round of the ranking qualifications alongside Jiu Ji-Tae. He scored second to last in academics among the first years in fight classes at the Grade announcement. He is friends with O In-Taek and Cha So-Wol. He has also shown familiarity with Im Hyeong-Cheol and Choi Yeong-Jun.

Nam-Il High School regular class first year, studying civil engineering. Seriously obsessed with fighting. Entered Nam-Il High School just to cover the fight classes in person. One of Ji-Tae's close friends.

title.english: What It Means to Be You

synonyms: あなたの心がわかるように
เพราะอยากให้คุณเข้าใจ
description:
Princess Violet always played by the rules—right down to marrying the hot-tempered Winter, an illegitimate noble, to save her family from ruin. Though Violet fell head over heels for Winter at first sight, her dream of happiness was shattered when her family lost its royal standing on their wedding day, leaving her branded a swindler and an outcast. Three years later, Violet endures endless shame, convinced even her husband wouldn’t care if she died. Desperate, she attempts to take her own life… only to wake up in Winter’s body! Now, trapped in each other’s lives, they’re forced to see the world through the other’s eyes. Could this strange twist be their one chance to truly understand—and love—each other?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

title.english: I Thought My Time Was Up!

synonyms: I Thought I Didn't Have Long To Live!
Mes jours ne sont plus comptés ?!
余命僅かだと思ってました！
ไหนบอกว่าฉันใกล้ตาย!
description:
Feeling a little under the weather, Lariette Blanche visits Doctor Zakascoff only to find out that she has an extremely rare congenital disease, and only three months left to live. Though devastated at first, Lariette decides to write up a bucket list of everything she wants to do before she dies. However, little did she know that the diagnosis was actually wrong! With so many changes implemented in her life already, what will Lariette do moving forward? Will she return to her previous life, or continue living the new one, full of adventures she had never imagined before?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

synonyms: I Reincarnated as a Legendary Surgeon
description:
Dr. Han Jinsoo always tried to live a righteous life, but in return, he got fired, swindled by a conman, and killed by his own professor. Luckily, a mysterious being offers him a second chance at life because of all the good deeds he had performed. The only problem is... he comes back to life as as Hua Tuo, the legendary Chinese physician, in the turbulent period of the Eastern Han Dynasty! Will he be able to survive in this era of wars and heroes as a surgeon without so much as a scalpel?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: A surgeon who passed away and came back to life as "Hwata".

synonyms: 武林界のファーブルは毒物博士
毒物專家法布爾in四川唐門
เซียนพิษท่องยุทธภพ
description:
Fabre, a famous million-viewer streamer known for his daring encounters with venomous creatures, is bitten by a black mamba while filming in Africa and wakes up in the mystical world of Murim. To his surprise, the jungles of Murim offer him a peaceful farming life in which he enjoys cultivating various poisonous species. But his tranquility is short-lived when he crosses paths with members of the Tang Clan, the masters of poison and devious tactics.

"I see potential in you. Become a part of our family."

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Reincarnation of the Hero Party's Grand Mage

synonyms: The Rebirth of the Hero's Party's Archmage
The Great Mage of the Hero's Party Reincarnates
description:
The warrior Lista heard the rumors about the great magician Rin, hailed as a genius for becoming the youngest 4-star mage. Lista recruited him to join her party to fight the forces of the void but, right before the final battle, Rin’s body succumbed to the void’s dark poison. As he drew his last breath, Rin cast an immortality spell, encasing his body in ice and promising Lista that he would return. Rin kept his promise and returned after 300 years--but reborn in the body of a noble boy.

(Source: Tapas)

Hell yeah! A major publisher wants Mai Sohn to write a webcomic on relationships. But she’s struck with heartbreak as her girlfriend abruptly dumps her. It’s hard writing about relationships without being in one, so she needs to find the inspiration for love—and find it fast. And what’s up with her possibly homophobic neighbor? Why is she cool with Mai one minute and then so awkward and weird to her the next?! Can't a girl catch a break?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

characters.description:
A computer engineering major at Yeon Gol university. She is religious and takes an interest on Mai.

~!She and Mai start dating at the end of Season 1!~
A photography major at Yeon Gol university. She writes a famous romance webcomic.

A rich coffee shop owner. She is Mai's best friend.

~!She develops feelings for Chanmi.!~

Chungyeon's childhood best friend. She is very protective of her and is anti-LGBTQ.

~!After learning Chungyeon likes Mai, she joins a LGBTQ parent meeting and studies about the community!~
Mai's ex-girlfriend.

synonyms: とにかく私達って最高！
description:
After the gods dropped her in the world of her favorite fantasy romance novel, Lithera was quick to realize that happily-ever-afters were never easy to get. Given another shot at happiness, she is now determined to avoid the mistakes of her previous life, starting by meeting the sweet and caring Grand Duke she spent years exchanging letters with… Another typical female lead, with another typical Duke, promised to Wed. Will this story go the typical path we all expect?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

synonyms: Today the Villainess has Fun Again
Another Happy Day for the Villainess
นางร้ายสายเชิด
description:
From growing up in a dysfunctional family to being cheated on, So-Jin never had it easy. So after waking up in the body of villainess Reilynn Candmion, daughter of the empire’s wealthiest duke, all she wants is to revel in her riches. But something feels amiss when the story’s heroine, Iris, constantly starts fights with her -- from stealing her dress to seducing her fiancé. Reilynn wants no drama, but Iris and her four love interests won’t leave her alone! Can’t a girl just wanna have fun?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

synonyms: นักล่าโหมดออโต้
description:
The world under attack by monsters that are pouring from the 'fracture'. And the 'hunters' who hunt those monsters are the most coveted job in the world currently.

 One day, Oh Yun-Sung who works his hardest from day to day as a worker in a meat restaurant awakens an ability to automatically hunt monsters with perfect techniques and physical prowess like in MMORPG when he presses a button 'Auto Hunting' that appears in front of him...!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Six years ago, humanity was almost brought to an end when mysterious towers filled the skies across the globe, unleashing deadly monsters. Fortunately, the people known as “players” emerged, blessed with supernatural powers that they harnessed to save mankind. Among them is Yuseong Kang, a phenomenal player who has saved the world time after time. Once again, he has successfully averted global catastrophe… and in an internationally broadcasted interview praising his heroic endeavors, he says,

“I’m just in it for the money.”

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: She is a noble soul and a beacon of light and hope.

description:
Set on a path to tragedy and misfortune from a young age, Aseph Randell is doomed to die a villain. That is, until the mysterious Elzay Tiathe appears in his life with a promise: "I can save you." After having vivid visions of him for so long, can Elzay untangle the twisted fate tied to Aseph... or will they both be dragged down together? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: TappyToon)

characters.description: Elzay's younger sister.

synonyms: เพลเยอร์นักกินเหล็ก
description:
Steel Emperor Hyeonuk Lee, the last savior of humanity, has died. The place he returned to in order to change the future is... the military?!! Why here of all places?! Corporal Hyeonuk Lee's steel eating show begins as he rapidly grows to get revenge!

(Source: WEBTOON)

A close and dangerous cohabitation with the cult leader's son has begun!

Chung-A was swindled by her uncle who she trusted and her parents disappeared, saying they are chasing their missing uncle, and Chung-A suddenly begins living on her own. But it wasn't just Chung-A's family that was scammed! The biggest cult in the autonomous district, "Millennium Adventist," was also deceived by her uncle. And Yo-Han, the son of the cult leader, came to Chung-A's house. He's dragging his luggage in...! God, is this cohabitation gonna be okay?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Chi-Woo’s got issues. Upon returning to school after the “incident” last year, he vows to keep to himself and stay out of trouble until graduation. Easier said than done: his bad boy reputation has made him the talk of the school, and Kyu-Jin - class president and model student - won’t stop being friendly. Trouble arrives soon enough in the shape of Ji-Hyun, a tattooed hunk from Chi-Woo’s dark past. It’s gonna be a tough year…

(Source: Lezhin US)

synonyms: บีรา เจ้าหนูฝักดาบ
剣鞘の子〜けんしょうのこ〜
description:
It’s a world where a magical tree grows from the back of a swordsman, a mute girl is turned into a living weapon by her mother, a frost dragon roams the skies seeking vengeance, and beings with godlike powers clash for the balance of nature. In the middle of it all is Bira, an orphaned boy, happily spending his days fishing inside a secluded forest. Then he meets Tanyu, a former general on a quest to find his childhood love. Together, they journey into an enchanted landscape unlike any other.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Bira is a kid who loves fishing, living and wandering in the wilderness with his dwarf grandfather.
A mute girl, turned into a living weapon by her own mother.
The person who raised Bira.

synonyms: I Became a Renowned Family's Sword Prodigy
偉大なる家門の天才剣士になった
description:
Baek Woo-Jin is the youngest son of a renowned swordsman family who has neither talent in swordsmanship nor an impressive Aura, despite trying harder than anyone. Although he was dishonored by his own family and killed, he reincarnates as the owner of a Magic Sword. His only goal is the destruction of his own family.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ianna and Arhad had much in common. They both only cared about themselves, and were madly obsessed with each other. The difference is one wanted the other's warmth, and the other wanted submission.

Though Ianna's life ended in a heated battle against Arhad, the Kingdom's emperor, she is reincarnated into the same life for reasons unknown.

Two people who faced misery in their previous life now have a chance to meet again. Will the same tragedy repeat itself, or can Ianna change the course of history?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: The daughter of a cold-hearted nobleman and his low-class second wife, Ianna is a fierce swordswoman with a fiery attitude to match. After dying at the hands of Arhad Roygen, she is reborn again into the same life. Although she doesn’t know why she was reincarnated, Ianna is determined to become the warrior she once was.

A nobleman destined to ascend to the throne of a rival kingdom, Arhad is impressed by Ianna from the first time he faces her in a duel. He declares that he is determined to have Ianna by his side — but what are his true intentions?

description:
College professor by day, and bartender by night, psychologist Dr. Frost believes in one simple belief. Humans are all the same. He uses this tenet to guide his practice, and solves the puzzles of the human mind one by one.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

characters.description: He is the protagonist of the manhwa Dr. Frost.

She is Dr. Frost's assistant. She is normally very caring and considerate towards others, especially towards counselling clients. She admires Dr. Frost's abilities, but also has a strong rebellious opinion of her own that goes past others beliefs and research at Yonggang University.
~!It is hinted that she has developed feelings for Professor Frost.!~
Seong-Hyeon Moon is a former psychology student and the founder of Priming Water School.

synonyms: 無限輪迴後成了殺人魔
description:
Karen Heyer thought that a happy ending with the male lead, Raymond Sayerteth, would help her escape the romance novel she had entered. Unfortunately, fate had other plans. Karen soon discovers that regardless of how the story ends, she always dies tragically and returns to when she was 17. After being forced to relive the story for 117 years, Karen's sanity finally reaches a breaking point... as she decides to change her destiny by killing everyone who has wronged her.

(Source: Tapas)

The boy next door, friends for life, is actually a werewolf!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

characters.description: Ryan Nam is one of the main characters as one of the main leads of the series. He is also a werewolf and likes Emma Ji. He is currently a college student and is a neighbor of Emma.
Emma is the main female character in the Webtoon Super Secret. She is a ditzy and clumsy college student and is often dependent on Ryan Nam.

Johan Song is one of the supporting characters in Super Secret. He is typically an easy-going, laid-back guy, and is sometimes sarcastic and annoying. He's a vampire who supplies Ryan Nam and other clients with his medicine. He works as a supernatural pharmacist.
Hailey Nam is one of the main characters of Super Secret, as well as the sister of Ryan and Katherine Nam. She is a witch and makes a living off of making potions and such for other monsters.
Jasmine Moon is the supporting female character in the comic Super Secret. She is the older sister of Jamie Moon and is the close friend to the main protagonist of the webtoon, Emma Ji.

Victor Kwon is known as the pure-blood who had dated Emma Ji. Victor had dated Emma near the end of the beginning of the comic. He has a younger half-brother named Hunter Kwon. Emma and Victor had started dating after Emma had asked Ryan to go on a blind date, he had rejected her. So then, Jasmine Moon, her classmate had set them up on a blind date.

Hunter is the younger half-brother of Victor Kwon, he attends high school with his best friend Jamie Moon. He is also a half (half-werewolf, half-human) though his original form is small, and typically mistaken as a fox or dog.
He is the younger brother of Jasmine and the best friend of Hunter Kwon. He is the supporting character of Super Secret and his plotlines are tied into Hunter's.
Ethan Ji is Emma's older brother. He had been really sick causing Emma to be pushed around because of it. Throughout the series he travels around the world to live out his last days.
Katherine Nam is Ryan Nam's oldest sister and the oldest child in the Nam family. She teaches students in her online live streams. Her species is a Nine-Tailed Fox.

Inna Seo is the pureblood female that dated Victor Kwon in the past. Miss Inna is also known to have copied Jasmine Moon and Emma Ji's clothing and fashion styles after she heard of supposedly romantic relationships they had with Victor. Inna is a little obsessive over her broken relationship with Victor. They have a very terse relationship.

title.english: I Tamed My Ex-husband’s Mad Dog

synonyms: 元夫の番犬を手なずけた
แผนสยบหมาบ้าของอดีตสามี
description:
As soon as Reinhardt Lincke wakes up 15 years in the past at her father’s funeral, she stabs her husband, the crown prince, in the leg. Even though he is the one at fault, Reinhardt is the one who is punished. But fate seems to smile upon her when, during the rocky journey to her place of exile, she encounters Will Cohlonna, her husband’s “mad dog” and war hero from her previous life. Thirsty for revenge, Reinhardt decides to give Will a new name and use him for her revenge. This time, Reinhardt has the joker, and she’s playing to win.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

synonyms: สุภาพบุรุษบุษบา
花屋になりたいだけなのに強すぎ！
description:
Even though he’s built like a fighter with a fearsome scowl, Hwang Jae-Ho would love nothing more than to become a florist instead. Unfortunately, Jae-Ho’s overbearing father disapproves, pushing his son to become an MMA fighter instead. Jae-Ho enters the virtual reality game, New World, to escape his father’s ambitions, but will he be able to realize his dreams?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

title.english: The Duke's Bored Daughter is My Master

synonyms: The Max Level Princess is Bored Today as Well
The Max-Leveled Princess is Bored Today as Well
The Invicible Princess Is Bored Again Today
ชีวิตที่ไร้สีสันของเลดี้สุดแกร่ง
满级公女今天也很无聊
最強公女は今日も退屈です
description:
I was an illegitimate daughter abandoned by the promiscuous emperor. From there, I ended up on the street where I learned that I had a knack for the sword. I competed in tournaments, became a mercenary, and I made a name for myself. Just when I had become the talk of the empire, the emperor wanted me back. In return, I demanded to be next in line for the throne. After years of hard work, I finally became empress and died happily. But here I am, alive again. Ugh, can’t a girl be left alone? This time, I’m going to be as lazy as I please!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Lady I Served Became a Master

synonyms: The Young Lady I Served Became a Young Master
Nona yang Kulayani Jadi Tuan Muda
คุณหนูที่เคยรับใช้กลายเป็นคุณชายไปซะแล้ว
description:
When Su-A wakes up inside the world of her favorite novel as the character of Blair, she is determined to help the female protagonist, Chloe, get through the darkest period of her life.

For years, Chloe has had to endure discrimination and abuse for being an illegitimate child. Blair becomes her maid and confidante, and the two form a special friendship. But Chloe turns out to be quite a different character than the one described in the book. She wields black magic, sends Blair to fetch her mysterious potions, and seems totally uninterested in any of the male lead candidates. Then one day, a handsome man who looks an awful lot like Chloe shows up at Blair’s doorstep. Could it be…the lady she used to serve?!

All bets are off as plot twist after plot twist unravels in this unpredictable tale of love and redemption.

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: คุณลูกสาวผู้น่ารักของจักรพรรดิบ้าเลือด
description:
Ariadna Lereg Ilestri Pre Agrigent. And so my life begins with this ridiculously long name, born to royalty and the center of attention — all because of one dangerous man; the veritably insane tyrant king, ruthless conqueror of ten empires, nightmare of all continents… and my father?! Will I be able to survive this maniac? Based on the hit series of novels.

(Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: A 24-year old woman who was murdered in her previous life, but reincarnated as the only daughter of Caitel Lereg Ilestri Pre Agrigent of the Agrigent Empire. Caitel chose to keep Ariadna alive, even when Princess Jereina gave birth to her to get revenge for her country and put a curse on her.

description: Jang Sung-gi is always misunderstood as a pervert and a worthless man! He meets a mentor who suddenly turns him into a very charismatic man?! A cool and edgy tale of how an average guy who turns into the greatest "pick up artist"... A story about misbehaved men who are constantly trying to pick up girls~!

characters.description: Best friend of protagonist Sung-gi. Hwang Jae Sunbae appears as a scraggly young man to the common eye, but holds the secret identity of the legendary Pickup artist "Master Kaiser." Hwang Jae Sunbae takes upon the task of educating his friend Sung-gi in the ways of seducing women, with respect involved, of course.
Sae-Na is the primary love interest of her classmate Sung Gi. She's a 20-year-old part-time model and is considered attractive by all her classmates.
Jang Sung-Gi is the main protagonist of Skill of Lure. He is consistently misunderstood and branded as a pervert.
Lee Yura is a student at Granda Cram School. She is popular due to her stunning beauty and is the first girl that Jang Sung-Gi developed feelings for.

title.english: The Little Lady Behind the Scenes

synonyms: เลดี้จอมบงการ
description:
Julianne is as close to perfect as it gets: she’s got looks, talent, and smarts. The only problem is she has terrible taste in men! That’s why her little sister Lilianne is doing everything she can to make sure she doesn’t end up with the wrong guy. However, Julianne’s suitors are quickly catching on that the way to her heart is through Lilianne’s sweet tooth! How far will Lilianne go to set her sister up with the right man? Who will be the sweetest suitor?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

characters.description: Originally a university student, she suddenly woke up one day in the body of a character from a novel her friend wrote; the younger sister of the female lead, Julianne. Driven by her desire to save her older sister from her fate in the original novel, Lilianne tries her hardest to ensure she doesn't end up with the wrong male lead.
Lilianne's older sister. Graduated from a prestigious academy, at the top of her class. The original female protagonist of the novel the story takes place in.
Cedric's nephew. Often a victim to Lilianne's teasing.
One of the male lead candidates. A modest and meek individual. Contrasting to his timid demeanor, he's the empire's top knight and a lieutenant commander of its imperial guard.
One of the male lead candidates – a friend of Julianne from their academy days. Considered an eccentric individual by many.
Allen's younger brother.
Michael's nephew.

One of the male lead candidates. A shrewd, calculating man who fell for Julianne at first sight. During their academy days he was second only to her. He employs many cunning strategies to win her heart.
The male lead in the original novel.

description:
Former archery prodigy Yoo Sanghyun was destined for greatness until an injury forced him to quit. Though his coach helped him secure a stable job, he never felt like he belonged. Frustrated, he leaves it all behind to pursue game streaming. Leveraging his incredible archery skills and the charm of his noob character, he quickly rises to fame as "Almond." Now, he's determined to dominate the gaming world, but will his virtual success translate into something greater in real life?

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Yu Sang-Hyeon is the youngest gold medalist of the Korean Archery Championships. Following a career-ending injury, his coach introduces him to an office job at a large corporation where he works for several years. With news of a company downsizing on the way, Sang-Hyeon resigns and uses the severance pay to buy a full-dive gaming capsule. He discovers that his injury does not affect his body in-game. He takes this opportunity to reconnect with his passion for archery and pursues game streaming where he quickly makes a name for himself with his legendary archery skills.
A big fan of Almond who makes edits of his gameplay as a hobby. Later on, she becomes his official editor.
An old colleague and close friend of Yu Sang-Hyeon. Upon quitting his job, he becomes Sang-Hyeon's manager.

synonyms: 怠惰なソードマスター
ยอดนักดาบจอมขี้เกียจ
description:
Baek Jinwoo, savior of humanity, is done with being a hero. In his last moments, this battle-scarred warrior vows never to pick up a sword again. But by some cruel twist of fate, he finds himself reborn as Riley Finn Epheletta, the youngest son of an esteemed family of swordmasters! When trouble comes knocking, Riley is forced to make a decision — take up the sword, or let his loved ones die. Will the “Lazy Sword” finally bloom into the legendary swordmaster he was always destined to become?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: I Became the Despised Granddaughter of the Powerful Martial Arts Family
I Became the Despised Granddaughter of the Murim Clan
ฉันคือหลานสาวตระกูลจอมยุทธ์ผู้ถูกเหยียดหยาม
description:
Yeon was just an orphan on the streets when a man claiming to be her father brought her to his family home. But the Baengri estate was a den of vipers that swallowed her whole, and it's only when she's standing at the funeral of the father she never truly understood that she realizes how familiar this story is. When she wakes up six years old again, Yeon knows she can't waste her second chance. This time, she's going to save her father. This time, she's going to live without regrets.

(Source: Tapas)

After training for 11 years to reach superhuman status, I gave up on my dream and returned to the family farm. But suddenly, Hawa appeared! She’s a powerful farming spirit who can make anything grow—even produce that enhances people’s powers. Now I’ve got my superhuman ID card, more spirits-friends, mouthwatering Grade A+ crops, and quests! Will Hawa and her friends lead us all to fame and fortune and change our lives forever?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: นางร้ายอย่างเธอต้องเจอทรราช
惡女與暴君的危險關係
description:
Orphaned at the age of seven, I was naïve to think my uncle took me in out of love. He promised to return the House of Edenbarre to me once I was of age, but he kept my father’s title and wealth. Not to mention my sweet cousin poisoned me after I learned of my uncle’s plans against the emperor. But with a second chance at life, I vow to take it all from them, as they did to me! Some may call me a villainess, but I’ll gladly use the tyrant emperor for my selfish interests. I’ll have my vengeance... as long as these suitors don’t get in my way!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life

synonyms: ชาตินี้เทพมารขอชิล
description:
After a lifetime of bloodshed, the Heavenly Demon longs for peace. In his final moments, he uncovers the truth about his power and yearns for a different life. He wakes up in the body of Tae-San Byeok, the frail second son of a powerful merchant family, barely clinging to life. Using his knowledge from his life as the Heavenly Demon, Tae-San must navigate a world of temptation and corruption to survive. As his martial arts reputation grows, new enemies emerge to disrupt his quiet life. Yet, Tae-San is determined to live on his own terms, despite the chaos around him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description: Tae-San's childhood friend and servant.
Tae-San's bodyguard.

description:
Estio is just an ordinary farmer’s son, but with an extraordinary ability—he can read the thoughts and memories of humans and animals. For this, he is shunned by the people in his village, finding happiness only in his animal friends. After years of silently enduring the villagers’ hostility, Estio runs away the night he turns 19. His journey brings unexpected friendships and encounters, but will such bonds be able to show him there is more to him and his ability than meets the eye?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Debut Mot Hamyeon Jungneun Byeong Geollim
title.native: 데뷔 못 하면 죽는 병 걸림

synonyms: Debut Mot Hamyeon Jungneun Byeong Geollim
데뷔 못 하면 죽는 병 걸림
デビューできないと死ぬ病気にかかってしまいました
เดบิวต์ไม่ได้ก็ต้องตายเท่านั้น
患上不出道就會死的病
description:
After a night of drinking, aspiring civil servant Ryu Gunwoo passes out, only to awaken three years in the past in the body of a young man named Park Moondae. Before he can even assess the situation, he's given a mission: Debut or Die! Now, Moondae has one year to debut as an idol or face his doom. Luckily, he's able to snag a spot on the famous survival program "Idol Inc.", but with his skills so low and the competition so high, does Moondae stand a chance at becoming a shining star?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide

synonyms: A Collection of Top Strategies That Only I See
คู่มือกลยุทธ์พิชิตหอคอย
description:
15 days until the apocalypse happens. That's what Ho-Yeong Lee, a 29-year-old office worker, learns when he takes the mysterious medicine he got for saving a goblin from a bear trap. As it turns out, it allows him to level up more easily and provides him with a strategy guide! Everyone in the world is forced into groups to conquer the mysterious Apocalypse Tower, and Ho-Yeong has to find a way to work with his teammates so that everyone makes it to the top alive. Will his ability give him an advantage, or will it end up spelling out his doom?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

characters.description: He's a former member of the special forces.

title.english: I'm a Part-Timer for the Gods

synonyms: I Became a Part Time Employee for Gods
The Part-Time Land of the Gods
神々より与えられしバイト
จ๊อบพิเศษ เทพสั่งมา
description:
When areas called “Dungeons” started appearing, individuals with Abilities also emerged. Dam-Deok Yu believed that these Abilities would catapult mankind to greater heights until he realized he wasn’t given any! Dam-Deok loathed his situation so much that he cursed the gods, and the gods seemed to have heard him since he was struck by lightning. When he woke up, a system window appeared, telling him the gods were waiting for him…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Her life is nothing but lies.

Camellia was just 12 when she was taken away from her mother in the slums and forced to live as the son of an aristocratic family. But under the layer of secrets and lies, she never forgets. She continues to struggle to be her true self again, to reclaim the life of Camellia.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue, 3 spin-off, 2 specials and 13 side stories.

characters.description: Claude questions Camellius' appearance.
She was a vagrant until she was taken in to play the role of a second son. ~!She was referred to as "he" until she met Claude Del Ihar.!~

synonyms: No Place for the Fake Princess
เป็นตัวปลอมก็ย่อมไร้ที่ยืน
description:
After finding a mysterious book in the imperial garden, Princess Philomel not only discovers that the book's villain shares her name, but that other events in the story are coming true too. Now, she believes that she's an imposter and that the real princess will take her rightful place, leading to the execution of Philomel the Fake! So to avoid a tragic death, she has to make sure the rest of the book doesn't come true. Can this fake princess change what's already been written?

(Source: Tapas)

synonyms: คุณแม่ย้อนวัย หัวใจดวงเดิม
description:
“Mom, I’m sorry. Please don’t die.”

When Henry realizes death is at his mother’s doorstep, he strikes a deal with a lifespan dealer to give years of his own life to his ailing mother. Now, his mother is a 20-year-old college student with a full life ahead of her, and Henry devotes his remaining days to helping her live life to the fullest. But things turn complicated when his friend falls in love with her!

(Source: WEBTOON)

characters.description:
Ijun is a seven-year-old boy who was abused by his parents.

~!He is saved from his abusive parents by Henry, and is later adopted by Olivia. His name changes from Ijun Nam to Ijun Yeon.

He can see lifespan dealers because he was offered a deal in the past.!~

Yeon-ye is a reporter in the sports & entertainment department for a [paparazzi] newspaper called Death Match (데스메치).

~!Her parents passed away and she is the sole provider for her two younger siblings.

She is later hired to become Jeremy's privacy protection manager.!~
He is Henry's father.

synonyms: La princesa imperial que salió del basurero
description:
A girl with glowing, bejeweled eyes and a tiny dragon has been found in an abandoned palace... and there is no doubt she is the long-forgotten daughter of the Emperor. Growing up wild and free, she is unaware of how special she is, especially since her eyes see things others cannot. As the Emperor and his three other children take her in and try to get closer to her, will she learn to trust them? And will this new addition to their family bring fortune or ruin to the empire?

(Source: Tapas)

Yuhyeon becomes the youngest CEO of Hansung, a successful electronics company built on toxic work culture, but nobody he cares about is there to celebrate with him. After a night of drinking and wondering if he could change the past, he wakes up the next morning, 20 years younger at the beginning of his career. Armed with the experience and insights that made him CEO, Yuhyeon begins to revisit broken relationships and battle the enablers of Hansung’s cut-throat work environment. But he does not yet know how changing the past will affect his future...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hyeong-Oh’s disability has always painted a target on his back. It seems like no one at school, from his classmates to his teachers, can stand to treat him like a human being. That is until transfer student Cha Nam-Soo arrives. Quiet and straightforward, he makes no excuses for staying by Hyeong-Oh's side, but can Hyeong-Oh bring himself to trust this new friendship?

(Source: Tapas)

There are people in the world that thinks they are the ‘chosen’ of the heavens. It’s been decades since chaos and strife among heroes ensued because of those people. A certain disciple who has six masters has been entrusted with the fate of the central plains.

“If you guys are the heavens, then I’m the sword that’ll pierce the heavens.”

That was what he’d resolved to do… No one mentioned he was a fatty, though! In any case, now that he’s here, he’ll need to save the… world… Damn it, lose some weight first.

Lim Sooha is an independent woman who has it all: a busy career, a brand-new home, and an ever-growing pile of household chores. And the last thing she needs is a man to mess things up. But that all changes when one walks through her front door–literally! Homeless and desperate for a break, Taesoo begs Sooha to let him stay in exchange for keeping house. Tempted by the idea of coming home to a warm meal, clean sheets, and ironed clothes, Sooha agrees after Taesoo shows just how capable he really is…and claims to be gay.

Could this be the perfect arrangement, or will Taesoo’s lie and Sooha’s conflicted feelings make a bigger mess?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

characters.description:
__Height__: 173 cm

Su-Ha is a hardworking woman who hates the idea of ​​being in a relationship. She does not have time to take care of the house, so she is relieved when she receives help from Tae-Su. She had a difficult childhood, so she has a complicated relationship with her mother.

__Height__: 191 cm

Tae-Su is a guy with no money and no home. Completely broke and nowhere to go, he ends up resorting to Su-Ha due to certain circumstances.
He can take care of most household chores, as well as cleaning and cooking very well. He has a great body and usually runs every morning to stay in shape.
__Height__: 180 cm
__Height__: 153 cm

description:
A young man finds and returns a lost wallet and cell phone to a beautiful young lady, thus begins the destined relationship between two strangers. Sound typical? Well then, how about making the young lady the young man's future homeroom teacher, and give them both a twisted sense of right and wrong. And just for kicks, let's have the young man help himself to a self proclaimed reward from the lost wallet before returning it… but of course, this scenario wouldn't be complete unless the young lady was very unforgiving when it came to teaching one of her students a lesson on morals.

(Source: Infinity Studios)

characters.description: A young, beautiful 26 year old woman who teaches mathematics and also acts as the homeroom teacher for class 3-2. She lives with her sister and niece in an apartment block quite close to Jin-Ho's. Her father's unexpected departure from her life when she was young has had a huge impact on her. Even though she is extremely attractive and was apparently popular throughout her school life, she has become very guarded around men, feeling unable to trust or form relationships with them. Consequently she is still a virgin and even has her first kiss during the course of the story. She also seems to be following her mother's career path, who was also a teacher and became the district superintendent before retirement. She also has a crush or love for Myung, Jin-Ho a student in her class and is defenseless around him.

He is in the final (senior) year of High School and finds himself a student in Hae-Young's class, seemingly caring little for schoolwork. He has been known to go to the nurse's office to sleep, watch erotic movies in school, and complete mathematics tests (generally unsuccessfully) using pure guesswork. In middle school, it appears he was something of a delinquent who got into fights, and he has become quite skilled in them. This has been a source of concern to his family, at the very least for his aunt. However, he can also become focused if something interests him, like film, which causes him to be the co-founder and eventually the president of the Film Studies Club. he also loves his home room teacher Nah, Hae-Young and lives in the same neighbor hood as her and is very stubborn.

She is Jin-Ho's screen writer aunt who lives with him and his father. She often talks to and looks out for her nephew and is not afraid of hitting him when she thinks he has gone out of line. She also acts to diffuse tension between Jin-Ho and his rather authoritarian and distant father.

She is a Eurasian (half Korean/half British) woman, recently arrived in Korea. She has lived in the United States for a while, learning the French martial art of savate. She has come to Korea because she is curious about her father's homeland and her siblings, who turn out to be Hae-Young and Hae-Jung. When she first arrives she lives temporarily at a motel while her father arranges for her to stay with her half-sisters for about a month. She has been employed as a language teacher and an assistant homeroom teacher under Hae-Young's supervision.  Her first encounter with Jin-Ho, like her half-sister's, is not entirely without its troubles, ending in a fight and injury for her. Her opinion of Jin-ho changes, however, when he escorts her back to her motel room and shows concern for her well-being. As she has no full siblings she appears to harbour a strong desire for a warm relationship with her half-sisters, though this is complicated somewhat by their rather cold and distant relationship with their father. She expresses great romantic interest in Jin-Ho and has challenged Hae-Young Nah to see who can first win his heart (though it's not certain whether this is genuine or she just wants to bring the two together).  Source: Wikipedia

She is a senior and friend of Ji-Soo. She is shy and quiet at school, where she often reads yaoi manhwa. She is one of the first to find out about Hae-Young and Jin-Ho's complicated out-of-school relationship. When Jin-Ho learns that she is the one who told Ji-Soo about his situation with Hae-Young, he attempts to confront her. During this face-off she threatens to publicly reveal the relationship, which would be likely to get Jin-Ho suspended and, even worse for him, ruin Hae-Young’s career. She even forces Jin-ho to kneel in front of her without a second thought so as to exert her power over him, and gets pleasure out of it. She seems not to like men in general, and also appears to dislike Jin-ho in particular. It transpires that this was an empty threat on Ami's part, since she herself is also in love with Hae-Young; she even tries to force herself on her teacher, who then turns her down.   (Source: Wikipedia)

She is a college freshman and a friend of Jin-Ho's. She was the co-founder and former president of the film studies club as well as the former president of the student council. Even though she flirts with him, Jin-Ho feels comfortable enough with her to confide his girl problems to her. There are also hints that Jin-Ho may have had rather deeper feelings for her while she was in high school. It seems that Jin-Ho has been rather more distant with girls since she left. There are implications that Jae-Kyung has romantic inclinations towards Jin-Ho, most prominent when she breaks up with her boyfriend, she seeks out Jin-Ho for comfort and acts very coldly towards Hae-Young after she finds out he was waiting for her. Caroline even states that Jae-Kyung is one of Hae-Young's rivals. It is later revealed that she was originally afraid of engaging with Jin-Ho in a romantic relationship and that she secretly believed he would still like her when she left, displaying regret that she never advanced beyond a friend with him. During these times, she has shown a certain level of deviousness, stating that she would sabatoge whatever relationship Jin-Ho has with Hae-Young as she claims she truly loves him, which meant she had to stop him from making the wrong choice. She has shown subtle manipulation of both Hae-Young and Ji-Soo and some amount of ruthlessness, intending to seduce Jin-Ho and even willing to have sex with him to make him hers.Her plan fails as Jin Ho turns her down, Jae Kyung realising she missed her chance to be with Jin Ho encourages him to go to the woman he loves and shows her true feelings by crying after he leaves.    (from Wikipedia)

She is the senior class president as well as now being the president of the student council. She is hardworking, studious, performs well and is also popular. She appears to have liked Jin-Ho ever since the freshmen year of high school, when he helped her make origami flowers. He does not feel the same way towards her, though at one point he does suddenly notice that she is attractive.

He is also a senior, who is Jin-Ho's friend and classmate. They have been placed together in the same class for the previous five years. Like his friend, he is skilled at fighting. It has been implied that he likes Ji-Soo; he is very protective of her and careful of how she perceives him. Young-Gi also has a strong sense of justice and, despite his tall athletic build, prefers to find the most peaceful resolutions to otherwise violent confrontations. In fact his first encounter with Jin-Ho was when Young-Gi was back in middle school when Jin-Ho, whom was a notable delinquent at the time, was harassing another student; the two fought and soon afterwards became close friends.    (from Wikipedia)

synonyms: รักใสๆ ของยอนอู
description:
Yeon-U is easily mistaken for a female student due to his soft and delicate appearance. He develops a crush on Hae-Sol Kang, the most popular student in school. However, due to his shy and timid personality, Yeon-U has never spoken to Hae-Sol even once despite being in the same class.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

synonyms: The Youngest Son of a Conglomerate
description:
After thirteen years as a loyal employee of the Soonyang Group, South Korea’s largest business empire, Hyeon-U is rewarded with betrayal–and murdered–by his employers! Miraculously, he’s given a second chance, reborn back in time as Dojun Jin, grandson of the founder of the corporate dynasty that betrayed him. In a daring quest to rewrite destiny, he will not only attempt to settle the score; he will aim for the ultimate hostile takeover.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

characters.description: The second son of Jin Yun-Gi and the youngest grandson of Jin Yang-Cheol. In his previous life under the name Yun Hyeon-U , he lived as a loyal servant to the Sunyang Group owner's family for 13 years.

The founder of Sunyang Group and the grandfather of the main character, [Jin Do-Jun](https://anilist.co/character/360783/Jin-DoJun). He is a seasoned businessman who believes that only those who win in battles based on the law of the jungle are qualified to become successors.

A friend of Jin Yoon-Gi since his study abroad days in England and a business partner of Jin Do-Jun. As the Korean representative of PowerShares, a global investment bank, he initially acts as an agent for Jin Do-Jun's asset management.

The fourth son of Jin Yang-Cheol and the father of Jin Do-Jun.

At one time, he was the one who received the most expectations from Chairman Jin among the five siblings. Even Director Lee Hak-Jae, the 2nd most influential person in the Sunyang Group, secretly supported Yoon-Gi.

The third son of  the Chairman of Sunyung Group, Jin Yang-Cheol. He sides with his eldest brother, Jin Yeong-Gi in the competition for the position of the Chairman of Sunyung Group.

He is the most incompetent of Jin Yang-Cheol's children, so he is not treated well by his father, and even though he is the son, he received nothing when his sister, Jin Seo-Yoon, and nephew, Jin Do-jun, received the controlling stake of the company, and only inherited small foundations and personal assets, effectively kicking him out of the Sunyung Group.

The second son of Chairman Jin Yang-Cheol . He was in charge of heavy industry, chemicals, and construction, and has a track record of raising the company to the one of the top companies in South Korea. He is known for his rational, calm, and cool-headed personality. He is in conflict with his eldest brother, Jin Young-Gi, and competes for the position of the Chairman of Sunyang Group.

She's Do-Jun's classmate from Seoul National University Law School. Coming from a prominent family in the judiciary, she is a hard worker who did her best to uphold the family's unwritten rule of passing the bar exam while attending school.

~!She confesses to Do-Jun, while they were in the university and they start dating.!~
Jin Seo-Yun's husband. He is a prosecutor from a family of lawyers. He entered politics because of his wife's intention to expand her share in the group with her husband's power.
The only daughter of Chairman Jin Yang-Cheol. She manages the department store and the hotel chain of Sunyang Group. Do-Jun's only aunt.
Jin Yoon-Gi's wife and mother of Jin Do-Jun. She was a model before the marriage.
The eldest son of Jin Yeong-Gi and the eldest grandson of Jin Yang-Cheol. Do-Jun's cousin.
The eldest son of the Chairman of Sunyeong group, Jin Yang-Cheol. Do-Jun's uncle.
Jin Yeong-Gi's wife. She comes from a well-known conglomerate family.

synonyms: มุกฮยาง ดิ ออริจิน
description:
In this prequel to “Mookhyang: Dark Lady,” we meet Mookhyang in Murim, or the world of martial arts, as a young member of the Demonic Sect. After years of rigorous training, he rises through the ranks and joins an elite squad of first-rate assassins. Despite his impressive achievements, however, he finds himself hungry for more. His obsession for martial arts ultimately leads him down a different path… one that few have ever dared to take. He spends decades learning the way of the sword and cultivating his inner qi, or mana, in hopes of one day reaching a state no warrior of the Demonic Sect has ever reached before—the State of Demon Transcender. Join Mookhyang as he fights powerful masters, takes down evil forces, and pushes himself to the limit... and beyond.

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: ขอโทษนะคะ แต่ข้าไม่ได้บอกรักท่าน
description:
"I think I’ve fallen for you." With a single drunken confession, Renesha's plans to live a comfortable and uneventful life were shattered. Somehow she confessed her love to the wrong man: the Grim Reaper of the Battlefield, Duke Cavert Willard! It's the worst thing to happen to her since she woke up in this fantasy universe and discovered her divine powers. In the midst of a war with a neighboring country, Renesha must balance her duties as a healer with her feelings for two alluring knights. When romance blooms on the battlefield, who will be victorious in the battle for Renee's heart?

 (Source: Tappytoon)

characters.description: General of the Imperial Knights, the Duke's successor. Also called the "Grim Reaper" of the battlefield.
Also called Renee. Priestess of El Nur.
Empire's Prince, leader of the Paladin Knights.

description:
After winning a long war, Asha Pervaz is expecting the emperor to compensate her with money. Unlike her expectations though, the emperor asks Asha to choose her own husband from a list of nobles. Asha chooses Duke Carlisle Haven, the emperor’s eldest son and former crown prince. Asha expects him to object and pay an alimony instead, but the duke actually agrees to marry her! He even promises to help Asha rebuild Pervaz. What does the duke really want? And will Asha get what she wants without getting embroiled in the growing royal conspiracy?

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: お兄ちゃんたちに気をつけて！
ระวังพี่ชายพวกนั้นให้ดี!
description:
Harley thought that marriage would be her ticket out of the Ernst household and away from the family’s three sons, aka her perpetual tormenters. But on the eve of her wedding, she’s transported back in time 20 years to a youth she’d hoped to forget. As long as she’s getting a second chance at childhood, Harley’s determined to stand up to her bullies. But what began as retaliation quickly turns into reconciliation as both Harley and the Ernst brothers come to understand each other’s pain.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title.english: The Red Knight Seeks No Reward

synonyms: Red Knights Don't Chase Blind Money
A Red Knight Does Not Blindly Follow Money
少ない住む盲目のお金を従わない
红骑士绝不追求不劳而获的金钱
อัศวินสีชาดผู้ละจากความโลภ
description:
After dying at the hands of her backstabbing superior, money-grubbing Judith learned the hard way that bounty is never worth bloodshed. When she somehow finds herself alive and well, six years prior to her death, she decides to use her second chance at life to abandon her greed and become a genuine knight. She begins by accepting Captain Kaillou Lewalmeigh’s offer to join the honorable Order of Red Knights. Will Judith be able to redeem herself by overcoming the wrongdoings of her past?

(Source: Tapas)

Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Army veteran's last go at the obstacle course turns lethal after a simple fall. A goddess presents an opportunity at new life as a hero! The protagonist ain't having any of it, he was supposed to retire and become a civilian. The arrogant Goddess drops him down to survive while having her own evil schemes. How will his new life progress after encountering another Goddess, a spy and his past life's junior?

synonyms: Young Lady Is a Royal Chef
The Royal Shop of Young Lady
お嬢様はロイヤル・シェフ
description:
Sena’s been tossed into another world, as the despised daughter of a noble family. Her little restaurant was her refuge in her last life, so she’s got some tricks up her sleeve—cooking skills! As Senianna, she’ll put her brains and fine-tuned taste buds (Korean fried chicken, anyone?) to the test so she can take back the kitchen and gain this society’s esteemed title of Chef Royale. Will her cuisine reign supreme over the empire and bring her the sweet and salty balance of power and affection?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Dang Clan’s Swordmaster Heir Just Wants a Normal Life

synonyms: Becoming the Swordmaster Rank Young Lord of the Sichuan Tang Family
description:
The Dang clan of Sacheon, once renowned for its poison and hidden weapons, is now on the path to its demise. That is, until Yeonmyeung Dang, an outcast boy of the clan, awakens by recollecting the memories of his past life as the 'god of swords' who devoted his life to mastering the sword. Will the boy be able to protect his family and fulfill his dream of living a normal life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Is infinite regression a blessing– or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape. Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regression. Here begins Eunhyeon’s relentless struggle to break free.

(Source: WEBTOON)

synonyms: This Girl is a Little Wild
description: After he was defeated, the Demon King used the last of his strength to trap the captain of the Holy Knights into the body of a weak girl. However, the Captain was a girl, to begin with, so, tired of her former life and unable to return to her former body, she decides to live a luxurious life instead, in the body of the noble daughter she's trapped in. However, her new family puts her in danger, so she tries to go to the church to prove her identity. In order to do so, she ultimately becomes engaged to the captain of the special task force. Will she be able to prove her identity and still live an ordinary life? What will happen to her relationship with her fiancé? And, is there something more to this new life she's received?

synonyms: I Will Live as an Actor
description:
To escape a life of poverty, Jang Youngkuk aspired to be a famous actor. And he succeeds... at the cost of his mother's life. Upon proceeding to take his own out of despair, Youngkuk miraculously returns to his childhood. With a second chance to make things right, he swears to abandon acting and be the good son he never was. However, when financial troubles begin to haunt Youngkuk and his mother, he discovers that he may have no choice but to return to the set for one last take.

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: He is considered the father of the modern Korean film industry and is one o the few people regarded as a master of his craft.
She is the mother of [Jang Young-Guk](https://anilist.co/character/297015/Jang-YeongGuk).
He is an actor and one of the individuals who paved the road for Korean actors.
He is the director of "Confessions of a Priest", in which [Jang Young-Guk](https://anilist.co/character/297015/Jang-YeongGuk) starred in as the main character.
He is a KBC Drama Director.
He is the camera director for “The August Man,” a drama in which [Jang Young-Guk](https://anilist.co/character/297015/Jang-YeongGuk) starred.
He studied cinematography at Hanyoung University and is the director of an indie film "To Jin-Hwan," in which [Jang Young-Guk](https://anilist.co/character/297015/Jang-YeongGuk) starred in.

synonyms: The Hunter Wants to Live Quietly
description:
Life's never quiet when you've got S-Rank Rizz.

Former S-Rank Hunter Ui-Jae, a.k.a. J, saved humanity from eldritch horrors emerging from dimensional rifts, only to time-leap 8 years into a future where he's presumed dead. Now a manager at a hangover soup joint, all J wants is a quiet life. But between selling off the relics of his past and catching the obsessive attention of Korea's #1 Hunter Sa-Yeong, peace isn't on the menu!

(Source: Manta, edited)

title.english: How to survive as a maid in a horror game

synonyms: Surviving as a Maid in a Horror Game
เมื่อฉันเป็นเมดที่ต้องเอาตัวรอดในเกมสยองขวัญ
在恐怖游戏中作为女仆活下去
ホラーゲームのメイドとして生き残る
Le tueur de la famille Paltzdraf
Wie man als Dienstmädchen in einem Horrorspiel überlebt
Cómo sobrevivir en un videojuego de terror
Sống Sót Như Một Hầu Gái Trong Trò Chơi Kinh Dị
description:
The Murderer of Pflatzgraff Manor is a brand-new horror game from the developer A-coms. Even though it has beautiful graphics, its player base dubbed it as one of the worst games due to how difficult it is. You play the game as Adrian—a fine young man who’s also the devil’s reincarnation. Your goal as Adrian is to kill as many people as possible because of Lilith’s Curse. One night, you played the game until you couldn’t anymore and found yourself waking up as Hilda, one of Adrian’s maids…

(Source: Tapas)

characters.description: Possessing Hilda's body, a supporting character and a maid in a horror game she played while drunk in the real world, the protagonist needs to complete the game and live the story.

Adrian, who used to be Satan, was reincarnated as a human with a very weak body as a result of a curse that Lilith placed on him. The curse states that Adrian must kill in order to regain health and strength.

The Countess of the Pfaltzgraff manor. She was once a famous beauty in high society. Originally a devout believer, she cared for and loved the ailing Adrian, whom most people, including her husband, gave up. But after witnessing holy water react negatively to Adrian during a baptism, she lost her sanity, believing that the Devil itself had taken over Adrian's body.
Hilda's friend. Her good looks and kind personality makes her popular in the Pfaltzgraff manor. She often braids Hilda's hair.
Rosie is a demon who appears before Hilda, eager to work for her.
The doctor responsible for Adrian's health since childhood. He supports the killing method as a way of improving Adrian's health.
Count and head of the Pfaltzgraff family.
The loyal head maid of the Pfaltzgraff family who emigrated from another country.
Grover is a town thief who looks up to Hilda.
Zed is the stable keeper at Pflatzgraff manor, and the only one who can take care of the count's horse. He's a rapist who has ruined the lives of several maids.
Cayden is a town thief who looks up to Hilda.
Elbern is the butler of Pfaltzgraff manor.
Inspector Harrison is a police detective investigating the murders in the town.
Joanne is a con woman famous for extorting money and goods from people in the temple. She raised Hilda.
Jeffrey is a police detective. He's Inspector Harrison's assistant.
Olivia is a maid who works for the countess.
Lilith is the queen of the succubi. She's in love with Satan.
Dolores is a maid who works for Pflatzgraff manor.
Katarina is a maid who works for Pflatzgraff manor.
Isaac is a mailman. Hilda uses him to gather information from the town.

synonyms: レベルアップする魔王様
description:
Now that the demonic realm and the heavenly realm have called a truce, the human world has returned to an era of peace. Jeon Minchul lives the life of an ordinary college student until the day he comes across an artifact from the war and remembers—in his past life, he was the demon king who brought the world to its knees. Upon recalling these memories, Minchul awakens his old powers, along with some new ones. But can this demon king harness the powers of both good and evil to protect the peace?

(Source: Tapas)
